entries.name: Black Knife
entries.detailedLocation: Received upon defeating the Black Knife Assassin in front of Sainted Hero's Grave located in Altus Plateau.
entries.acquisition: Received upon defeating the Black Knife Assassin in front of Sainted Hero's Grave located in Altus Plateau.
entries.description: Dagger once belonging to one of the assassins who murdered Godwyn the Golden on the Night of the Black Knives. A ritual performed on the oddly misshapen blade imbued it with the power of the stolen Rune of Death.

entries.name: Blade of Calling
entries.primaryLocation: Forbidden Lands - Mountaintops of the Giants
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Forbidden Lands (Mountaintops of the Giants) Hidden within a room that you can only reach during the elevator ride that leads down to the Forbidden Lands grace, alongside the Official's Attire. Jump from the southwestern part of the elevator to a doorway just above the bottom floor.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Forbidden Lands (Mountaintops of the Giants) Hidden within a room that you can only reach during the elevator ride that leads down to the Forbidden Lands grace, alongside the Official's Attire. Jump from the southwestern part of the elevator to a doorway just above the bottom floor.
entries.description: Dagger given to one who set out on a journey to fulfill her duty long ago. The power of its former owner, the kindling maiden, is still apparent. The one who walks alongside flame, Shall one day meet the road of Destined Death.

entries.name: Bloodstained Dagger
entries.detailedLocation: Has a 2% drop rate from Fierce Demi-Humans aka Demi-Human Chiefs. One can point asleep next to the bridge west of the South of the Lookout Tower Site of Grace.
entries.acquisition: Has a 2% drop rate from Fierce Demi-Humans aka Demi-Human Chiefs. One can point asleep next to the bridge west of the South of the Lookout Tower Site of Grace.
entries.description: Dagger with a bloodstained blade. Afflicts targets with blood loss. As blood darkened the dagger through repeated slashing and stabbing, its blade only grew sharper and harder.

entries.name: Celebrant's Sickle
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Dominula, Windmill Village (Altus Plateau) 0.5% drop chance from the blue Dominula Dancers in Dominula, Windmill Village, located in the north of Altus Plateau. Two of them are found a bit east of the Windmill Village Site of Grace.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Dominula, Windmill Village (Altus Plateau) 0.5% drop chance from the blue Dominula Dancers in Dominula, Windmill Village, located in the north of Altus Plateau. Two of them are found a bit east of the Windmill Village Site of Grace.
entries.description: Sickle decorated with flowers and many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes on landing attacks.

entries.name: Cinquedea
entries.detailedLocation: On a body very far down at the cliff west of the Bestial Sanctum, on the same level as the Dragoncrest Shield Talisman. The Tarnished must carefully descend the cliffs by jumping onto roots, the domes of the pillars, and outcrops on the walls and pillars. Rainbow Stones can be used to help navigate safe descent.
entries.acquisition: On a body very far down at the cliff west of the Bestial Sanctum, on the same level as the Dragoncrest Shield Talisman. The Tarnished must carefully descend the cliffs by jumping onto roots, the domes of the pillars, and outcrops on the walls and pillars. Rainbow Stones can be used to help navigate safe descent.
entries.description: Short sword given to high ranking clergymen of Farum Azula. Raises potency of bestial incantations. The design celebrates a beast's five fingers, symbolic of the intelligence once granted upon their kind.

entries.name: Crystal Knife
entries.detailedLocation: Found in a chest inside the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel located in Liurnia of the Lakes. After taking the first elevator after the Site of Grace down and walking across a wooden beam it is inside the second room on the right, guarded by two distracted Marionette Soldiers.
entries.acquisition: Found in a chest inside the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel located in Liurnia of the Lakes. After taking the first elevator after the Site of Grace down and walking across a wooden beam it is inside the second room on the right, guarded by two distracted Marionette Soldiers.
entries.description: A knife made by sharpening hard crystal. Signature weapon of glintstone miners. Used as tool to extract glintstone from broken rock, and as such a faint magic enwreathes the blade.

entries.name: Dagger
entries.detailedLocation: One is sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 400 Runes 4% drop chance from dagger-wielding enemies (Highwaymen, Godrick Foot Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Foot Soldiers, Radahn Foot Soldiers, Leyndell Foot Soldiers, Haligtree Foot Soldiers, and Messmer Foot Soldiers). A good early farming spot is all the Highwaymen at the beginning of Murkwater Cave.
entries.acquisition: One is sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 400 Runes 4% drop chance from dagger-wielding enemies (Highwaymen, Godrick Foot Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Foot Soldiers, Radahn Foot Soldiers, Leyndell Foot Soldiers, Haligtree Foot Soldiers, and Messmer Foot Soldiers). A good early farming spot is all the Highwaymen at the beginning of Murkwater Cave.
entries.description: A standard dagger with a straight blade. Though modest in reach and capacity for harm, this weapon is light enough to jab in rapid succession and delivers devastating critical hits.

entries.name: Erdsteel Dagger
entries.detailedLocation: Received from Kenneth Haight after helping him retake Fort Haight. Can be found in Leyndell, Royal Capital in the sewer area under the wing of Gransax near a fire-spitting Gargoyle Statue. From the Avenue Balcony Site of Grace, proceed northwest along the avenue and drop down in the pit to the far left.
entries.acquisition: Received from Kenneth Haight after helping him retake Fort Haight. Can be found in Leyndell, Royal Capital in the sewer area under the wing of Gransax near a fire-spitting Gargoyle Statue. From the Avenue Balcony Site of Grace, proceed northwest along the avenue and drop down in the pit to the far left.
entries.description: An erdsteel dagger with a grass crest engraved upon its blade. Carried by the Erdtree royalty for self-defense in times of peace. Though forged to a high standard, the weapon is difficult to wield. Attack power also scales with faith.

entries.name: Fire Knight's Shortsword
entries.detailedLocation: Dropped by dual dagger-wielding Fire Knights with a 4% droprate.
entries.acquisition: Dropped by dual dagger-wielding Fire Knights with a 4% droprate.
entries.description: Shortsword used by the Fire Knights. A slender blade that undulates like fire. Blessed with a flame incantation. Further flame imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power.

entries.name: Glintstone Kris
entries.detailedLocation: Received if siding with Sorceress Sellen against Castellan Jerren in Academy of Raya Lucaria near the end of her questline.
entries.acquisition: Received if siding with Sorceress Sellen against Castellan Jerren in Academy of Raya Lucaria near the end of her questline.
entries.description: Ritual blade once presented to Leyndell by the Academy of Raya Lucaria to celebrate their newfound peace. Though the weapon is embedded with precious glintstones and features Erdtree ornamentation, the undulating blade is symbolic of an ancient ritual.

entries.name: Great Knife
entries.detailedLocation: Starting equipment for the Bandit class. 2% drop chance from Small Demi-Humans. The earliest farming spot is just inside Lakeside Crystal Cave, where one can be found hiding inside of a bush next to a regular Demi-Human. The most efficient farming spot is just north of the Craftsman's Shack Site of Grace on Mt. Gelmir, where four of them are hiding amongst a flock of Sheep.
entries.acquisition: Starting equipment for the Bandit class. 2% drop chance from Small Demi-Humans. The earliest farming spot is just inside Lakeside Crystal Cave, where one can be found hiding inside of a bush next to a regular Demi-Human. The most efficient farming spot is just north of the Craftsman's Shack Site of Grace on Mt. Gelmir, where four of them are hiding amongst a flock of Sheep.
entries.description: Large knife with a broad, curved blade. This weapon is designed to slash and rend, inflicting blood loss upon the recipient.

entries.name: Ivory Sickle
entries.detailedLocation: Found near the Village of the Albinaurics Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes.
entries.acquisition: Found near the Village of the Albinaurics Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes.
entries.description: Sickle fashioned from ivory. Weapon carried by aged Albinaurics. These weapons are evidence of their dedication to the Haligtree, despite never having entered its presence.

entries.name: Main-gauche
entries.detailedLocation: Found inside of Shadow Keep. From the Main Gate Plaza Site of Grace, head up the western stairs and take a right after the first stair, then take a right again in the corridor to arrive in a small room with a Black Knight. The dagger can be found on a body in the left corner.
entries.acquisition: Found inside of Shadow Keep. From the Main Gate Plaza Site of Grace, head up the western stairs and take a right after the first stair, then take a right again in the corridor to arrive in a small room with a Black Knight. The dagger can be found on a body in the left corner.
entries.description: Dagger with a large hand guard. Intended to be used in the left hand, thereby complementing a piercing sword or identical blade held in the right to enable a distinctive style of fighting.

entries.name: Miséricorde
entries.detailedLocation: Found behind a fog wall that requires 1 Stonesword Key to open, near the roaming Grafted Scion inside Stormveil Castle and the elevator shortcut back up to the Rampart Tower Site of Grace.
entries.acquisition: Found behind a fog wall that requires 1 Stonesword Key to open, near the roaming Grafted Scion inside Stormveil Castle and the elevator shortcut back up to the Rampart Tower Site of Grace.
entries.description: Dagger favored by military physicians in white. The pointed blade is hard and sharp, making critical hits especially potent. Medicine is mercy, and mercy upon the battlefield is ruthless. Beware the killers clothed as men of compassion.

entries.name: Parrying Dagger
entries.detailedLocation: One can be bought from Patches for 1,600 Runes in any of his locations (Murkwater Cave is the earliest).
entries.acquisition: One can be bought from Patches for 1,600 Runes in any of his locations (Murkwater Cave is the earliest).
entries.description: A knife with curved handguards. Designed to parry, turning foes' attacks against them. For masters of combat who anticipate every enemy strike and counter accordingly, this weapon is all they need.

entries.name: Reduvia
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Limgrave Dropped by Bloody Finger Nerijus near Murkwater Cave after defeating him. Beware that progressing through the game can prevent this invasion from happening, more specifically by defeating all the major Limgrave bosses (Flying Dragon Agheel, Mad Pumpkin Head, Margit, the Fell Omen, Tibia Mariner, and Tree Sentinel).
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Limgrave Dropped by Bloody Finger Nerijus near Murkwater Cave after defeating him. Beware that progressing through the game can prevent this invasion from happening, more specifically by defeating all the major Limgrave bosses (Flying Dragon Agheel, Mad Pumpkin Head, Margit, the Fell Omen, Tibia Mariner, and Tree Sentinel).
entries.description: Jagged dagger with a distinctive curved blade. Used by the noble servants of the Lord of Blood. This dagger rips the flesh as it enters, inflicting blood loss with sickening efficacy. A proud testament to the success of its vicious design, this weapon is perpetually coated in blood.

entries.name: Scorpion's Stinger
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Lake of Rot (Ainsel River) Found inside a chest near the Grand Cloister Site of Grace, located in the Lake of Rot. It inside the small shrine to the west that is guarded by a large group of Kindred of Rot.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Lake of Rot (Ainsel River) Found inside a chest near the Grand Cloister Site of Grace, located in the Lake of Rot. It inside the small shrine to the west that is guarded by a large group of Kindred of Rot.
entries.description: Dagger fashioned from a great scorpion's tail, glistening with scarlet rot. A ceremonial tool used by heretics, crafted from the relic of a sealed outer god. |JP_Name=蠍の針 |JP_Source=1.07.

entries.name: Wakizashi
entries.detailedLocation: Found on a corpse inside a locked cell in Gaol Cave, located in Caelid. The cave requires one Stonesword Key to access. From the lever that unlocks all the cages it can be found by taking a right then a left, and then it's one of three items in the second cage on the left.
entries.acquisition: Found on a corpse inside a locked cell in Gaol Cave, located in Caelid. The cave requires one Stonesword Key to access. From the lever that unlocks all the cages it can be found by taking a right then a left, and then it's one of three items in the second cage on the left.
entries.description: Short sword with a tempering pattern on the blade. A weapon unique to warriors of the Land of the Reeds. Afflicts targets with blood loss. These swords are considered auxiliary weapons. Yet, one man is known to wield this weapon in his left hand while using a full-sized katana in his right. A demonic swordman known only as Okina.

entries.name: Smithscript Dagger
entries.detailedLocation: Found at Ruined Forge Lava Intake. Proceed normally through the dungeon until you reach the lever that moves the lava pipe and then drop down to the floor below. The dagger can be found behind the Golem Smith.
entries.acquisition: Found at Ruined Forge Lava Intake. Proceed normally through the dungeon until you reach the lever that moves the lava pipe and then drop down to the floor below. The dagger can be found behind the Golem Smith.

entries.name: Broadsword
entries.detailedLocation: Starting equipment for the Confessor class. Nomadic Merchant southeast of Coastal Cave, beneath the collapsed structure.
entries.acquisition: Starting equipment for the Confessor class. Nomadic Merchant southeast of Coastal Cave, beneath the collapsed structure.
entries.description: A straight sword with a wide blade, suited to slashing attacks. Horizontal swing boast wide attack range, making it easier to connect with foes.

entries.name: Cane Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Found next to the stairs just south of the West Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Can still be found in Leyndell, Ashen Capital.
entries.acquisition: Found next to the stairs just south of the West Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Can still be found in Leyndell, Ashen Capital.
entries.description: Beloved sword of an aged knight whose last quest was long behind him, repurposed into a walking stick. The tip is rather worn. Though bent of back and without the brawn required even to raise the sword aloft, still he wished to meet his end with weapon in hand.

entries.name: Carian Knight's Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Held by a Carriage located in the northwest region of Liurnia of the Lakes, between the Northern Liurnia Lake Shore and The Four Belfries Sites of Grace.
entries.acquisition: Held by a Carriage located in the northwest region of Liurnia of the Lakes, between the Northern Liurnia Lake Shore and The Four Belfries Sites of Grace.
entries.description: Straight sword embedded with a blue glintstone. Weapon of knights sworn to Carian royalty. These knights' sword could serve as catalysts, letting them wield sorcerous battle skills. Despite numbering fewer than twenty, this power made them a match for even the champions of gold in battle.

entries.name: Coded Sword
entries.detailedLocation: The Coded Sword can be found on the upper floor of the Fortified Manor in Leyndell, Royal Capital, in the room that mirrors the one that the Two Fingers of the Roundtable Hold can be found it. This weapon cannot be acquired once the Tarnished has defeated Maliketh.
entries.acquisition: The Coded Sword can be found on the upper floor of the Fortified Manor in Leyndell, Royal Capital, in the room that mirrors the one that the Two Fingers of the Roundtable Hold can be found it. This weapon cannot be acquired once the Tarnished has defeated Maliketh.
entries.description: Hidden sword once granted to the Tarnished of the Roundtable by the Two Fingers. A formless cipher comprises its blade, which deals holy damage no shield can repel. Champions would gather at the Roundtable Hold in days long past, when the Two Fingers were masters of oration, their flesh yet full of vigor.

entries.name: Crystal Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Found after the bridge in the Village of the Albinaurics Site of Grace, located in Liurnia of the Lakes.
entries.acquisition: Found after the bridge in the Village of the Albinaurics Site of Grace, located in Liurnia of the Lakes.
entries.description: Sword fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence. The inscrutable Crystalians have but one clear purpose, to safeguard their crystals unto the end. One theory posits that they yearn for the return of their creator who will carve for them new brethren.

entries.name: Golden Epitaph
entries.detailedLocation: Found at the entrance of Auriza Hero's Grave. Requires a Stonesword Key to access and is guarded by a Basilisk.
entries.acquisition: Found at the entrance of Auriza Hero's Grave. Requires a Stonesword Key to access and is guarded by a Basilisk.
entries.description: A sword made to commemorate the death of Godwyn the Golden, first of the demigods to die. Infused with the humble prayer of a young boy; "O brother, lord brother, please die a true death.".

entries.name: Lazuli Glintstone Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Dropped by Lazuli Glintstone Sorcerers with a 2% drop rate. One can be easily reached just outside of the room with the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace, just before the Red Wolf of Radagon in Academy of Raya Lucaria.
entries.acquisition: Dropped by Lazuli Glintstone Sorcerers with a 2% drop rate. One can be easily reached just outside of the room with the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace, just before the Red Wolf of Radagon in Academy of Raya Lucaria.
entries.description: A sword with a glintstone in its handguards. Wielded by the scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus who seek to master Carian sorcery. Deals magic damage. Apparently once used as a staff of sorcery, this sword is made out of wood.

entries.name: Longsword
entries.detailedLocation: Starting armament of the Vagabond origin. Purchased from Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 1,000 Runes.
entries.acquisition: Starting armament of the Vagabond origin. Purchased from Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 1,000 Runes.
entries.description: A straight sword with a double-edged blade. In addition to its reliable standard damage, this weapon also boasts powerful piercing attacks. A superbly balanced armament.

entries.name: Lordsworn's Straight Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Soldier enemies of every faction that wield this weapon have a 2% drop rate for it. This includes Godrick Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Soldiers, Radahn Soldiers, Leyndell Soldiers, Mausoleum Soldiers, and Haligtree Soldiers. Can be farmed from the very beginning of the game, at Gatefront Ruins, where some Godrick Soldiers wield this sword. A more reliable spot can be found at Fourth Church of Marika, where two sword-wielding Mausoleum Soldiers can be found just outside the entrance.
entries.acquisition: Soldier enemies of every faction that wield this weapon have a 2% drop rate for it. This includes Godrick Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Soldiers, Radahn Soldiers, Leyndell Soldiers, Mausoleum Soldiers, and Haligtree Soldiers. Can be farmed from the very beginning of the game, at Gatefront Ruins, where some Godrick Soldiers wield this sword. A more reliable spot can be found at Fourth Church of Marika, where two sword-wielding Mausoleum Soldiers can be found just outside the entrance.
entries.description: Well-crafted straight sword with an illustrious design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army. Though blackened and damaged by years of use, it appears to have otherwise been kept in a serviceable condition, despite the soldiers having long since lost their minds.

entries.name: Miquellan Knight's Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, near the Prayer Room Site of Grace. After exiting the Grace in it to continue forward there will be a parapet on the right that leads to a tower with a ladder on the other side. Climbing that ladder leads to the sword's location.
entries.acquisition: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, near the Prayer Room Site of Grace. After exiting the Grace in it to continue forward there will be a parapet on the right that leads to a tower with a ladder on the other side. Climbing that ladder leads to the sword's location.
entries.description: Sword forged by the servants of Miquella of the Haligtree, with a design modeled after those carried by Carian Knights. Instead of glinstone however, amber of the Haligtree is embedded in the blade. A sumptuous piece, yet it has never been offered to any knight - an ill-starred sword with no master.

entries.name: Noble's Slender Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Dropped by Wandering Nobles that wield it with a 0.5% drop rate. These specific nobles are distinguished by wearing the Aristocrat Garb (Altered) and Aristocrat Boots. Sword-and-torch-wielding nobles will not drop the sword. The Carriage on the road that runs north from the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace has several of these Nobles in its caravan.
entries.acquisition: Dropped by Wandering Nobles that wield it with a 0.5% drop rate. These specific nobles are distinguished by wearing the Aristocrat Garb (Altered) and Aristocrat Boots. Sword-and-torch-wielding nobles will not drop the sword. The Carriage on the road that runs north from the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace has several of these Nobles in its caravan.
entries.description: Narrow blade carried by wandering nobles. Made to be easy to wield. Daubed with gold from tip to tail, it should fetch a good sum.

entries.name: Ornamental Straight Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Dropped by the Grafted Scion at the Chapel of Anticipation, either by beating it first try when starting the game or when visiting again through The Four Belfries in west Liurnia of the Lakes.
entries.acquisition: Dropped by the Grafted Scion at the Chapel of Anticipation, either by beating it first try when starting the game or when visiting again through The Four Belfries in west Liurnia of the Lakes.
entries.description: Slender straight sword patterned after an unique ornament. Superior swordsmen prefer to wield one in each hand. After falling from grace, the dregs of the golden lineage sought power and purpose in the past.

entries.name: Regalia of Eochaid
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Gaol Cave (Caelid) Found on a ledge at the beach bordering Caelid and Limgrave, to the east of the Third Church of Marika. It can be reached through the Gaol Cave or by using Torrent to perform some tricky jumps to ascend the cliff face onto its ledge.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Gaol Cave (Caelid) Found on a ledge at the beach bordering Caelid and Limgrave, to the east of the Third Church of Marika. It can be reached through the Gaol Cave or by using Torrent to perform some tricky jumps to ascend the cliff face onto its ledge.
entries.description: Treasured sword of Eochaid, a lesser, long-vanished domain. The copper coloration is not to be confused for rust, but is a conduit for its wielder to move it by their will alone. Swords of Eochaid dance through the skies.

entries.name: Rotten Crystal Sword
entries.detailedLocation: In a treasure chest guarded by three Crystalians in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, behind some large tree roots right after the Ephael Inner Wall grace.
entries.acquisition: In a treasure chest guarded by three Crystalians in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, behind some large tree roots right after the Ephael Inner Wall grace.
entries.description: Sword fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence.

entries.name: Short Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Starting equipment for the Astrologer class. Nomadic Merchant east of Saintsbridge for 600 Runes (x1). 4% drop chance off short sword-wielding enemies (Highwaymen, Godrick Foot Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Foot Soldiers, Radahn Foot Soldiers, Leyndell Foot Soldiers, Haligtree Foot Soldiers, and Messmer Foot Soldiers). Murkwater Cave has many Highwaymen in a small area, making it a decent farming spot.
entries.acquisition: Starting equipment for the Astrologer class. Nomadic Merchant east of Saintsbridge for 600 Runes (x1). 4% drop chance off short sword-wielding enemies (Highwaymen, Godrick Foot Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Foot Soldiers, Radahn Foot Soldiers, Leyndell Foot Soldiers, Haligtree Foot Soldiers, and Messmer Foot Soldiers). Murkwater Cave has many Highwaymen in a small area, making it a decent farming spot.
entries.description: A short straight sword with a short blade. In addition to its reliable standard damage, this weapon also boasts powerful piercing attacks. Lightweight amongst straight swords, this weapon is easy to wield, requiring only humble attributes.

entries.name: Stone-Sheathed Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Found at an altar in either Fog Rift Catacombs, Ruins of Unte, or Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Since the altar in Fog Rift Catacombs is the most complicated to reach, it's recommended that the sword is taken there so that the later interactions with altars are less time-consuming. WARNING: Once either the Sword of Darkness or Sword of Light has been acquired, though the two forms can be freely switched between by traveling to their assigned altars, the Stone-Sheathed Sword itself cannot be reacquired until you enter the next new game cycle. Fog Rift Catacombs: From the start, follow the path so that you pass the first and second falling-spikes roofs to the elevator. Continue to the third falling-spikes roof and get to the other side of the room (be wary of the pit in the second saferoom to the left). Use the raised platform at the end of the room to enter the hidden compartment in the falling roof and ride it to a higher platform so that you can stand on top of the falling roof. The altar can be found in the opposite right corner of the room when on the roof. Picking the sword up here means it turns into the Sword of Darkness at Ruins of Unte and the Sword of Light at Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Ruins of Unte: Found to the right inside of the courtyard blocked by an extinguished Furnace Golem (a Hefty Furnace Pot can get it going again to open the path). Picking the sword up here means it turns into the Sword of Darkness at Fog Rift Catacombs and the Sword of Light at Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Ancient Ruins of Rauh: From Ancient Rauh Ruins, East Site of Grace, head across the bridge towards the west then continue forward until a small body of water and take a right. Take the Spirit Spring that is now straight ahead and jump forwards (north-northeast on the map) to a ruin underneath the large cliff. Here is a body with the Greater Potentate's Cookbook 9 on a pile of rubble. Standing at the cookbook with the Spirit Spring directly behind you, turn to the right to see a tower and a "broken" bridge (actually just invisible) that can be crossed to reach the altar. Picking the sword up here means it turns into the Sword of Darkness at Fog Rift Catacombs and the Sword of Light at Ruins of Unte.

Here is a body with the Greater Potentate's Cookbook 9 on a pile of rubble. Standing at the cookbook with the Spirit Spring directly behind you, turn to the right to see a tower and a "broken" bridge (actually just invisible) that can be crossed to reach the altar. Picking the sword up here means it turns into the Sword of Darkness at Fog Rift Catacombs and the Sword of Light at Ruins of Unte.
entries.description: A sword that none can pull from its scabbard of cracked stone. Relic of a lost civilization from a time long past, said to have served a ritual purpose at altars of light and darkness.

entries.name: Sword of Darkness
entries.detailedLocation: Take the Stone-Sheathed Sword or Sword of Light to an altar at either Fog Rift Catacombs or Ruins of Unte. WARNING: Once either the Sword of Darkness or Sword of Light has been acquired, though the two forms can be freely switched between by traveling to their assigned altars, the Stone-Sheathed Sword itself cannot be reacquired until you enter the next new game cycle. See the page for the Stone-Sheathed Sword for all 3 altar locations. If the Stone-Sheathed Sword was taken from Fog Rift Catacombs or Ancient Ruins of Rauh the altar at Ruins of Unte should be used. If it was taken from Ruins of Unte the altar at Fog Rift Catacombs should be used.
entries.acquisition: Take the Stone-Sheathed Sword or Sword of Light to an altar at either Fog Rift Catacombs or Ruins of Unte. WARNING: Once either the Sword of Darkness or Sword of Light has been acquired, though the two forms can be freely switched between by traveling to their assigned altars, the Stone-Sheathed Sword itself cannot be reacquired until you enter the next new game cycle. See the page for the Stone-Sheathed Sword for all 3 altar locations. If the Stone-Sheathed Sword was taken from Fog Rift Catacombs or Ancient Ruins of Rauh the altar at Ruins of Unte should be used. If it was taken from Ruins of Unte the altar at Fog Rift Catacombs should be used.
entries.description: Sword of darkness, pulled from its stone scabbard at an altar. From the quick of the root, wandering coils of darkness coalesce and release, their eddies and vortices giving form to the dark blade.

entries.name: Sword of Light
entries.detailedLocation: Take the Stone-Sheathed Sword or Sword of Darkness to an altar at either Fog Rift Catacombs or Ancient Ruins of Rauh. WARNING: Once either the Sword of Darkness or Sword of Light has been acquired, though the two forms can be freely switched between by traveling to their assigned altars, the Stone-Sheathed Sword itself cannot be reacquired until you enter the next new game cycle. See the page for the Stone-Sheathed Sword for all 3 altar locations. If the Stone-Sheathed Sword was taken from Fog Rift Catacombs or Ruins of Unte the altar at Ancient Ruins of Rauh should be used. If it was taken from Ancient Ruins of Rauh the altar at Fog Rift Catacombs should be used.
entries.acquisition: Take the Stone-Sheathed Sword or Sword of Darkness to an altar at either Fog Rift Catacombs or Ancient Ruins of Rauh. WARNING: Once either the Sword of Darkness or Sword of Light has been acquired, though the two forms can be freely switched between by traveling to their assigned altars, the Stone-Sheathed Sword itself cannot be reacquired until you enter the next new game cycle. See the page for the Stone-Sheathed Sword for all 3 altar locations. If the Stone-Sheathed Sword was taken from Fog Rift Catacombs or Ruins of Unte the altar at Ancient Ruins of Rauh should be used. If it was taken from Ancient Ruins of Rauh the altar at Fog Rift Catacombs should be used.
entries.description: Sword of light, pulled from its stone scabbard at an altar. From the quick of the root, unswerving rays of light intersect and reflect to give the silver blade form.

entries.name: Sword of Night and Flame
entries.detailedLocation: In a locked room at Caria Manor, Liurnia of the Lakes, which the Tarnished can jump into from above on the walkways where the Raya Lucaria Soldier puppets appear. More specifically, starting from the Manor Lower Level Site of Grace walk out onto the stone walkways and take a left when they path splits in two. Follow the path as it turn to the right and look to the left when halfway across the last walkway. Search for a nearby roof to jump onto and then walk forward to find another roof further down. In one of the corners should be a ladder leading down into the inside of a tower with a chest containing the sword as well as a door leading outside.
entries.acquisition: In a locked room at Caria Manor, Liurnia of the Lakes, which the Tarnished can jump into from above on the walkways where the Raya Lucaria Soldier puppets appear. More specifically, starting from the Manor Lower Level Site of Grace walk out onto the stone walkways and take a left when they path splits in two. Follow the path as it turn to the right and look to the left when halfway across the last walkway. Search for a nearby roof to jump onto and then walk forward to find another roof further down. In one of the corners should be a ladder leading down into the inside of a tower with a chest containing the sword as well as a door leading outside.
entries.description: Storied sword and treasure of Caria Manor. One of the legendary armaments. Astrologers, who preceded the sorcerers, established themselves in mountaintops that nearly touched the sky, and considered the Fire Giants their neighbors.

entries.name: Sword of St. Trina
entries.detailedLocation: Behind a Stonesword Key imp statue in the Forsaken Ruins, Caelid, visible directly below the ledge at the Rotview Balcony Site of Grace.
entries.acquisition: Behind a Stonesword Key imp statue in the Forsaken Ruins, Caelid, visible directly below the ledge at the Rotview Balcony Site of Grace.
entries.description: Silver sword carried by clerics of St. Trina. Inflicts sleep ailment upon foes. St. Trina is an enigmatic figure. Some say she is a comely young girl, others are sure he is a boy. The only certainty is that their appearance was as sudden as their disappearance.

entries.name: Velvet Sword of St. Trina
entries.detailedLocation: From the Fissure Cross Site of Grace in Cerulean Coast, head north and drop down two stone platforms to a cliff lower down. Inside of a cave to the south that's full of slimes is also the sword, furthest in.
entries.acquisition: From the Fissure Cross Site of Grace in Cerulean Coast, head north and drop down two stone platforms to a cliff lower down. Inside of a cave to the south that's full of slimes is also the sword, furthest in.
entries.description: Silver sword of St. Trina, now stained the color of velvet. Inflicts eternal sleep. When St. Trina was abandoned, the faint, light-purple mists coalesced into an intoxicating deep-purple cloud.

entries.name: Warhawk's Talon
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Stormveil Castle / Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants) 2% drop chance from Warhawks. 4 of these birds can be found on the walls outside of the Rampart Tower Site of Grace.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Stormveil Castle / Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants) 2% drop chance from Warhawks. 4 of these birds can be found on the walls outside of the Rampart Tower Site of Grace.
entries.description: Talon-swords are affixed to the legs of Stormveil's warhawks, but this one has been repurposed for human use. The blade is thin and lightweight so as not to obstruct the hawk's mobility.

entries.name: Weathered Straight Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Dropped by Commoner enemies with a 4% drop rate. An easy spot to farm is the room with a Grafted Scion, where 3 Commoners are sitting next to a fireplace near the stairs to the second floor (an easy path there is taking the elevator next to the Rampart Tower Site of Grace). A more complicated but also more efficient farming spot is heading southwest from the Secluded Chamber Site of Grace and, once up a small pile of rocks, turn around to the right and use a wooden platform to jump to a thin stone ledge. Jump to a dark room to the right and proceed along the path to a second dark room, full of Commoners.
entries.acquisition: Dropped by Commoner enemies with a 4% drop rate. An easy spot to farm is the room with a Grafted Scion, where 3 Commoners are sitting next to a fireplace near the stairs to the second floor (an easy path there is taking the elevator next to the Rampart Tower Site of Grace). A more complicated but also more efficient farming spot is heading southwest from the Secluded Chamber Site of Grace and, once up a small pile of rocks, turn around to the right and use a wooden platform to jump to a thin stone ledge. Jump to a dark room to the right and proceed along the path to a second dark room, full of Commoners.
entries.description: Straight sword with a rather short but wide blade. Simple to wield, it was known as the sword of the people. Though the Erdtree styling is still visible, time has not been kind to this sword, now merely a shadow of its former self.

entries.name: Leda's Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Enir-Ilim Received after defeating Leda and her allies in their boss fight near the top of Enir-Ilim.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Enir-Ilim Received after defeating Leda and her allies in their boss fight near the top of Enir-Ilim.
entries.description: Light greatsword with gold inlaid. Weapon of Leda, the Needle Knight. Deals holy damage. Though polished to a mirror sheen, this blade still reeks with the stench of crusted blood that lingers from the cull of her knightly comrades.

entries.name: Milady
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Castle Ensis (Gravesite Plain) The weapon can be found in a chest at the top of a watchtower in Castle Ensis. The watchtower can be reached from the Castle-Lord's Chamber Site of Grace by heading out the small arched doorway onto a stone balcony, jumping over the ledge, and continuing downwards on the rock facings. You can then head up the watchtower via a set of stairs and ladders.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Castle Ensis (Gravesite Plain) The weapon can be found in a chest at the top of a watchtower in Castle Ensis. The watchtower can be reached from the Castle-Lord's Chamber Site of Grace by heading out the small arched doorway onto a stone balcony, jumping over the ledge, and continuing downwards on the rock facings. You can then head up the watchtower via a set of stairs and ladders.
entries.description: A light greatsword; that is, a sword whose blade matches the length of a greatsword, while being constrained to a minimal weight. Nicknamed after ladies of noble status for its refined appearance. With cultivated form, one can wield this weapon as swiftly as one might a straightsword.

entries.name: Rellana's Twin Blades
entries.detailedLocation: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight, gained by defeating Rellana, Twin Moon Knight, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.acquisition: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight, gained by defeating Rellana, Twin Moon Knight, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.description: Carian light greatsword embedded with blue glintstone. Weapon of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight. Two swords as a single armament. When two-handing, a straight sword engraved with golden flame will be carried in the left hand. Here, and here alone, were moon and fire ever together.

entries.name: Alabaster Lord's Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Lake of Rot / Yelough Anix Tunnel (Consecrated Snowfield) One each is dropped by respective the Alabaster Lord in the Lake of Rot and in Yelough Anix Tunnel. Note that the sword will not drop if the Lord is killed at the same time as the player. Lake of Rot one is reached by raising a series of platforms towards the end of the lake and then getting atop them by climbing up a cliff west of the entrance to the Grand Cloister to reach a gravitational anomaly. The Lord in the Tunnel is found in a pit after the frozen elevator. Dropping down into the pit and turning around should make the anomaly the Lord is hiding in visible.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Lake of Rot / Yelough Anix Tunnel (Consecrated Snowfield) One each is dropped by respective the Alabaster Lord in the Lake of Rot and in Yelough Anix Tunnel. Note that the sword will not drop if the Lord is killed at the same time as the player. Lake of Rot one is reached by raising a series of platforms towards the end of the lake and then getting atop them by climbing up a cliff west of the entrance to the Grand Cloister to reach a gravitational anomaly. The Lord in the Tunnel is found in a pit after the frozen elevator. Dropping down into the pit and turning around should make the anomaly the Lord is hiding in visible.
entries.description: Greatsword forged from a blue-white meteoric ore. The blade conceals gravity-manipulating magic. A weapon unique to the Alabaster Lords, a race of ancients with skin of stone who were said to have risen to life when a meteor struck long ago.

entries.name: Banished Knight's Greatsword
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Stormveil Castle / Cathedral of Dragon Communion (Caelid) / Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants) 4% drop chance from sword-and-shield Banished Knights. A lone sword-and-shield Banished Knight can be found outside of the southwestern exit from Cathedral of Dragon Communion, patrolling around the Cathedral. Heading southwest down the tower from the Rampart Tower Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle leads to a halberd-wielding Banished Knight. Another, sword-and-shield-wielding knight can be found by continuing down the tower and dropping down one of the wooden walkways to the floor below, making it possible to farm the Banished Knight's Halberd at the same time. 7.8% drop chance from dual-sword Banished Knights. These are the rarest variant of Banished Knight, and are found only in Castle Sol and Crumbling Farum Azula. Technically the drop chance per Greatsword is still only 4%, but as they can have a chance to drop it twice the drop chance is effectively increased.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Stormveil Castle / Cathedral of Dragon Communion (Caelid) / Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants) 4% drop chance from sword-and-shield Banished Knights. A lone sword-and-shield Banished Knight can be found outside of the southwestern exit from Cathedral of Dragon Communion, patrolling around the Cathedral. Heading southwest down the tower from the Rampart Tower Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle leads to a halberd-wielding Banished Knight. Another, sword-and-shield-wielding knight can be found by continuing down the tower and dropping down one of the wooden walkways to the floor below, making it possible to farm the Banished Knight's Halberd at the same time. 7.8% drop chance from dual-sword Banished Knights. These are the rarest variant of Banished Knight, and are found only in Castle Sol and Crumbling Farum Azula. Technically the drop chance per Greatsword is still only 4%, but as they can have a chance to drop it twice the drop chance is effectively increased.
entries.description: A finely-crafted greatsword intricately engraved with an ancient motif. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.

entries.name: Bastard Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Purchase: Weeping Peninsula One is sold for runes 3,000 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant at the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace.
entries.acquisition: Purchase: Weeping Peninsula One is sold for runes 3,000 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant at the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace.
entries.description: A large sword with a straight blade. This heavy sword is usually wielded with two hands, but for those with enough strength, one is sufficient. The hefty blade can be swung into multiple foes at once thanks to the broad, sweeping attack, making fending off crowds all the easier.

entries.name: Blasphemous Blade
entries.detailedLocation: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Blasphemous, gained by defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.acquisition: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Blasphemous, gained by defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
passiveEffects: Restores HP equal to 4% of maximum HP + 40 upon nearby deaths.
entries.description: Sacred sword of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy. Remains of the countless heroes he has devoured writhe upon the surface of this blade. Now they share the same blood, bound together as family. Some HP is restored upon defeating an enemy.

entries.name: Claymore
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Castle Morne (Weeping Peninsula) Found in a chest in the castle. From the Castle Morne Lift Site of Grace and taking the elevator up, it's found in a building on the right, reached by climbing up the pile of bodies in the castle's courtyard.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Castle Morne (Weeping Peninsula) Found in a chest in the castle. From the Castle Morne Lift Site of Grace and taking the elevator up, it's found in a building on the right, reached by climbing up the pile of bodies in the castle's courtyard.
entries.description: A large sword with a long, straight blade. This heavy sword is usually wielded with two hands, but for those with enough strength, one is sufficient. In addition to the heavy sweeping attacks, it can also make a heavy piercing thrust, making this a versatile weapon.

entries.name: Dark Moon Greatsword
entries.detailedLocation: Quest reward: Cathedral of Manus Celes (Liurnia of the Lakes) Found at the end of Lunar Princess Ranni's questline, in the spot where she sat underneath the Cathedral of Manus Celes, after giving her the Dark Moon Ring.
entries.acquisition: Quest reward: Cathedral of Manus Celes (Liurnia of the Lakes) Found at the end of Lunar Princess Ranni's questline, in the spot where she sat underneath the Cathedral of Manus Celes, after giving her the Dark Moon Ring.
entries.description: A Moon Greatsword bestowed by a Carian queen upon her spouse to honor long-standing tradition. One of the legendary armaments. Ranni's sigil is a full moon, cold and leaden, and this sword is but a beam of its light.

entries.name: Death's Poker
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Caelid Dropped by the Death Rite Bird in Caelid, found southeast of the Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank Site of Grace at night. The high cliff to the east of the boss can be used to cheese it, as it's rather bad at scaling the rocks. Combined with anti-Those Who Live in Death equipment and ranged attacks will kill it quickly. It's also possible to lure the Bird off the southern cliffs since some of its attack have it jump in various directions, especially if its first lure to the southern cliffs and then pulled to a large branch to the east to keep it from moving around too much.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Caelid Dropped by the Death Rite Bird in Caelid, found southeast of the Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank Site of Grace at night. The high cliff to the east of the boss can be used to cheese it, as it's rather bad at scaling the rocks. Combined with anti-Those Who Live in Death equipment and ranged attacks will kill it quickly. It's also possible to lure the Bird off the southern cliffs since some of its attack have it jump in various directions, especially if its first lure to the southern cliffs and then pulled to a large branch to the east to keep it from moving around too much.
entries.description: Barbed rod carried by Deathbirds. The birds are graveyard fire keepers; it is said they rake out the ashen remains of the dead from their kilns.

entries.name: Flamberge
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Redmane Castle (Caelid) Found atop a tower to the right of the stairs up to the courtyard with the Misbegotten Warrior & Crucible Knight boss fight, guarded by a Mad Pumpkin Head. WARNING: This door is locked during the Radahn Festival, requiring the defeat of Starscourge Radahn and speaking to Castellan Jerren to reset the Castle to its regular state.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Redmane Castle (Caelid) Found atop a tower to the right of the stairs up to the courtyard with the Misbegotten Warrior & Crucible Knight boss fight, guarded by a Mad Pumpkin Head. WARNING: This door is locked during the Radahn Festival, requiring the defeat of Starscourge Radahn and speaking to Castellan Jerren to reset the Castle to its regular state.
entries.description: Greatsword featuring a flame-like undulation. Shred enemy flesh, inducing blood loss. Scarlet rot is kept at bay with flame at Redmane Castle, and as such, this beloved sword of Jerren's eventually became the symbol of the castle itself.

entries.name: Forked Greatsword
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Road's End Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Minor Erdtree Catacombs & War-Dead Catacombs (Caelid) / Sainted Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau) / Wyndham Catacombs (Mt. Gelmir) / Auriza Side Tomb (Capital Outskirts) / Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Leyndell, Royal Capital) / Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (Mountaintops of the Giants) / Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs (Consecrated Snowfield) 2% drop chance from Wolf-Headed, Greatsword-wielding Imps. One such Imp can be found almost immediately down the stairs after the Site of Grace in the Road's End Catacombs.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Road's End Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Minor Erdtree Catacombs & War-Dead Catacombs (Caelid) / Sainted Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau) / Wyndham Catacombs (Mt. Gelmir) / Auriza Side Tomb (Capital Outskirts) / Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Leyndell, Royal Capital) / Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (Mountaintops of the Giants) / Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs (Consecrated Snowfield) 2% drop chance from Wolf-Headed, Greatsword-wielding Imps. One such Imp can be found almost immediately down the stairs after the Site of Grace in the Road's End Catacombs.
entries.description: Oddly shaped greatsword wielded by imps. The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.

entries.name: Gargoyle's Blackblade
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Bestial Sanctum (Greyoll's Dragonbarrow) Dropped upon defeating the Black Blade Kindred outside of the Bestial Sanctum, along with the Gargoyle's Black Halberd.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Bestial Sanctum (Greyoll's Dragonbarrow) Dropped upon defeating the Black Blade Kindred outside of the Bestial Sanctum, along with the Gargoyle's Black Halberd.
entries.description: Bronze greatsword wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage. Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

entries.name: Gargoyle's Greatsword
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Siofra Aqueduct (Siofra River) Dropped by the Valiant Gargoyles duo boss, along with the Gargoyle's Twinblade.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Siofra Aqueduct (Siofra River) Dropped by the Valiant Gargoyles duo boss, along with the Gargoyle's Twinblade.
entries.description: Bronze greatsword wielded by Valiant Gargoyles. Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.

entries.name: Golden Order Greatsword
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Cave of the Forlorn (Consecrated Snowfield) Received upon defeating the Misbegotten Crusader at the end of the Cave of the Forlorn, located in the Consecrated Snowfield.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Cave of the Forlorn (Consecrated Snowfield) Received upon defeating the Misbegotten Crusader at the end of the Cave of the Forlorn, located in the Consecrated Snowfield.
passiveEffects: 20% Damage against Those Who Live in Death.
entries.description: Greatsword made of light, modeled after the Elden Ring itself. Forged by the King Consort Radagon to proudly symbolize the tenets of the Golden Order. One of the legendary armaments. Telltale signs betray that this was once the greatsword bequeathed to him by his first wife, Rennala.

entries.name: Greatsword of Damnation
entries.detailedLocation: Trade: Finger Reader Enia Trade the Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame, gained by defeating Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.acquisition: Trade: Finger Reader Enia Trade the Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame, gained by defeating Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.description: Golden greatsword that once pierced the body of Midra, master of the manse. Used by hornsent in the execution of a damnation like no other. The barbs that pierce the victim from within wind gently around the blade.

entries.name: Greatsword of Solitude
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Western Nameless Mausoleum (Gravesite Plain) Dropped by the Knight of the Solitary Gaol found inside of the Western Nameless Mausoleum.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Western Nameless Mausoleum (Gravesite Plain) Dropped by the Knight of the Solitary Gaol found inside of the Western Nameless Mausoleum.
entries.description: Steel greatsword wielded by the Knights of the Solitary Gaol. Through a secret rite, they relinquished their hearts for heightened battle prowess. Next, they engraved their blades with two crests: one depicting the light of birth, and the other, solitude.

entries.name: Helphen's Steeple
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Mountaintops of the Giants Dropped by a Tibia Mariner in the Mountaintops, overlooking Castle Sol and not far from the Snow Valley Ruins Overlook Site of Grace and where you fight the Mountaintops' Death Rite Bird.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Mountaintops of the Giants Dropped by a Tibia Mariner in the Mountaintops, overlooking Castle Sol and not far from the Snow Valley Ruins Overlook Site of Grace and where you fight the Mountaintops' Death Rite Bird.
entries.description: Greatsword patterned after the black steeple of the Helphen, the lampwood which guides the dead of the spirit world. The lamplight is similar to grace in appearance, only it is said that it can only be seen by those who met their death in battle.

entries.name: Inseparable Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Siofra Aqueduct (Siofra River) / Deeproot Depths Obtained after the death of D, Beholder of Death, meaning there are two ways to obtain this weapon. The first way is the regular one, which is slower and require that the questlines of both D's and also Fia, Deathbed Companion, is completed, whereafter it is found where Fia sat in Deeproot Depths. The second is to kill D, Hunter of the Dead (only possible during the first encounter with him, in Limgrave, and impossible thereafter) to obtain the Twinned Set from him and then give this armor to D, Beholder of Death in Siofra Aqueduct. This results in the second D becoming hostile at the spot where he was sitting after reloading the area, and killing him then awards the weapon (and the Twinned Set once more).
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Siofra Aqueduct (Siofra River) / Deeproot Depths Obtained after the death of D, Beholder of Death, meaning there are two ways to obtain this weapon. The first way is the regular one, which is slower and require that the questlines of both D's and also Fia, Deathbed Companion, is completed, whereafter it is found where Fia sat in Deeproot Depths. The second is to kill D, Hunter of the Dead (only possible during the first encounter with him, in Limgrave, and impossible thereafter) to obtain the Twinned Set from him and then give this armor to D, Beholder of Death in Siofra Aqueduct. This results in the second D becoming hostile at the spot where he was sitting after reloading the area, and killing him then awards the weapon (and the Twinned Set once more).
entries.description: Sword forged by compounding silver and gold. A sacred weapon to hunt Those Who Live in Death. Deals holy damage. The inseparable twins found solace in the Golden Order, the only institution not to revile them as accursed beings.

entries.name: Iron Greatsword
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Leyndell, Royal Capital / Miquella's Haligtree 4% drop chance from Misbegotten Warriors. 2 Warriors can be found among the Misbegotten southeast the East Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell, before the elevator to the Forbidden Lands. One is among a group of Misbegotten just before the elevator and the other is further down, reached by not taking the path up to the elevator and instead continuing on the ground path until its end. Another Warrior can be found on the route north of the Haligtree Town Placa Site of Grace in the Haligtree, praying at a statue. Keep in mind to be wary of the other nearby enemies and that this Warrior can be lured to fall of the bridge next to the Grace.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Leyndell, Royal Capital / Miquella's Haligtree 4% drop chance from Misbegotten Warriors. 2 Warriors can be found among the Misbegotten southeast the East Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell, before the elevator to the Forbidden Lands. One is among a group of Misbegotten just before the elevator and the other is further down, reached by not taking the path up to the elevator and instead continuing on the ground path until its end. Another Warrior can be found on the route north of the Haligtree Town Placa Site of Grace in the Haligtree, praying at a statue. Keep in mind to be wary of the other nearby enemies and that this Warrior can be lured to fall of the bridge next to the Grace.
entries.description: Greatsword with a blade of unusually thick steel. A coarse weapon to which polishing is a foreign concept. Weighty even among others of its class, the impact of each strike is sure to be felt.

entries.name: Knight's Greatsword
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Mt. Gelmir / Altus Plateau / Deeproot Depths / Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree 4% drop chance from various sword-wielding knight enemies: Godrick Knights, Cuckoo Knights, Leyndell Knights and Mausoleum Knights. 2 sword-wielding Godrick Knights can be found at the camp between the Warmaster's Shack and the Saintsbridge Site of Grace. A lone, sword-wielding Mausoleum Knight can be found just outside of the Black Knife Catacombs, with its back turned to the entrance.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Mt. Gelmir / Altus Plateau / Deeproot Depths / Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree 4% drop chance from various sword-wielding knight enemies: Godrick Knights, Cuckoo Knights, Leyndell Knights and Mausoleum Knights. 2 sword-wielding Godrick Knights can be found at the camp between the Warmaster's Shack and the Saintsbridge Site of Grace. A lone, sword-wielding Mausoleum Knight can be found just outside of the Black Knife Catacombs, with its back turned to the entrance.
entries.description: Greatsword bestowed upon skilled swordsmen in the demigods' service, and yet had no rank or title. Featuring a long grip enabling a dual-handed use, this weapon was designed to dispatch larger foes. Being charged with such a duty was undoubtedly a great honor.

entries.name: Lizard Greatsword
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Fog Rift Catacombs (Fog Rift Catacombs) / Scorpion River Catacombs (Rauh Base) 2% drop chance from Greatsword-wielding, Lion-Headed Imps found in .
entries.acquisition: Drop: Fog Rift Catacombs (Fog Rift Catacombs) / Scorpion River Catacombs (Rauh Base) 2% drop chance from Greatsword-wielding, Lion-Headed Imps found in .
entries.description: A peculiar weapon carried by Imps. Greatsword smithed in the shape of a fork-tongued lizard. Strong attacks allow the wielder to fire the forked tongue from the blade.

entries.name: Lordsworn's Greatsword
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Gatefront Ruins (Limgrave) Found in the chest on a carriage just southeast of the Gatefront Site of Grace.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Gatefront Ruins (Limgrave) Found in the chest on a carriage just southeast of the Gatefront Site of Grace.
entries.description: Well-crafted straight sword with an illustrious design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army. Though blackened and damaged by years of use, it appears to have otherwise been kept in a serviceable condition, despite the soldiers having long since lost their minds.

entries.name: Marais Executioner's Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: The Shaded Castle (Altus Plateau) Defeat Elemer of the Briar at the top of the castle.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: The Shaded Castle (Altus Plateau) Defeat Elemer of the Briar at the top of the castle.
entries.description: Storied sword of House Marais, the family of executioners who presided over the Shaded Castle. One of the legendary armaments. Elemer of the Briar, the Bell Bearing Hunter, snatched the sword from the site of his looming execution, and furnished it with battle skills from his home of Eochaid.

entries.name: Ordovis's Greatsword
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Auriza Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau) Ordovis's Greatsword is received upon defeating the Crucible Knight Ordovis and Crucible Knight duo boss at the bottom of the Auriza Hero's Grave.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Auriza Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau) Ordovis's Greatsword is received upon defeating the Crucible Knight Ordovis and Crucible Knight duo boss at the bottom of the Auriza Hero's Grave.

entries.name: Sacred Relic Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Elden Remembrance, gained by defeating the Elden Beast, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.acquisition: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Elden Remembrance, gained by defeating the Elden Beast, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.description: Sword wrought from the remains of a god who should have lived a life eternal. Thoughts on what the weapon portends are many and varied. Some consider it the mark of a great sin, or a sign of a great devastation. Some think it as the end of an age, while others; the beginning.

entries.name: Sword of Milos
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Capital Outskirts / Subterranean Shunning-Grounds Can be acquired in two different, mutually exclusive ways: Dropped by the Dung Eater when he invades in the southern end of the moat in Capital Outskirts, at the spot where Blackguard Big Boggart normally sits. Alternatively also dropped by the Dung Eater if he is killed in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds before the invasion, along with the Omen Set.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Capital Outskirts / Subterranean Shunning-Grounds Can be acquired in two different, mutually exclusive ways: Dropped by the Dung Eater when he invades in the southern end of the moat in Capital Outskirts, at the spot where Blackguard Big Boggart normally sits. Alternatively also dropped by the Dung Eater if he is killed in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds before the invasion, along with the Omen Set.

entries.name: Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword
entries.primaryLocation: Ruined Forge Starfall Past - Scadu Altus
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Ruined Forge Starfall Past (Scadu Altus) Obtained upon examining the altar of the dungeon. The altar is found on the second level of the dungeon. To reach it, you must pull the lever to make the iron door rise, and use it as a platform to jump across to the second level where the altar is.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Ruined Forge Starfall Past (Scadu Altus) Obtained upon examining the altar of the dungeon. The altar is found on the second level of the dungeon. To reach it, you must pull the lever to make the iron door rise, and use it as a platform to jump across to the second level where the altar is.
entries.description: One of the treasures of the ruined forges. Greatsword of ancient meteoric ore, ending in a sharp point. Fashioned from an excavated shard of an arrowhead that once was a part of the old gods' arsenal. A capable piercing weapon that excels at thrusting attacks.

entries.name: Fire Knight's Greatsword
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Shadow Keep, Church District / Specimen Storehouse (Shadow Keep) 4% drop chance from greatsword-wielding Fire Knights. One such knight can be found just before the elevator leading up to the Storehouse, First Floor Site of Grace. If the elevator is taken from the Grace the knight will start with its back turned, making it easier to defeat.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Shadow Keep, Church District / Specimen Storehouse (Shadow Keep) 4% drop chance from greatsword-wielding Fire Knights. One such knight can be found just before the elevator leading up to the Storehouse, First Floor Site of Grace. If the elevator is taken from the Grace the knight will start with its back turned, making it easier to defeat.
entries.description: Greatsword of the Fire Knights. A long, slender blade that undulates like fire. Blessed with a flame incantation. Further flame imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power.

entries.name: Godslayer's Greatsword
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Divine Tower of Caelid (Caelid) Found in a treasure chest at the end of the Divine Tower of Caelid, behind the Godskin Apostle boss.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Divine Tower of Caelid (Caelid) Found in a treasure chest at the end of the Divine Tower of Caelid, behind the Godskin Apostle boss.
entries.description: Sacred sword of the Gloam-Eyed Queen who controlled the Godskin Apostles before her defeat at the hands of Maliketh. The black flames wielded by the apostles are channeled from this sword.

entries.name: Grafted Blade Greatsword
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Castle Morne (Weeping Peninsula) Defeat the Leonine Misbegotten at the end of the castle.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Castle Morne (Weeping Peninsula) Defeat the Leonine Misbegotten at the end of the castle.
entries.description: The storied sword of Castle Morne. A revenger's weapon, it is burdened with oceans of anger and regret. One of the legendary armaments. A lone surviving champion from a country now vanished was so determined to continue fighting that he claimed the swords of an entire clan of warriors.

entries.name: Greatsword
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Caelid The found in a chest on the backside of a Carriage beside the road heading northwest from Caelem Ruins. The location is southwest of the Minor Erdtree in Caelid and the Minor Erdtree Catacombs.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Caelid The found in a chest on the backside of a Carriage beside the road heading northwest from Caelem Ruins. The location is southwest of the Minor Erdtree in Caelid and the Minor Erdtree Catacombs.
entries.description: A coarse iron lump of an ultra greatsword. Mows down foes by utilizing its incredible weight. Though handling it likely requires the wielder to have surpassed the realm of the merely human, it is precisely for this reason the weapon is used to slaughter even inhuman foes.

entries.name: Greatsword of Radahn (Light)
entries.detailedLocation: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of a God and a Lord, gained by defeating the Promised Consort Radahn, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the belled Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.acquisition: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of a God and a Lord, gained by defeating the Promised Consort Radahn, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the belled Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

entries.name: Greatsword of Radahn (Lord)
entries.detailedLocation: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of a God and a Lord, gained by defeating the Promised Consort Radahn, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the belled Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.acquisition: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of a God and a Lord, gained by defeating the Promised Consort Radahn, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the belled Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.description: Greatswords of black steel wielded by Radahn in his youth. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif. These were in his possession immediately before his triumph over the stars - the swords of a lord who does not rely on physical strength and gravity alone.

entries.name: Maliketh's Black Blade
entries.detailedLocation: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Black Blade, gained by defeating the Maliketh, the Black Blade, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.acquisition: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Black Blade, gained by defeating the Maliketh, the Black Blade, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.description: Maliketh's black blade which once harbored the power of the Rune of Death. A sad shadow of its former glory. After a fragment of Death was stolen on that fateful night, Maliketh bound the blade within his own flesh, such that none might ever rob Death again.

entries.name: Moonrithyll's Knight Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Castle Ensis Moonrithyll's Knight Sword can be obtained after defeating the NPC Moonrithyll, Carian Knight. She's found outside of the chapel halfway on the path between the Castle Ensis Checkpoint and Castle-Lord's Chamber Sites of Grace.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Castle Ensis Moonrithyll's Knight Sword can be obtained after defeating the NPC Moonrithyll, Carian Knight. She's found outside of the chapel halfway on the path between the Castle Ensis Checkpoint and Castle-Lord's Chamber Sites of Grace.
entries.description: Greatsword embedded with a blue glintstone. The favored weapon of the steadfast Carian knight, Moonrithyll. Moonrithyll was the Twin Moon Knight's chamberlain. She was also a friend to the trolls, who served the royal family, and proudly wielded their weapons as she fought arm in arm with her gargantuan comrades.

entries.name: Royal Greatsword
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Ranni's Rise (Three Sisters) Dropped by Blaidd, along with his armor set (except the Black Wolf Mask), when encountered at Ranni's Rise after Ranni the Witch's storyline has been completed. Killing him prior to this will award no items.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Ranni's Rise (Three Sisters) Dropped by Blaidd, along with his armor set (except the Black Wolf Mask), when encountered at Ranni's Rise after Ranni the Witch's storyline has been completed. Killing him prior to this will award no items.
entries.description: Greatsword decorated in royal Carian Style. Favored weapon of Blaidd the Half-Wolf. In defiance of the fate he was born to, Blaidd swore to serve no master but Ranni. As proof. the sword was imbued with a cold magic at the moment oath was sworn.

entries.name: Ruins Greatsword
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Redmane Castle (Caelid) Obtained upon defeating the optional Misbegotten Warrior and Crucible Knight duo boss at the Redmane Castle plaza. Do note that this fight is only available whenever the Radahn festival isn't active. If it's currently active it can be deactivated by defeating Starscourge Radahn and talking to Castellan Jerren once more in the chapel just before the lift down to Radahn and then reloading the area, preferably by teleporting to the Chamber Outside the Plaza Site of Grace.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Redmane Castle (Caelid) Obtained upon defeating the optional Misbegotten Warrior and Crucible Knight duo boss at the Redmane Castle plaza. Do note that this fight is only available whenever the Radahn festival isn't active. If it's currently active it can be deactivated by defeating Starscourge Radahn and talking to Castellan Jerren once more in the chapel just before the lift down to Radahn and then reloading the area, preferably by teleporting to the Chamber Outside the Plaza Site of Grace.
entries.description: Originally rubble from a ruin which fell from the sky, this surviving fragment was honed into a weapon. One of the legendary armaments. The ruin it came from crumbled when struck by a meteorite, as such this weapon harbors its destructive power.

entries.name: Starscourge Greatsword
entries.detailedLocation: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Starscourge, gained by defeating the Starscourge Radahn, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the belled Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.acquisition: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Starscourge, gained by defeating the Starscourge Radahn, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the belled Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.description: Curved greatswords of black steel wielded by General Radahn. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif. Radahn earned considerable renown as the Starscourge in his youth, and it is said that it was during this time he engraved the gravity crest upon these blades.

entries.name: Troll Knight's Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Caria Manor (Liurnia of the Lakes) Guaranteed drop from the Troll Knight in Carian Manor, just before Royal Knight Loretta, the first time it's killed. Drop: Caria Manor / Converted Fringe Tower / The Four Belfries (Liurnia of the Lakes) 4% drop chance from all Troll Knights. The one in Caria Manor is most easily farmed, in addition to its guaranteed first-time drop of the sword, by starting at the Royal Moongazing Grounds Site of Grace and heading back into the Manor. The spectral Troll Knights at the Four Belfries are also farmable, by starting at either the top or the bottom of the hill.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Caria Manor (Liurnia of the Lakes) Guaranteed drop from the Troll Knight in Carian Manor, just before Royal Knight Loretta, the first time it's killed. Drop: Caria Manor / Converted Fringe Tower / The Four Belfries (Liurnia of the Lakes) 4% drop chance from all Troll Knights. The one in Caria Manor is most easily farmed, in addition to its guaranteed first-time drop of the sword, by starting at the Royal Moongazing Grounds Site of Grace and heading back into the Manor. The spectral Troll Knights at the Four Belfries are also farmable, by starting at either the top or the bottom of the hill.
entries.description: Greatsword embedded with a blue glintstone. Weapon of the trolls in service to the royal family of Caria. Called into service when the Queen invoked an oath they swore, the trolls are treated as true knights of Caria, and fight arm in arm with their human comrades.

entries.name: Troll's Golden Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Altus Plateau Found in a chest in the back of a Carriage in a Leyndell Soldier camp in-between the Erdtree-Gazing Hill and Altus Highway Junction Sites of Graces.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Altus Plateau Found in a chest in the back of a Carriage in a Leyndell Soldier camp in-between the Erdtree-Gazing Hill and Altus Highway Junction Sites of Graces.
entries.description: Sword given to the lesser giants who fought for the Erdtree during the War against the Giants long ago. Though the giants have lost their minds, they stay inseparable from their swords that are in sad shape—such that the gold plating had flaked away.

entries.name: Watchdog's Greatsword
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (Mountaintops of the Giants) / Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs (Mountaintops of the Giants) / Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs (Consecrated Snowfield) 8% drop chance from the non-boss variant of Erdtree Burial Watchdog. Most easily farmed in the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, by heading out the southwestern exit from the Site of Grace and then jumping out one of the windows to the right. After killing the two shaded Imps next to the Erdtree seal the Watchdog can be easily lured over to de-shade it and then be killed.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (Mountaintops of the Giants) / Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs (Mountaintops of the Giants) / Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs (Consecrated Snowfield) 8% drop chance from the non-boss variant of Erdtree Burial Watchdog. Most easily farmed in the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, by heading out the southwestern exit from the Site of Grace and then jumping out one of the windows to the right. After killing the two shaded Imps next to the Erdtree seal the Watchdog can be easily lured over to de-shade it and then be killed.
entries.description: Stone greatsword wielded by Erdtree Burial Watchdogs. Though decorated with the watchman's eye, the pupil was taken by graverobbers and is now hollow, leaving this sword a mere lump of stone.

entries.name: Zweihander
entries.detailedLocation: Purchase: Weeping Peninsula One is sold for 3,500 runes Runes by the Isolated Merchant at the Isolated Merchant's Shack at the westernmost point of the Peninsula.
entries.acquisition: Purchase: Weeping Peninsula One is sold for 3,500 runes Runes by the Isolated Merchant at the Isolated Merchant's Shack at the westernmost point of the Peninsula.
entries.description: Just about the largest sword a mere man is capable of swinging. True to its name, it is designed to be wielded in both hands, but those of merely ordinary strength will still struggle to do so. The long blade is heavy and sharp, sending foes reeling back with its broader strokes, while also capable of a devastating piercing thrust.

entries.name: Antspur Rapier
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: The Shaded Castle (Altus Plateau) Dropped by Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan, found just to the west of The Shaded Castle, together with a Guardian Golem.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: The Shaded Castle (Altus Plateau) Dropped by Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan, found just to the west of The Shaded Castle, together with a Guardian Golem.
