entries.description: Spur of a giant ant which has been fashioned into a rapier. The blade drips with scarlet rot. Scarlet rot is an old legend, of which Maleigh Marais of the Shaded Castle was a private believer. And indeed, he eventually found his own personal goddess.

entries.name: Carian Sorcery Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Castle Ensis (Gravesite Plain) This item can be found in a chest in northern Castle Ensis after dropping down from Scadu Altus. Starting from the Highroad Cross Site of Grace, head southwest into the river and jump of the southern edge of the western riverbank to get to a freestanding castle-section with the chest on its top.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Castle Ensis (Gravesite Plain) This item can be found in a chest in northern Castle Ensis after dropping down from Scadu Altus. Starting from the Highroad Cross Site of Grace, head southwest into the river and jump of the southern edge of the western riverbank to get to a freestanding castle-section with the chest on its top.
passiveEffects: Becomes a catalyst for Glintstone Sorceries upon using Strong attacks.
entries.description: One of the Carian royal family's glintstone swords. A small piercing sword with a slender blade. Formerly used by the Carian knights of old before the full refinement of their sorcerous combat techniques, this armament functions as a catalyst for glintstone sorcery when executing strong attacks.

entries.name: Cleanrot Knight's Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Caelid / The Shaded Castle (Altus Plateau) / Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs (Consecrated Snowfield) / Miquella's Haligtree All Cleanrot Knights have a 4% drop chance for this weapon. The Swamp of Aeonia in Caelid is quite notably littered with Cleanrot Knights who will rise up when approached. Starting from the Castellan's Hall Site of Grace in The Shaded Castle and then heading back down the elevator into the castle leads to three separate Cleanrot Knights: one at the bottom of the elevator, another just to the left, and a third at the end of the walkway to the right. A lone Cleanrot Knight can be found standing just outside of the Prayer Room Site of Grace in Miquella's Haligtree.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Caelid / The Shaded Castle (Altus Plateau) / Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs (Consecrated Snowfield) / Miquella's Haligtree All Cleanrot Knights have a 4% drop chance for this weapon. The Swamp of Aeonia in Caelid is quite notably littered with Cleanrot Knights who will rise up when approached. Starting from the Castellan's Hall Site of Grace in The Shaded Castle and then heading back down the elevator into the castle leads to three separate Cleanrot Knights: one at the bottom of the elevator, another just to the left, and a third at the end of the walkway to the right. A lone Cleanrot Knight can be found standing just outside of the Prayer Room Site of Grace in Miquella's Haligtree.
entries.description: Piercing sword of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Mainly used as a backup weapon, in combination with a long-handled armament.

entries.name: Estoc
entries.detailedLocation: Starting equipment: The Prisoner origin starts with an Estoc. Purchase: Murkwater Cave (Limgrave) / Liurnia of the Lakes / Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir) One is sold for runes 3,000 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant in southern Liurnia of the Lakes, next to the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace. One is sold for runes 3,000 Runes by Patches whenever his shop is available, in Murkwater Cave, at the Scenic Isle Site of Grace, and in Volcano Manor.
entries.acquisition: Starting equipment: The Prisoner origin starts with an Estoc. Purchase: Murkwater Cave (Limgrave) / Liurnia of the Lakes / Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir) One is sold for runes 3,000 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant in southern Liurnia of the Lakes, next to the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace. One is sold for runes 3,000 Runes by Patches whenever his shop is available, in Murkwater Cave, at the Scenic Isle Site of Grace, and in Volcano Manor.
entries.description: Large piercing sword with a long, hard bladed edge which is also capable of slashing attacks. For its large size, it can be wielded rather nimbly, leaving little opportunity for the enemy to counter.

entries.name: Frozen Needle
entries.primaryLocation: Kingsrealm Ruins - Liurnia of the Lakes
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Kingsrealm Ruins (Liurnia of the Lakes) Found inside a chest after beating the Royal Revenant boss inside the Kingsrealm Ruins.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Kingsrealm Ruins (Liurnia of the Lakes) Found inside a chest after beating the Royal Revenant boss inside the Kingsrealm Ruins.
entries.description: A razor-thin piercing blade of ice. Forged by Iji, the Carian Royal Blacksmith. Can inflict frost upon enemies, and launch its blade with a strong attack. The blade immediately regenerates.

entries.name: Noble's Estoc
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Mountaintops of the Giants / Consecrated Snowfield Low (0.5%) drop chance from those Wandering Noble enemies that wield it, specifically the ones wearing the Aristocrat Hat and Aristocrat Coat. There are two immediately to the north of the Mistwood Outskirts Site of Grace in eastern Limgrave, following a torch bearer.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Mountaintops of the Giants / Consecrated Snowfield Low (0.5%) drop chance from those Wandering Noble enemies that wield it, specifically the ones wearing the Aristocrat Hat and Aristocrat Coat. There are two immediately to the north of the Mistwood Outskirts Site of Grace in eastern Limgrave, following a torch bearer.
entries.description: Estoc carried by wandering nobles. Made to be easy to wield. Daubed with gold from tip to tail, it should fetch a good sum.

entries.name: Rapier
entries.detailedLocation: Purchase: Roundtable Hold One is sold for runes 1,000 Runes by the Twin Maiden Husks.
entries.acquisition: Purchase: Roundtable Hold One is sold for runes 1,000 Runes by the Twin Maiden Husks.
entries.description: A piercing sword with a sharp, slender blade. In addition to this weapon's thrusting attack prowess, it also boasts the ability to be used while guarding with a shield. As one of the smaller piercing swords, quick successive thrusts are easy to perform, but without a cutting edge, it cannot be used for slashing attacks.

entries.name: Rogier's Rapier
entries.detailedLocation: Quest reward: Roundtable Hold Given at +8 by Sorcerer Rogier after defeating Godrick the Grafted. It comes with Ash of War: Glintblade Phalanx pre-equipped on acquisition; however, its underlying base skill is Repeating Thrust.
entries.acquisition: Quest reward: Roundtable Hold Given at +8 by Sorcerer Rogier after defeating Godrick the Grafted. It comes with Ash of War: Glintblade Phalanx pre-equipped on acquisition; however, its underlying base skill is Repeating Thrust.
entries.description: Piercing sword of superior quality, featuring intricate ornamentation. Signature weapon of the sorcerer Rogier. High dexterity is required to wield the blade to its full potential, but mastery is a sight to behold, characterized by a flowing style which excels in successive attacks.

entries.name: Bloody Helice
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Writheblood Ruins (Altus Plateau) Found in the cellar of the Writheblood Ruins, in a chest behind the Sanguine Noble boss. The Ruins are found just north of the Second Church of Marika.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Writheblood Ruins (Altus Plateau) Found in the cellar of the Writheblood Ruins, in a chest behind the Sanguine Noble boss. The Ruins are found just north of the Second Church of Marika.
entries.description: Ominous piercing sword with a winding blade. Carried by the noble servants of the Lord of Blood. Designed to bore into flesh, causing severe blood loss at the wound. The extracted blood trickles gracefully down the length of the blade.

entries.name: Dragon King's Cragblade
entries.detailedLocation: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Dragonlord, gained by defeating Dragonlord Placidusax, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.acquisition: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Dragonlord, gained by defeating Dragonlord Placidusax, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
passiveEffects: Deals increased damage to Dragons and Ancient Dragons}}.
entries.description: Piercing Gravel Stone sword containing primeval lightning. A portion of the Dragonlord's power, gained from a remembrance. This weapon commands great power over the paltry, mortal dragons of today.

entries.name: Godskin Stitcher
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir) Received upon defeating the Godskin Noble boss found in Volcano Manor.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir) Received upon defeating the Godskin Noble boss found in Volcano Manor.
entries.description: Elegant piercing sword with a celadon colored blade wielded by Godskin Nobles. The nobles possess skill with the sword unmatched by any lowborn. Despite its size, successive attacks from this weapon are swifter than the eye can follow.

entries.name: Great Épée
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Limgrave Acquired from a treasure chest by a tent in a Campsite by some Fallen Ruins east of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace. It is guarded by two Kaiden Mercenaries and a particularly eagle-eyed Noble Sorcerer. ER Item Location Great Épée.png|Item acquired ER Item Location Great Épée Map.png|Location on map.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Limgrave Acquired from a treasure chest by a tent in a Campsite by some Fallen Ruins east of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace. It is guarded by two Kaiden Mercenaries and a particularly eagle-eyed Noble Sorcerer. ER Item Location Great Épée.png|Item acquired ER Item Location Great Épée Map.png|Location on map.

entries.name: Queelign's Greatsword
entries.detailedLocation: Quest reward: Shadow Keep, Church District This weapon can be obtained in the Shadow Keep after giving Fire Knight Queelign the Iris of Occultation. That makes this weapon mutually exclusive with the Fire Knight Queelign Spirit Ash, requiring a second Journey to get both on the same character.
entries.acquisition: Quest reward: Shadow Keep, Church District This weapon can be obtained in the Shadow Keep after giving Fire Knight Queelign the Iris of Occultation. That makes this weapon mutually exclusive with the Fire Knight Queelign Spirit Ash, requiring a second Journey to get both on the same character.
entries.description: Greatsword of the Fire Knight Queelign. A weighty piercing sword with a blade that undulates like fire. Queelign devoted his all to the crusade, and remade his sword in the shape of the lance wielded by his liege—aspiring to become a second impaler.

entries.name: Sword Lance
entries.detailedLocation: Trade: Finger Reader Enia Can be obtained after trading Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method). Comes pre-equipped with the Ash of War: Spinning Gravity Thrust and Standard Affinity on it.
entries.acquisition: Trade: Finger Reader Enia Can be obtained after trading Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method). Comes pre-equipped with the Ash of War: Spinning Gravity Thrust and Standard Affinity on it.
entries.description: Weapon once wielded by Commander Gaius. A combination of greatsword and lance. Weighty and capable of being brought to bear with great force, this armament shows its true potential when used astride a mount. Gaius himself was never without his boar.

entries.name: Bandit's Curved Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Tombsward Ruins (Weeping Peninsula) / Church of the Plague (Caelid) / Sage's Cave (Altus Plateau) / Wyndham Ruins (Altus Plateau) / Capital Outskirts / Crumbling Farum Azula / Cerulean Coast / Charo's Hidden Grave 3% drop chance from the armored "Bandit" Skeletons and Bestial Skeletons that dual-wield this weapon (technically the drop chance is 1.5% twice per enemy, making it possible for it to drop two Swords from one enemy). One such Skeleton can be found just outside the Church of Pilgrimage at the northern tip of the Weeping Peninsula, in the graveyard. Another can be found just east of the Hermit Merchant's Shack in Capital Outskirts, alongside a Skeleton Knight.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Tombsward Ruins (Weeping Peninsula) / Church of the Plague (Caelid) / Sage's Cave (Altus Plateau) / Wyndham Ruins (Altus Plateau) / Capital Outskirts / Crumbling Farum Azula / Cerulean Coast / Charo's Hidden Grave 3% drop chance from the armored "Bandit" Skeletons and Bestial Skeletons that dual-wield this weapon (technically the drop chance is 1.5% twice per enemy, making it possible for it to drop two Swords from one enemy). One such Skeleton can be found just outside the Church of Pilgrimage at the northern tip of the Weeping Peninsula, in the graveyard. Another can be found just east of the Hermit Merchant's Shack in Capital Outskirts, alongside a Skeleton Knight.
entries.description: Curved sword with a light, crescent-shaped blade. Used by the bandits who ran rampant in the wake of the Shattering. Most of the blade is now darkened and covered in rust, but with enough dexterity this weapon may still stand up to some use.

entries.name: Beastman's Curved Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Crumbling Farum Azula 2% drop chance from the Curved Sword-wielding Azula Beastmen enemies, also including the variants with red lightning and with shields. 7 of them can be found just east of/before the Crumbling Beast Grave Site of Grace, 2 in the first room and 5 in the second.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Crumbling Farum Azula 2% drop chance from the Curved Sword-wielding Azula Beastmen enemies, also including the variants with red lightning and with shields. 7 of them can be found just east of/before the Crumbling Beast Grave Site of Grace, 2 in the first room and 5 in the second.
entries.description: Curved sword forged of dull iron wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula. The blade is heavy but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers.

entries.name: Dancing Blade of Ranah
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Southern Nameless Mausoleum (Cerulean Coast) Dropped by the Dancer of Ranah, found inside of the Southern Nameless Mausoleum.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Southern Nameless Mausoleum (Cerulean Coast) Dropped by the Dancer of Ranah, found inside of the Southern Nameless Mausoleum.
entries.description: Decorative swords ablaze with impassioned red. A pair of weapons made to be wielded in both hands. Used by the dancers of Ranah. Strike enemies with a dancing assault when executing a strong attack.

entries.name: Eclipse Shotel
entries.primaryLocation: Castle Sol - Mountaintops of the Giants
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants) The Eclipse Shotel is in front of the altar inside the Church of the Eclipse.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants) The Eclipse Shotel is in front of the altar inside the Church of the Eclipse.
entries.description: Storied sword and treasure of Castle Sol that depicts an eclipsed sun drained of color. One of the legendary armaments. In Sol, the sight of an eclipse inspires a dreadful awe, preventing an onlooker from averting his gaze.

entries.name: Falchion
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Limgrave / Coastal Cave (Limgrave) / Demi-Human Forest Ruins (Weeping Peninsula) / Lakeside Crystal Cave (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Lux Ruins (Altus Plateau) / Volcano Cave (Mt. Gelmir) / Mountaintops of the Giants / Cerulean Coast 2% drop chance from Demi-Humans wielding falchions, including both shield-wielding and shield-less variants. 6 of the 9 Demi-Humans in the group just northeast of the Mistwood Outskirts Site of Grace in eastern Limgrave wield this weapon, making that group very viable for farming. 2 Falchion-wielders in a group of 4 Demi-Humans can also be found just outside of Coastal Cave.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Limgrave / Coastal Cave (Limgrave) / Demi-Human Forest Ruins (Weeping Peninsula) / Lakeside Crystal Cave (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Lux Ruins (Altus Plateau) / Volcano Cave (Mt. Gelmir) / Mountaintops of the Giants / Cerulean Coast 2% drop chance from Demi-Humans wielding falchions, including both shield-wielding and shield-less variants. 6 of the 9 Demi-Humans in the group just northeast of the Mistwood Outskirts Site of Grace in eastern Limgrave wield this weapon, making that group very viable for farming. 2 Falchion-wielders in a group of 4 Demi-Humans can also be found just outside of Coastal Cave.
entries.description: A curved sword with a single-sided blade. Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against thick armor and hides covered in tough scales. Wielders of the weapon employ a unique style that enhances attacks with spinning motions.

entries.name: Falx
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Shadow Keep / Ancient Ruins of Rauh / Enir-Ilim The Falx is a guaranteed drop depending on how the player interacts with Hornsent after Miquella's Great Rune breaks. If the player summons Hornsent to help defeat Messmer the Impaler, he will invade as a hostile NPC near the Rauh Ancient Ruins Site of Grace. He will drop the Falx upon his defeat. If the player sides with Needle Knight Leda in invading Hornsent, he will drop his weapon upon his defeat. If the Hornsent is left alive and assists Needle Knight Leda during her boss fight, the Falx will be found on his corpse after the player wins the fight.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Shadow Keep / Ancient Ruins of Rauh / Enir-Ilim The Falx is a guaranteed drop depending on how the player interacts with Hornsent after Miquella's Great Rune breaks. If the player summons Hornsent to help defeat Messmer the Impaler, he will invade as a hostile NPC near the Rauh Ancient Ruins Site of Grace. He will drop the Falx upon his defeat. If the player sides with Needle Knight Leda in invading Hornsent, he will drop his weapon upon his defeat. If the Hornsent is left alive and assists Needle Knight Leda during her boss fight, the Falx will be found on his corpse after the player wins the fight.
entries.description: Curved swords with long sickle-like blades. A pair of weapons made to be wielded in both hands Forged by a hornsent in the name of revenge. "In vengeance for the flames, my blade I wield...".

entries.name: Flowing Curved Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Consecrated Snowfield Found in a chest in the back of a Great Coffin in the middle of the Consecrated Snowfield, starting just southwest of the Inner Consecrated Snowfield Site of Grace. At night the Coffin is guarded by two Night's Cavalry, making approaching it during daytime a much better idea.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Consecrated Snowfield Found in a chest in the back of a Great Coffin in the middle of the Consecrated Snowfield, starting just southwest of the Inner Consecrated Snowfield Site of Grace. At night the Coffin is guarded by two Night's Cavalry, making approaching it during daytime a much better idea.
entries.description: Legends speak of a master of the sword garbed in blue, and his curved blade that was patterned after flowing water. Strong attack unleashes a series of strikes akin to a dance, offering a glimpse into the legend.

entries.name: Grossmesser
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Tombsward Catacombs (Weeping Peninsula) / Black Knife Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Caelid Catacombs (Caelid) / Auriza Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau) / Gelmir Hero's Grave (Mt. Gelmir) / Stone Coffin Fissure 2% drop chance from the Skeleton enemies that wield it. They will solely be armed with the Grossmesser. One Skeleton wielding the weapon can be found immediately down past the Site of Grace in the Tombsward Catacombs, behind the fog wall with the Imp Statue unlocked by a Stonesword Key. There are more inside the catacombs.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Tombsward Catacombs (Weeping Peninsula) / Black Knife Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Caelid Catacombs (Caelid) / Auriza Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau) / Gelmir Hero's Grave (Mt. Gelmir) / Stone Coffin Fissure 2% drop chance from the Skeleton enemies that wield it. They will solely be armed with the Grossmesser. One Skeleton wielding the weapon can be found immediately down past the Site of Grace in the Tombsward Catacombs, behind the fog wall with the Imp Statue unlocked by a Stonesword Key. There are more inside the catacombs.
entries.description: Curved sword boasting a large blade. This weapon is designed to make use of its weight in combination with its sharp cutting edge. A thoroughly reliable choice of weapon for those who can master its particulars.

entries.name: Horned Warrior's Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Belurat, Tower Settlement / Rauh Base / Midra's Manse / Ancient Ruins of Rauh 4% drop rate from dual-wielding Horned Warriors. One can be found in the Belurat Tower Settlement Swamp. An easy one to farm is located just up the stairs from the Small Private Altar Site of Grace in Belurat, Tower Settlement. Another is located just by the Ravine North Site of Grace in Rauh Base.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Belurat, Tower Settlement / Rauh Base / Midra's Manse / Ancient Ruins of Rauh 4% drop rate from dual-wielding Horned Warriors. One can be found in the Belurat Tower Settlement Swamp. An easy one to farm is located just up the stairs from the Small Private Altar Site of Grace in Belurat, Tower Settlement. Another is located just by the Ravine North Site of Grace in Rauh Base.
entries.description: Curved sword of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower. The ornamental tangled horns allow the blade to serve as a medium for horn-calling.

entries.name: Magma Blade
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Volcano Manor 1% drop chance from the Man-Serpents wielding flaming swords. There are two Man-Serpents that drop this weapon, both of which can be found on the same path: from the Temple of Eiglay Site of Grace, head up the elevator back into the Manor and the first Magma Blade-wielding Man-Serpent can be found on the bridge out of the tower, followed by the second one on the walkway after the second tower.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Volcano Manor 1% drop chance from the Man-Serpents wielding flaming swords. There are two Man-Serpents that drop this weapon, both of which can be found on the same path: from the Temple of Eiglay Site of Grace, head up the elevator back into the Manor and the first Magma Blade-wielding Man-Serpent can be found on the bridge out of the tower, followed by the second one on the walkway after the second tower.
entries.description: Curved sword with a blade fashioned from the lava of Mt. Gelmir. An armament of the man-serpents, impossible for a human to have made. Deals fire damage.

entries.name: Mantis Blade
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Gelmir Hero's Grave (Mt. Gelmir) Dropped by a Cemetery Shade found in a nook in Gelmir Hero's Grave, just before the final stretch of lava leading to the room with the Boss. Only dropped the first time it's killed. As the Chariot moves on this path, it will follow the Tarnished down and can kill either them or the Shade, making a vigilant eye on both the enemy and the Hero Grave's path a good idea.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Gelmir Hero's Grave (Mt. Gelmir) Dropped by a Cemetery Shade found in a nook in Gelmir Hero's Grave, just before the final stretch of lava leading to the room with the Boss. Only dropped the first time it's killed. As the Chariot moves on this path, it will follow the Tarnished down and can kill either them or the Shade, making a vigilant eye on both the enemy and the Hero Grave's path a good idea.
entries.description: A curved sword with a blade at both ends wielded by the Cemetery Shades, the insect-ridden grave keepers. The blade is thin and sharp, and strong attack unleashes a far-reaching slash.

entries.name: Nox Flowing Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Sellia, Town of Sorcery (Caelid) Received upon defeating the Nox Swordstress & Nox Monk duo boss in Sellia, Town of Sorcery, just east of the Swamp of Aeonia in Caelid. Accessing the duo requires lighting the three braziers in the town to remove a seal.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Sellia, Town of Sorcery (Caelid) Received upon defeating the Nox Swordstress & Nox Monk duo boss in Sellia, Town of Sorcery, just east of the Swamp of Aeonia in Caelid. Accessing the duo requires lighting the three braziers in the town to remove a seal.
entries.description: A grim weapon wielded by swordsmen of the Eternal City, this shotel has a blade as fine as a needle. Forged from the liquid metal of a Silver Tear, it is thoroughly tempered until hardened.

entries.name: Scavenger's Curved Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Mt. Gelmir After the stone bridge a bit west of the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite Site of Grace, the sword can be found on a corpse in a wagon next to the ladder leading upwards, right next to where the Grafted Scion lands.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Mt. Gelmir After the stone bridge a bit west of the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite Site of Grace, the sword can be found on a corpse in a wagon next to the ladder leading upwards, right next to where the Grafted Scion lands.
entries.description: Unique curved sword, notched like shark's teeth. Weapon carried by corpse pillagers who prowl the sites of old battles. The blade is tacky with blood and covered in hefty nicks, making it totally uneven. Life can be sinister indeed.

entries.name: Scimitar
entries.detailedLocation: Starting Equipment: 2 are part of the starting equipment for the Warrior Origin. Purchase: Roundtable Hold 1 is sold for runes 600 Runes by the Twin Maiden Husks. Drop: Deathtouched Catacombs (Limgrave) / Tombsward Catacombs (Weeping Peninsula) / Black Knife Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Auriza Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau) / Gelmir Hero's Grave (Mt. Gelmir) / Stone Coffin Fissure 2% drop chance from Scimitar-and-Shield-wielding Skeletons, one-armed Scimitar-wielding Skeletons, and Fire Pot-throwing Skeletons. Though the Scimitar-and-Shield Skeletons look to be wielding Iron Roundshields, they actually drop Scripture Wooden Shield. Also, some one-armed Skeletons wield a Grossmesser instead of a Scimitar. Deathtouched Catacombs is an easy place to farm for these, as all enemies except for the Archer Skeletons can drop it.
entries.acquisition: Starting Equipment: 2 are part of the starting equipment for the Warrior Origin. Purchase: Roundtable Hold 1 is sold for runes 600 Runes by the Twin Maiden Husks. Drop: Deathtouched Catacombs (Limgrave) / Tombsward Catacombs (Weeping Peninsula) / Black Knife Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Auriza Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau) / Gelmir Hero's Grave (Mt. Gelmir) / Stone Coffin Fissure 2% drop chance from Scimitar-and-Shield-wielding Skeletons, one-armed Scimitar-wielding Skeletons, and Fire Pot-throwing Skeletons. Though the Scimitar-and-Shield Skeletons look to be wielding Iron Roundshields, they actually drop Scripture Wooden Shield. Also, some one-armed Skeletons wield a Grossmesser instead of a Scimitar. Deathtouched Catacombs is an easy place to farm for these, as all enemies except for the Archer Skeletons can drop it.
entries.description: A curved sword with a single-sided blade. Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against armor and hides covered in tough scales. Smaller in size than most curved swords, it carves into enemies with quick, sharp cuts.

entries.name: Serpent-God's Curved Sword
entries.primaryLocation: Ruin-Strewn Precipice - Liurnia of the Lakes
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Ruin-Strewn Precipice (Liurnia of the Lakes) Found near a giant Land Octopus on an overhang reached by a ladder to the side just before reaching the ladder to the Ruin-Strewn Precipice Overlook Site of Grace. More specifically, on the same floor-level where the final ladder to the Site of Grace is, further to the right is another ladder leading to a sloped rooftop with the giant Land Octopus and a few smaller ones, right next to a corpse with the item.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Ruin-Strewn Precipice (Liurnia of the Lakes) Found near a giant Land Octopus on an overhang reached by a ladder to the side just before reaching the ladder to the Ruin-Strewn Precipice Overlook Site of Grace. More specifically, on the same floor-level where the final ladder to the Site of Grace is, further to the right is another ladder leading to a sloped rooftop with the giant Land Octopus and a few smaller ones, right next to a corpse with the item.
entries.description: Curved sword fashioned in the image of an ancient serpent deity and tool of a forgotten religion practiced on Mt. Gelmir. Formerly used to offer up sacrifices, this sword restores HP upon slaying an enemy.

entries.name: Shamshir
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Highroad Cave (Limgrave) Found on a corpse on the biggest pillar in the body of water inside of Highroad Cave, guarded by two Giant Bats.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Highroad Cave (Limgrave) Found on a corpse on the biggest pillar in the body of water inside of Highroad Cave, guarded by two Giant Bats.
entries.description: Curved sword with a thin blade of ample length. Light of weight despite its larger size, its slicing attacks come in rapid succession. A devastating powerful weapon in the hands of a skilled swordsman.

entries.name: Shotel
entries.detailedLocation: Purchase: Siofra River 1 is sold for runes 2500 Runes by the Abandoned Merchant in lower Siofra River. The Merchant is atop a structure west of the Worshippers' Woods Site of Grace.
entries.acquisition: Purchase: Siofra River 1 is sold for runes 2500 Runes by the Abandoned Merchant in lower Siofra River. The Merchant is atop a structure west of the Worshippers' Woods Site of Grace.
passiveEffects: Attacks pierce enemy guard with reduced damage.
entries.description: Curved sword with a severely hooked blade. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard. Made to hunt down humans, this weapon requires high dexterity to wield effectively.

entries.name: Spirit Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Cerulean Coast This weapon can be found in a triangular ravine behind the stranded coffin boat just northeast of the Cerulean Coast West Site of Grace. It's in the far right corner, near some gravestones and Demi-Humans.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Cerulean Coast This weapon can be found in a triangular ravine behind the stranded coffin boat just northeast of the Cerulean Coast West Site of Grace. It's in the far right corner, near some gravestones and Demi-Humans.
entries.description: Sharp blade sculpted into a twisted shape. A sword that has seen many years of use in the gravesite. Said to serve as a medium for communion with spirits.

entries.name: Wing of Astel
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Uhl Palace Ruins Found inside a chest in Uhl Palace Ruins above a Withered Astel, located in Ainsel River and only reachable from Ainsel River Main. More specifically, start from Ainsel River Main Site of Grace and head down the tunnel. Take the left split in the road, guarded by a Hardhead Giant Ant, and follow the cliffside path to a stone structure with the chest.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Uhl Palace Ruins Found inside a chest in Uhl Palace Ruins above a Withered Astel, located in Ainsel River and only reachable from Ainsel River Main. More specifically, start from Ainsel River Main Site of Grace and head down the tunnel. Take the left split in the road, guarded by a Hardhead Giant Ant, and follow the cliffside path to a stone structure with the chest.
entries.description: Sword fashioned from a delicate wing, suffused with the magic of the stars. Strong attack unleashes a wave of enchanted light. Crafted from a relic of the Naturalborn of the Void who is said to have assailed the Eternal City.

entries.name: Beastman's Cleaver
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: The Four Belfries (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Crumbling Farum Azula 2% drop chance from Cleaver-wielding Beastmen. It can be found at the earliest by taking the "Crumbling Lands" Waygate at The Four Belfries, alongside a throwing knife-wielding one. These will be scaled for Farum Azula rather than Liurnia, so they are considerably tougher than any other regular enemy at that point of the game and the mix of range and melee make them quite difficult to take on. In Farum Azula, taking the elevator next to the Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace back down leads to a walking cleaver-wielder with its back turned, though it is the stronger. Another two can be found by taking the lift down beside the Dragon Temple Lift Site of Grace exiting out the room to the right, with the first being down the stairs straight ahead and the second being reached by walking up a floating pillar to the right (though the second one is also guardd by a sword-wielding Beastman at the pillar and a Stray behind a wall near its position).
entries.acquisition: Drop: The Four Belfries (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Crumbling Farum Azula 2% drop chance from Cleaver-wielding Beastmen. It can be found at the earliest by taking the "Crumbling Lands" Waygate at The Four Belfries, alongside a throwing knife-wielding one. These will be scaled for Farum Azula rather than Liurnia, so they are considerably tougher than any other regular enemy at that point of the game and the mix of range and melee make them quite difficult to take on. In Farum Azula, taking the elevator next to the Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace back down leads to a walking cleaver-wielder with its back turned, though it is the stronger. Another two can be found by taking the lift down beside the Dragon Temple Lift Site of Grace exiting out the room to the right, with the first being down the stairs straight ahead and the second being reached by walking up a floating pillar to the right (though the second one is also guardd by a sword-wielding Beastman at the pillar and a Stray behind a wall near its position).
entries.description: Curved greatsword of colossal size forged of dull iron and wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula. The blade is incredibly heavy, but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers. It's clear the beastmen possess knowledge beyond human ken.

entries.name: Bloodhound's Fang
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Forlorn Hound Evergaol (Limgrave) Dropped by Bloodhound Knight Darriwil in the Forlorn Hound Evergaol in southern Limgrave. Blaidd the Half-Wolf will direct the Tarnished here as part of his questline, and will be available for summoning in the Evergaol before awakening Darriwil after doing so.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Forlorn Hound Evergaol (Limgrave) Dropped by Bloodhound Knight Darriwil in the Forlorn Hound Evergaol in southern Limgrave. Blaidd the Half-Wolf will direct the Tarnished here as part of his questline, and will be available for summoning in the Evergaol before awakening Darriwil after doing so.
entries.description: Curved greatsword with a gently undulating blade wielded by Bloodhound Knights. A fearsome blade capable of brutal airborne attacks.

entries.name: Dismounter
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Limgrave / Weeping Peninsula / Mountaintops of the Giants 4% drop chance from Kaiden Sellswords. Two Sellswords can be found apart on the path between Stormhill Shack and Warmaster's Shack in Limgrave. Four Sellswords can be found at an unmarked camp northeast of the Agheel Lake North Site of Grace in Limgrave (the camp that contains the Armorer's Cookbook 1). Two of them are at the camp alongside some Wolves while the other two patrol around it on Horses.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Limgrave / Weeping Peninsula / Mountaintops of the Giants 4% drop chance from Kaiden Sellswords. Two Sellswords can be found apart on the path between Stormhill Shack and Warmaster's Shack in Limgrave. Four Sellswords can be found at an unmarked camp northeast of the Agheel Lake North Site of Grace in Limgrave (the camp that contains the Armorer's Cookbook 1). Two of them are at the camp alongside some Wolves while the other two patrol around it on Horses.
entries.description: This curved greatsword wielded by the brawny sellswords of Kaiden combines the blades of a scimitar with the heft of a hatchet. A difficult to handle weapon that demands much of the wielder's strength and dexterity, but with practice and ability, it can serve as a versatile weapon even on horseback.

entries.name: Freyja's Greatsword
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Specimen Storehouse (Shadow Keep) / Enir-Ilim This weapon can be obtained wherever Redmane Freyja dies. If you gave her Freyja's Letter, you can find Freyja's Greatsword on her body after defeating her during the boss against Needle Knight Leda and her allies. Otherwise, it can be found by the Storehouse, Seventh Floor Site of Grace after defeating Leda and her allies.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Specimen Storehouse (Shadow Keep) / Enir-Ilim This weapon can be obtained wherever Redmane Freyja dies. If you gave her Freyja's Letter, you can find Freyja's Greatsword on her body after defeating her during the boss against Needle Knight Leda and her allies. Otherwise, it can be found by the Storehouse, Seventh Floor Site of Grace after defeating Leda and her allies.
entries.description: Weapon of Freyja, a Redmane. Greatsword decorated with a mane, much like the weapons used by her liege. The spirit of Freyja's training lingers in this sword, enhancing the power of Redmane battle skills.

entries.name: Horned Warrior's Greatsword
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower) Obtained from the Wind-aspected Divine Beast Warrior found towards the end of Enir-Ilim on the bridge to the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom Site of Grace.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower) Obtained from the Wind-aspected Divine Beast Warrior found towards the end of Enir-Ilim on the bridge to the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom Site of Grace.
entries.description: Curved greatsword of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower. A heavy weapon made to bring the deft strength of the warriors to bear. The ornamental tangled horns allow the blade to serve as a medium for horn-calling.

entries.name: Magma Wyrm's Scalesword
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Ruin-Strewn Precipice (Liurnia of the Lakes) Received upon defeating Magma Wyrm Makar at the end of the dungeon.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Ruin-Strewn Precipice (Liurnia of the Lakes) Received upon defeating Magma Wyrm Makar at the end of the dungeon.
entries.description: Curved greatsword wielded by Magma Wyrms. The shape resembles a dragon's jaw and is covered in hard scales. It's said these land-bound dragons were once human heroes who partook in dragon communion, a grave transgression for which they were cursed to crawl the earth upon their bellies, shadows of their former selves.

entries.name: Monk's Flameblade
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (Mountaintops of the Giants) 4% chance to drop from Fire Monk enemies that wield it within the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave. Note that it does NOT drop from any Blackflame Monks that wield it. From the Site of Grace at the entrance, head further down the stairs into the Grave and take a right to find an illusory wall in the corner. Jumping through the furthest window in that hidden corridor, there is another doorway straight ahead, with a moveable flame trap to the right. If it has been lowered (easy with any ranged weapon or Margit's Shackle) then a sword-wielding Flame Monk can be found in a cubby on the right side in the corridor the trap was guarding.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (Mountaintops of the Giants) 4% chance to drop from Fire Monk enemies that wield it within the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave. Note that it does NOT drop from any Blackflame Monks that wield it. From the Site of Grace at the entrance, head further down the stairs into the Grave and take a right to find an illusory wall in the corner. Jumping through the furthest window in that hidden corridor, there is another doorway straight ahead, with a moveable flame trap to the right. If it has been lowered (easy with any ranged weapon or Margit's Shackle) then a sword-wielding Flame Monk can be found in a cubby on the right side in the corridor the trap was guarding.
entries.description: Curved sword with a flickering flame motif. Wielded by the Fire Monks who came out from the Mountaintops of the Giants. The monks came to the land of Liurnia in pursuit of a fugitive who stole their fire.

entries.name: Morgott's Cursed Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Omen King, gained by defeating the Morgott, the Omen King, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the belled Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.acquisition: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Omen King, gained by defeating the Morgott, the Omen King, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the belled Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.description: Warped blade of shifting hue used by Morgott, the Omen King. The accursed blood that Morgott recanted and sealed away reformed into this blade.

entries.name: Omen Cleaver
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Stormveil Castle / Cliffbottom Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Subterranean Shunning-Grounds 4% drop chance from sword-wielding Omens. One can be found just outside of hte Liftside Chamber Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle, sitting beside a Stray (a Beast-Repellent Torch can help keep the latter away to make the fight easier).
entries.acquisition: Drop: Stormveil Castle / Cliffbottom Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Subterranean Shunning-Grounds 4% drop chance from sword-wielding Omens. One can be found just outside of hte Liftside Chamber Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle, sitting beside a Stray (a Beast-Repellent Torch can help keep the latter away to make the fight easier).
entries.description: Heavy-bladed curved sword of colossal size awarded to Omen as a tool of war. This weapon is made to take advantage of brute strength. The pattern etched upon the blade is the remnant of a deteriorative malediction. Indeed, when bestowing a weapon, preparations must be made for taking it away.

entries.name: Onyx Lord's Greatsword
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Sealed Tunnel (Capital Outskirts) Dropped by the Onyx Lord boss at the end of the Sealed Tunnel in Capital Outskirts.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Sealed Tunnel (Capital Outskirts) Dropped by the Onyx Lord boss at the end of the Sealed Tunnel in Capital Outskirts.
entries.description: Greatsword forged from golden-hued meteoric ore. The blade conceals gravity-manipulating magic. A weapon unique to the Onyx Lords, a race of ancients with skin of stone who were said to have risen to life when a meteor struck long ago.

entries.name: Zamor Curved Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (Mountaintops of the Giants) Dropped by the Ancient Hero of Zamor boss at the end of the Hero's Grave.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (Mountaintops of the Giants) Dropped by the Ancient Hero of Zamor boss at the end of the Hero's Grave.
entries.description: Weapon wielded by the knights of Zamor who earned great renown during the War against the Giants. In apparent devotion to winter, the curved blade is styled after an icy wind and imbued with a powerful frost effect.

entries.name: Backhand Blade
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Gravesite Plain This weapon can be found beside a coffin in a gazebo in the Inquisitor section of Gravesite Plain, north-northeast of the Scorched Ruins Site of Grace. On acquisition it has Ash of War: Blind Spot pre-equipped, despite already having Blind Spot as its underlying base skill — thus allowing this Ash of War to be obtained.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Gravesite Plain This weapon can be found beside a coffin in a gazebo in the Inquisitor section of Gravesite Plain, north-northeast of the Scorched Ruins Site of Grace. On acquisition it has Ash of War: Blind Spot pre-equipped, despite already having Blind Spot as its underlying base skill — thus allowing this Ash of War to be obtained.
entries.description: Curved blade wielded with a backhand grip. A type of weapon wielded by hornsent for generations. The style of combat associated with this weapon is marked by spinning slashes and gouging thrust attacks.

entries.name: Curseblade's Cirque
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Gravesite Plain / Belurat, Tower Settlement / Scadu Altus / Ancient Ruins of Rauh 3% drop chance from Curseblades (2% drop chance from some of the Curseblades in Scaduview and Ancient Ruins of Rauh). There is an easily reached Curseblade walking down the stairs leading down from the Stagefront Site of Grace in Belurat. By crouching it is possible to backstab it to make the fight easier. The one directly northeast of the first Gravesite Plain is also easily reached, though it isn't really possible to ambush it.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Gravesite Plain / Belurat, Tower Settlement / Scadu Altus / Ancient Ruins of Rauh 3% drop chance from Curseblades (2% drop chance from some of the Curseblades in Scaduview and Ancient Ruins of Rauh). There is an easily reached Curseblade walking down the stairs leading down from the Stagefront Site of Grace in Belurat. By crouching it is possible to backstab it to make the fight easier. The one directly northeast of the first Gravesite Plain is also easily reached, though it isn't really possible to ambush it.
entries.description: Weapon of the masked Curseblades. Circular backhand blade with wave-like cutting edges, sharpened into points that incite blood loss. Long ago, this was employed by the ascetics who strove to become tutelary deities as a ritualistic object in their self-flagellating dances.

entries.name: Smithscript Cirque
entries.primaryLocation: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past - Scadu Altus
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past (Scadu Altus) It can be looted from a body located by the edge of the sewage waterfall in the depths of the Forge. More specifically, it's found a bit behind a lever-locked gate inside of the Forge.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past (Scadu Altus) It can be looted from a body located by the edge of the sewage waterfall in the depths of the Forge. More specifically, it's found a bit behind a lever-locked gate inside of the Forge.
entries.description: Circular backhand blade engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts. Execute a strong attack to throw the backhand blade, causing it to fly in a curved trajectory.

entries.name: Dragonscale Blade
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Lake of Rot (Ainsel River) Dropped by the Dragonkin Soldier boss in the Lake of Rot. A platform can be raised by buttons in the immediate area, making it slightly easier to fight the boss without constantly being afflicted with Scarlet Rot.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Lake of Rot (Ainsel River) Dropped by the Dragonkin Soldier boss in the Lake of Rot. A platform can be raised by buttons in the immediate area, making it slightly easier to fight the boss without constantly being afflicted with Scarlet Rot.
passiveEffects: Deals increased damage to Dragons and Ancient Dragons.
entries.description: A weapon made by sharpening a Gravel Stone scale, thought to be the source of ancient dragon immortality, into an unclouded blade. Alas, the Dragonkin Soldiers never attained immortality, and perished as decrepit, pale imitations of their skyborn kin.

entries.name: Hand of Malenia
entries.detailedLocation: Trade: Finger Reader Enia Trade the Remembrance of the Rot Goddess, gained by defeating Malenia, Blade of Miquella, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.acquisition: Trade: Finger Reader Enia Trade the Remembrance of the Rot Goddess, gained by defeating Malenia, Blade of Miquella, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.description: Blade built into Malenia's prosthetic arm. Through consecration it is resistant to rot. Malenia's war prosthesis symbolized her victories. Some claim to have seen wings when the weapon was raised aloft; wings of fierce determination that have never known defeat.

entries.name: Meteoric Ore Blade
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Caelid Waypoint Ruins (Caelid) Found in the underground chambers in the northwest section of the Caelid Waypoint Ruins. It is inside of a chest behind a door in the far corner of the room.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Caelid Waypoint Ruins (Caelid) Found in the underground chambers in the northwest section of the Caelid Waypoint Ruins. It is inside of a chest behind a door in the far corner of the room.
entries.description: Katana forged from meteoric ore to dispatch lifeforms born of falling stars. Deals magic damage. The blade is weighty known to deliver slashes of such ferocity that the impact is said to resemble the crash of a falling meteor.

entries.name: Moonveil
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Gael Tunnel (Caelid) Dropped by the Magma Wyrm in Gael Tunnel.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Gael Tunnel (Caelid) Dropped by the Magma Wyrm in Gael Tunnel.
entries.description: Katana forged of glintstone. Masterpiece of a Sellian swordsmith. Light enwreathes the blade when sheathed, explaining its Moonveil moniker.

entries.name: Nagakiba
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Mountaintops of the Giants The Nagakiba is either dropped by Bloody Finger Hunter Yura at the end of his questline at the Second Church of Marika or after being killed by the player. If the player visits the Three Fingers and inherits the Frenzied Flame, the Nagakiba will be found on the ground where Shabriri once stood near the Zamor Ruins, along with the Ronin's Set. The Nagakiba comes pre-equipped with the Piercing Fang Ash of War and Standard affinity on it.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Mountaintops of the Giants The Nagakiba is either dropped by Bloody Finger Hunter Yura at the end of his questline at the Second Church of Marika or after being killed by the player. If the player visits the Three Fingers and inherits the Frenzied Flame, the Nagakiba will be found on the ground where Shabriri once stood near the Zamor Ruins, along with the Ronin's Set. The Nagakiba comes pre-equipped with the Piercing Fang Ash of War and Standard affinity on it.
entries.description: Katana with a ferociously long blade. Signature weapon of Yura, hunter of Bloody Fingers. Reminiscent of a reinforced spear, its imposing length can be put to good use with powerful thrusting attacks.

entries.name: Rivers of Blood
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Mountaintops of the Giants Defeat Okina at the Church of Repose.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Mountaintops of the Giants Defeat Okina at the Church of Repose.
entries.description: Weapon of Okina, swordsman from the Land of Reeds. A cursed weapon that has felled countless men. When Mohg, the Lord of Blood, first felt Okina's sword, and madness, upon his flesh, he had a proposal, to offer Okina the life of a demon, whose thirst would never go unsated.

entries.name: Serpentbone Blade
entries.detailedLocation: Quest reward: Volcano Manor Obtained from Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress after defeating Rileigh the Idle. This reward can still be received after defeating the Lord of Blasphemy as long as the second Letter from Volcano Manor was obtained beforehand. In this case the Serpentbone Blade should appear where Tanith normally sits after the assassination is done.
entries.acquisition: Quest reward: Volcano Manor Obtained from Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress after defeating Rileigh the Idle. This reward can still be received after defeating the Lord of Blasphemy as long as the second Letter from Volcano Manor was obtained beforehand. In this case the Serpentbone Blade should appear where Tanith normally sits after the assassination is done.
entries.description: Sinister katana modeled after a serpent bone. The densely packed row of spines that jut away from the cutting edge are coated in a lethal poison.

entries.name: Star-Lined Sword
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Cerulean Coast Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Marigga.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Cerulean Coast Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Marigga.
entries.description: Sword encrusted with a line of stars fashioned from small pieces of crude glintstone. Weapon of the demi-human swordsmen. When bestowed with this weapon by their queen, the swordsmen swear to find the truth that lies at the end of the procession of stars.

entries.name: Sword of Night
entries.detailedLocation: Quest Reward: Cathedral of Manus Metyr (Scadu Altus) Defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers by following Count Ymir's questline and then defeat both him and Jolán, Swordhand of Night. Reload the area, and the player will find Jolán sitting on the ground against the pillar when she usually stands. Give her the Iris of Occultation, and she'll die and drop the .
entries.acquisition: Quest Reward: Cathedral of Manus Metyr (Scadu Altus) Defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers by following Count Ymir's questline and then defeat both him and Jolán, Swordhand of Night. Reload the area, and the player will find Jolán sitting on the ground against the pillar when she usually stands. Give her the Iris of Occultation, and she'll die and drop the .
entries.description: Sword of an all-consuming, bottomless black that devours even the light that shines upon it. Wielded by Jolán, Swordhand of Night. The blade of the sword is only semicorporeal, and thus cannot be guarded against completely.

entries.name: Uchigatana
entries.detailedLocation: Starting equipment: 1 is part of the starting equipment for the Samurai Origin. Loot: Deathtouched Catacombs (Limgrave) 1 is found in the Deathtouched Catacombs on the hidden platform with a Skeleton Archer, just before the lever. This spot is reached by going through an Illusory Wall on the right side of the stairs the first Skeleton enemy is standing on, then through a passage to the left.
entries.acquisition: Starting equipment: 1 is part of the starting equipment for the Samurai Origin. Loot: Deathtouched Catacombs (Limgrave) 1 is found in the Deathtouched Catacombs on the hidden platform with a Skeleton Archer, just before the lever. This spot is reached by going through an Illusory Wall on the right side of the stairs the first Skeleton enemy is standing on, then through a passage to the left.
entries.description: A katana with a long single-edged curved blade. A unique weapon wielded by the samurai from the Land of Reeds. The blade, with its undulating design, boasts extraordinary sharpness, and its slash attacks cause blood loss.

entries.name: Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Dragon's Pit (Gravesite Plain) The Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana is received upon defeating the Ancient Dragon-Man at the end of the Dragon's Pit dungeon.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Dragon's Pit (Gravesite Plain) The Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana is received upon defeating the Ancient Dragon-Man at the end of the Dragon's Pit dungeon.
entries.description: Great katana with spines of gravel stone along its blade, wielded by the Ancient Dragon-Man of the Dragon's Pit. Has an anti-dragon effect. Formerly a Dragon Communion warrior, the Ancient Dragon-Man was once arbiter of those worthy to devour the Dreaded One.

entries.name: Great Katana
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Gravesite Plain Found on a corpse in the lake on the northern Gravesite Plain, west of Abandoned Ailing Village, where the Ghostflame Dragon is fought. Comes equipped with the Ash of War: Overhead Stance by default.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Gravesite Plain Found on a corpse in the lake on the northern Gravesite Plain, west of Abandoned Ailing Village, where the Ghostflame Dragon is fought. Comes equipped with the Ash of War: Overhead Stance by default.
entries.description: Large katana with a long, heavy blade. A weapon unique to warriors of the Land of Reeds. Designed for aggression, this armament requires the wielder to throw their entire body into swinging it. The slashing attacks of its honed edge incite blood loss.

entries.name: Rakshasa's Great Katana
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Eastern Nameless Mausoleum (Scadu Altus) Gained by defeating Rakshasa in the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Eastern Nameless Mausoleum (Scadu Altus) Gained by defeating Rakshasa in the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum.
entries.description: A great katana with the tempering pattern of its blade forever stained red with blood. Weapon of Rakshasa, who cuts down and devours. A berserker's weapon used to endure enemy attacks and reply with one's full fury. When attacking, the wielder is less likely to stagger from counterattacks, but will also take increased damage.

entries.name: Black Steel Twinblade
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Scadu Altus Guaranteed drop from the Black Knight at the top of the western hill camp off to the side of the encampment in front of the Shadow Keep, or northeast of Church of the Crusade.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Scadu Altus Guaranteed drop from the Black Knight at the top of the western hill camp off to the side of the encampment in front of the Shadow Keep, or northeast of Church of the Crusade.
entries.description: Weapon of the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Twinblade of black steel with decorative embellishments in gold. Blessed with an Erdtree incantation. Further holy imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power.

entries.name: Eleonora's Poleblade
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Altus Plateau Dropped by the invader Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger at the Second Church of Marika. Eleonora spawns at the Church regardless if the Tarnished is doing Yura's questline or not.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Altus Plateau Dropped by the invader Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger at the Second Church of Marika. Eleonora spawns at the Church regardless if the Tarnished is doing Yura's questline or not.
entries.description: Twinned naginata forged in the Land of Reeds. Chosen weapon of Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger. Her mastery of the sword was such that her onslaught was likened to a whirlwind, but now her legacy is stained by accursed blood.

entries.name: Euporia
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Enir-Ilim This armament is technically found in Belurat, Tower Settlement, however, reaching it can only be done through Enir-Ilim. On the stairs past the lightning-aspected Divine Beast Warrior, jump off the path onto a lower staircase and then follow the ledges down until you reach a platform with a Fireproof Pickled Liver. Jump into the nearby window (sprinting is advised), and then go out to the balcony and follow the path to the right down the lifts, past the Inquisitors and the Divine Beast Warrior. Euporia lies at the end of this path.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Enir-Ilim This armament is technically found in Belurat, Tower Settlement, however, reaching it can only be done through Enir-Ilim. On the stairs past the lightning-aspected Divine Beast Warrior, jump off the path onto a lower staircase and then follow the ledges down until you reach a platform with a Fireproof Pickled Liver. Jump into the nearby window (sprinting is advised), and then go out to the balcony and follow the path to the right down the lifts, past the Inquisitors and the Divine Beast Warrior. Euporia lies at the end of this path.
entries.description: Twinblade symbolizing abundance. The secret treasure of the tower. Though the blades, fashioned from golden shoots, are largely wilted and darkened, their luster can be restored by dealing damage to foes. However, damage dealt to Those Who Live in Death will have no such effect.

entries.name: Gargoyle's Black Blades
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Grand Lift of Rold (Forbidden Lands) Received upon defeating Black Blade Kindred before the Grand Lift of Rold, along with the Gargoyle's Black Axe.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Grand Lift of Rold (Forbidden Lands) Received upon defeating Black Blade Kindred before the Grand Lift of Rold, along with the Gargoyle's Black Axe.
entries.description: Bronze twinblade wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage. Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

entries.name: Gargoyle's Twinblade
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Siofra River Dropped by the Valiant Gargoyle duo boss, along with the Gargoyle's Greatsword.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Siofra River Dropped by the Valiant Gargoyle duo boss, along with the Gargoyle's Greatsword.
entries.description: Bronze twinblade wielded by Valiant Gargoyles. Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.

entries.name: Godskin Peeler
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Dominula, Windmill Village (Altus Plateau) Dropped by the Godskin Apostle at the end of Dominula, Windmill Village.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Dominula, Windmill Village (Altus Plateau) Dropped by the Godskin Apostle at the end of Dominula, Windmill Village.
entries.description: Unique twinblade wielded by Godskin Apostles characterized by its disturbing design. One end features a sickle for slicing attacks while the other boasts a winding spike for boring into flesh. Much skill is required to wield this weapon due to its asymmetric nature.

entries.name: Twinblade
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Dragon-Burnt Ruins (Limgrave) Found in a chest in the southeastern basement room of the Ruins, the one without the Rats, that is reached by using Torrent to jump over a crumbled wall into an enclosure.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Dragon-Burnt Ruins (Limgrave) Found in a chest in the southeastern basement room of the Ruins, the one without the Rats, that is reached by using Torrent to jump over a crumbled wall into an enclosure.
entries.description: A sword with blades on both sides of the hilt. This weapon is difficult to wield and demands high dexterity. Can be wielded with a single hand, but its true strength is unlocked with dual-handed spinning attacks.

entries.name: Twinned Knight Swords
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: East Windmill Pasture (Altus Plateau) Found on a corpse just northwest of the East Windmill Pasture.
entries.acquisition: Loot: East Windmill Pasture (Altus Plateau) Found on a corpse just northwest of the East Windmill Pasture.
entries.description: An attractive twinblade of fine make that prizes the chivalric way. Can be wielded with a single hand, but its true strength is unlocked with dual-handed spinning attacks.

entries.name: Battle Axe
entries.detailedLocation: Starting Equipment: 1 is part of the starting equipment of the Hero origin. Purchase: Roundtable Hold 1 is sold for runes 800 Runes by the Twin Maiden Husks in Roundtable Hold.
entries.acquisition: Starting Equipment: 1 is part of the starting equipment of the Hero origin. Purchase: Roundtable Hold 1 is sold for runes 800 Runes by the Twin Maiden Husks in Roundtable Hold.
entries.description: A thick, heavy blade attached to a handle. A versatile, standard weapon Capable of powerful attacks thanks to the weighty blade, these weapons are also regarded for their powerful charge attacks.

entries.name: Celebrant's Cleaver
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Dominula, Windmill Village (Altus Plateau) 0.5% drop chance from cleaver-wielding Dominula Dancers in Dominula, Windmill Village, located in the north of Altus Plateau.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Dominula, Windmill Village (Altus Plateau) 0.5% drop chance from cleaver-wielding Dominula Dancers in Dominula, Windmill Village, located in the north of Altus Plateau.
entries.description: Cleaver decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.

entries.name: Death Knight's Twin Axes
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Fog Rift Catacombs (Gravesite Plain) Dropped by the dual-axe wielding Death Knight at then end of the dungeon.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Fog Rift Catacombs (Gravesite Plain) Dropped by the dual-axe wielding Death Knight at then end of the dungeon.
entries.description: Golden war axes of the Death Knight. A pair of weapons made to be wielded in both hands. Crackles with lightning, the power of the capital's ancient dragon cult. The knight, once the personal guard of Godwyn, was also the protector of the Prince of Death's cadaver surrogate.

entries.name: Forked Hatchet
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Fringefolk Hero's Grave & Stormfoot Catacombs & Murkwater Catacombs (Limgrave) / Impaler's Catacombs (Weeping Peninsula) / Road's End Catacombs & Cliffbottom Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Wyndham Catacombs & Sainted Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau) / Minor Erdtree Catacombs & War-Dead Catacombs (Caelid) / Auriza Side Tomb & Leyndell, Royal Capital & Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Capital Outskirts) / Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs & Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (Mountaintops of the Giants) / Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs (Consecrated Snowfield) 2% drop chance from hatchet-wielding Fanged Imps. Stormfoot Catacombs is an easy farming spot, being located very early in the game and having a small sideroom with two hatchet-wielding Imps just after the Site of Grace at the entrance. Murkwater Catacombs also has two hatchet-wielding Imps in the corridor just after the entrance.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Fringefolk Hero's Grave & Stormfoot Catacombs & Murkwater Catacombs (Limgrave) / Impaler's Catacombs (Weeping Peninsula) / Road's End Catacombs & Cliffbottom Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Wyndham Catacombs & Sainted Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau) / Minor Erdtree Catacombs & War-Dead Catacombs (Caelid) / Auriza Side Tomb & Leyndell, Royal Capital & Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Capital Outskirts) / Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs & Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (Mountaintops of the Giants) / Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs (Consecrated Snowfield) 2% drop chance from hatchet-wielding Fanged Imps. Stormfoot Catacombs is an easy farming spot, being located very early in the game and having a small sideroom with two hatchet-wielding Imps just after the Site of Grace at the entrance. Murkwater Catacombs also has two hatchet-wielding Imps in the corridor just after the entrance.
entries.description: Peculiar hatched wielded by imps. The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.

entries.name: Forked-Tongue Hatchet
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Fog Rift Catacombs (Gravesite Plain) / Darklight Catacombs (Scadu Altus) / Scorpion River Catacombs (Rauh Base) 2% drop chance from hatchet-wielding Fanged Imps in the Realm of Shadow. The earliest farming spot is in Darklight Catacombs by using the Stake of Marika found just after the first elevator down in the dungeon, where one hatchet-wielding Imp can be found down a set of stairs and a greatsword-wielder can be found next to the Stake to kill the Tarnished and trigger a respawn at it. One easily farmed Imp can be found in the Scorpion River Catacombs by taking two left turned after the grace, in a dead-end room (two other, non-hatchet Imps can be found on the way but only the second one will have to be dealt with). There is also another hatchet-wielding Imp found across the bridge in the room beside the dead-end room, that can be pulled over with a Kukri or a Crossbow/Bow to kill.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Fog Rift Catacombs (Gravesite Plain) / Darklight Catacombs (Scadu Altus) / Scorpion River Catacombs (Rauh Base) 2% drop chance from hatchet-wielding Fanged Imps in the Realm of Shadow. The earliest farming spot is in Darklight Catacombs by using the Stake of Marika found just after the first elevator down in the dungeon, where one hatchet-wielding Imp can be found down a set of stairs and a greatsword-wielder can be found next to the Stake to kill the Tarnished and trigger a respawn at it. One easily farmed Imp can be found in the Scorpion River Catacombs by taking two left turned after the grace, in a dead-end room (two other, non-hatchet Imps can be found on the way but only the second one will have to be dealt with). There is also another hatchet-wielding Imp found across the bridge in the room beside the dead-end room, that can be pulled over with a Kukri or a Crossbow/Bow to kill.
entries.description: A peculiar weapon wielded by imps. Hatchet smithed in the shape of a fork-tongued dragon. The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.

entries.name: Hand Axe
entries.detailedLocation: Purchase: Limgrave 1 is sold for runes 600 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant located in eastern Limgrave in the Mistwood, south of the Minor Erdtree there.
entries.acquisition: Purchase: Limgrave 1 is sold for runes 600 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant located in eastern Limgrave in the Mistwood, south of the Minor Erdtree there.
entries.description: Commonly known as a hatchet, this smaller variety of axe is an everyday work tool. Despite its short reach, it is easy to handle, exceling in successive attacks.

entries.name: Highland Axe
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave) Found in Stormveil Castle under a painting inside the room with a roaming Grafted Scion, across from the room with the elevator shortcut up to the Rampart Tower Site of Grace.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave) Found in Stormveil Castle under a painting inside the room with a roaming Grafted Scion, across from the room with the elevator shortcut up to the Rampart Tower Site of Grace.
entries.description: Single-sided axe used by the warriors of the highlands. Brave combatants begin battle by crying out their names. Roars are enhanced by this weapon.

entries.name: Icerind Hatchet
entries.primaryLocation: Temple Quarter - Liurnia of the Lakes
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Temple Quarter (Liurnia of the Lakes) Found inside a chest in a small, broken tower in southern Temple Quarter, located south-west of Academy of Raya Lucaria. It's on a straight track southeast of the Temple Quarter Site of Grace, on the island just south of the Temple Quarter map icon.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Temple Quarter (Liurnia of the Lakes) Found inside a chest in a small, broken tower in southern Temple Quarter, located south-west of Academy of Raya Lucaria. It's on a straight track southeast of the Temple Quarter Site of Grace, on the island just south of the Temple Quarter map icon.
entries.description: A hatchet with a frost-coated blade. One of several gifts given by Castle Sol in the distant north. Known as "freezing fog," the blade is thought to be a dragon's scale. Inflicts a powerful frost effect.

entries.name: Iron Cleaver
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Morne Tunnel & Castle Morne (Weeping Peninsula) / Unsightly Catacombs & Leyndell, Royal Capital (Capital Outskirts) / Cave of the Forlorn & Miquella's Haligtree (Consecrated Snowfield) / Scadu Altus / Charo's Hidden Grave 2% drop chance from cleaver-wielding Misbegotten. Starting from the Castle Morne Lift Site of Grace, heading up the elevator is a courtyard filled with Misbegotten, of which 8 (all around the big pyre) wield cleavers. Just northwest of the Haligtree Town Plaza Site of Grace in Miquella's Haligtree are 3 fairly passive cleaver-wielders.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Morne Tunnel & Castle Morne (Weeping Peninsula) / Unsightly Catacombs & Leyndell, Royal Capital (Capital Outskirts) / Cave of the Forlorn & Miquella's Haligtree (Consecrated Snowfield) / Scadu Altus / Charo's Hidden Grave 2% drop chance from cleaver-wielding Misbegotten. Starting from the Castle Morne Lift Site of Grace, heading up the elevator is a courtyard filled with Misbegotten, of which 8 (all around the big pyre) wield cleavers. Just northwest of the Haligtree Town Plaza Site of Grace in Miquella's Haligtree are 3 fairly passive cleaver-wielders.
entries.description: Fairly large iron cleaver, commonly used by the maltreated Misbegotten. Steeped in resentment, these weapons are swung wildly and relentlessly, often after rushing up to foes.

entries.name: Jawbone Axe
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Siofra River / Uld Palace Ruins (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Ainsel River 2% drop chance from axe-wielding Ancestral Follower Warriors, including the bow-wielding ones. 3 can be found just northwest of the Worshippers' Woods in Lower Siofra River. Several can be found by the Ruined Labyrinth Site of Grace in southern Uld Palace Ruins. 8 can be found on the approach to the Minor Erdtree in northeastern Liurnia. Mauoleum Compound is the closest Site of Grace.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Siofra River / Uld Palace Ruins (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Ainsel River 2% drop chance from axe-wielding Ancestral Follower Warriors, including the bow-wielding ones. 3 can be found just northwest of the Worshippers' Woods in Lower Siofra River. Several can be found by the Ruined Labyrinth Site of Grace in southern Uld Palace Ruins. 8 can be found on the approach to the Minor Erdtree in northeastern Liurnia. Mauoleum Compound is the closest Site of Grace.
entries.description: Axe made from a herbivore's skull. Weapon of the ancestral followers who disdain metal. This axe is more of a bludgeon; it forgoes a bladed edge, instead using the beast's molar teeth to buffet foes, dealing strike damage.

entries.name: Messmer Soldier's Axe
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Gravesite Plain / Cerulean Coast / Charo's Hidden Grave / Scadu Altus / Rauh Base / Abyssal Woods / Ruins of Rauh 2% drop chance from any axe-wielding Messmer Soldiers. 2 axe-wielders (and 2 spear-wielders) can be found down a ladder from the Stake of Marika in Fog Rift Fort, reached by dropping down the cliff by the Scadu Altus, West Site of Grace. They are all found near some explosive barrels, which can be used to kill them quicker (and to reset to the Stake afterwards). 2 axe-wielders can be found at the Castle Front Site of Grace just outside of Castle Ensis, though a Beast-Repellent Torch to keep the dogs away is greatly recommended.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Gravesite Plain / Cerulean Coast / Charo's Hidden Grave / Scadu Altus / Rauh Base / Abyssal Woods / Ruins of Rauh 2% drop chance from any axe-wielding Messmer Soldiers. 2 axe-wielders (and 2 spear-wielders) can be found down a ladder from the Stake of Marika in Fog Rift Fort, reached by dropping down the cliff by the Scadu Altus, West Site of Grace. They are all found near some explosive barrels, which can be used to kill them quicker (and to reset to the Stake afterwards). 2 axe-wielders can be found at the Castle Front Site of Grace just outside of Castle Ensis, though a Beast-Repellent Torch to keep the dogs away is greatly recommended.
entries.description: Weapon used by the soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. A steel axe, worn from use. A favorite of those who lost themselves utterly in their lord's war. Capable of performing powerful charge attacks.

entries.name: Ripple Blade
entries.detailedLocation: Purchase: Caria Manor (Liurnia of the Lakes) 1 is sold for runes 3500 Runes by Pidia, Carian Servant, in the hidden floor accessed from the back side of Caria Manor after defeating Royal Knight Loretta.
entries.acquisition: Purchase: Caria Manor (Liurnia of the Lakes) 1 is sold for runes 3500 Runes by Pidia, Carian Servant, in the hidden floor accessed from the back side of Caria Manor after defeating Royal Knight Loretta.
entries.description: Unique weapon wielded by young Albinaurics, this sword is modelled after the ripples that are thought to be the origin of their species. Its attack power is greatly enhanced with one's arcane attribute.

entries.name: Rosus' Axe
entries.primaryLocation: Black Knife Catacombs - Liurnia of the Lakes
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Black Knife Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes) Found inside Black Knife Catacombs, located to the northeast in Liurnia of the Lakes. It requires one Stonesword Key to access.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Black Knife Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes) Found inside Black Knife Catacombs, located to the northeast in Liurnia of the Lakes. It requires one Stonesword Key to access.
entries.description: Usher of Death, Rosus, who shows the path to the catacombs throughout the Land Between, is depicted on this ritual axe. The dead easily lose their way, and have always been in sore need of a guiding hand.

entries.name: Sacrificial Axe
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Weeping Peninsula Received upon defeating the Deathbird in Weeping Peninsula. It will appear on south side of the wall north of Castle Morne at night, near where the wall meets the coast. If the (non-respawning) Archer Golem in the area is still alive, its arrows may help defeat the Deathbird (though it can hit either combatant).
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Weeping Peninsula Received upon defeating the Deathbird in Weeping Peninsula. It will appear on south side of the wall north of Castle Morne at night, near where the wall meets the coast. If the (non-respawning) Archer Golem in the area is still alive, its arrows may help defeat the Deathbird (though it can hit either combatant).
entries.description: Hatchet used in ancient sacrificial rite. A Deathbird is depicted as a malevolent deity. The power of the rite yet lingers. A small amount of FP is restored upon slaying a foe.

entries.name: Smithscript Axe
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Taylew's Ruined Forge (Rauh Base) From the Site of Grace at Taylew's Ruined Forge, take the straight path through the dungeon until there's a gap in the path. Jump over the gap instead of dropping down, then take a left into a small room with a Golem Smith and the Smithscript Axe.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Taylew's Ruined Forge (Rauh Base) From the Site of Grace at Taylew's Ruined Forge, take the straight path through the dungeon until there's a gap in the path. Jump over the gap instead of dropping down, then take a left into a small room with a Golem Smith and the Smithscript Axe.
