entries.description: Axe engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts. Execute a strong attack or jumping strong attack to throw the axe.

entries.name: Stormhawk Axe
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Leyndell, Royal Capital (Altus Plateau) / Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants) One can be found in Leyndell, in the court outside of the fortified manor where the Abductor Virgin enemies are roaming. One can be found within Castle Sol, on a rooftop not far from where you find the painting. Drop: Nepheli Loux, Warrior Two can be looted from Nepheli Loux if she's killed in the Village of the Albinaurics. Alternatively, if the player burns the Erdtree and has not advanced Nepheli's questline since her arrival at the Roundtable Hold, she will be gone and her Stormhawk Axes can be found her she previously stood.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Leyndell, Royal Capital (Altus Plateau) / Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants) One can be found in Leyndell, in the court outside of the fortified manor where the Abductor Virgin enemies are roaming. One can be found within Castle Sol, on a rooftop not far from where you find the painting. Drop: Nepheli Loux, Warrior Two can be looted from Nepheli Loux if she's killed in the Village of the Albinaurics. Alternatively, if the player burns the Erdtree and has not advanced Nepheli's questline since her arrival at the Roundtable Hold, she will be gone and her Stormhawk Axes can be found her she previously stood.
entries.description: Battle axe designed to resemble a hawk, with its wings comprising the blade. Signature weapon of warriors who strive to remain one with the storm, despite being so far from their place of birth. Their hearts are proud, and thereby easily undone.

entries.name: Warped Axe
entries.primaryLocation: Cliffbottom Catacombs - Liurnia of the Lakes
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Cliffbottom Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Altus Plateau / Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Altus Plateau) 4% chance to drop from axe-wielding Omens. The earliest spots is in Cliffbottom Catacombs, though the two axe-wielding Omen in there are pretty far in. The first one is found by taking a right after reaching the door to the boss fight then dropping down to the side of the stairs afterwards (can be easily be killed with ranged attacks), and the second one can be found up a ladder on a side path in the pit with the first one (after a greatsword-wielding Omen). 2 are found right next to the Abandoned Coffin Site of Grace, just outside the exit from Ruin-Strewn Precipice: one is atop a crashed Carriage just northeast of the Grace, another is walking on the path heading in the same direction, 2 are found by the Underground Roadside Site of Grace, one to the left of the Grace room and one to the right of it.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Cliffbottom Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Altus Plateau / Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Altus Plateau) 4% chance to drop from axe-wielding Omens. The earliest spots is in Cliffbottom Catacombs, though the two axe-wielding Omen in there are pretty far in. The first one is found by taking a right after reaching the door to the boss fight then dropping down to the side of the stairs afterwards (can be easily be killed with ranged attacks), and the second one can be found up a ladder on a side path in the pit with the first one (after a greatsword-wielding Omen). 2 are found right next to the Abandoned Coffin Site of Grace, just outside the exit from Ruin-Strewn Precipice: one is atop a crashed Carriage just northeast of the Grace, another is walking on the path heading in the same direction, 2 are found by the Underground Roadside Site of Grace, one to the left of the Grace room and one to the right of it.
entries.description: Oversized double-headed axe with a bizarre, almost melted appearance. Brute strength is the only thing required to wield this weapon, which appears to have taken quite the beating itself.

entries.name: Axe of Godrick
entries.detailedLocation: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Grafted, gained by defeating Godrick the Grafted, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the belled Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.acquisition: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Grafted, gained by defeating Godrick the Grafted, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the belled Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.description: Greataxe wielded by Godrick the Grafted. This golden battleaxe is emblazoned with the figure of a beast, representing the strength of Godfrey, First Elden Lord and patriarch of the golden lineage. "I command thee kneel! For I am the lord of all that is golden!".

entries.name: Bonny Butchering Knife
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Bonny Village (Scadu Altus) This weapon can be found at Bonny Village below a small shed outside a house east of the Site of Grace, just west of the broken bridge in the central ravine.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Bonny Village (Scadu Altus) This weapon can be found at Bonny Village below a small shed outside a house east of the Site of Grace, just west of the broken bridge in the central ravine.
passiveEffects: Restores small amount of HP on hit.
entries.description: Weapon of the greater potentates of Bonny Village. An outsize Should be "outsized" butcher's cleaver used to dismember human bodies in the making of the great jars stored in the gaols. Restores a very small amount of HP when it squarely strikes an enemy.

entries.name: Butchering Knife
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Corpse-Stench Shack (Mt. Gelmir) Dropped by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater when she invades outside of the Corpse-Stench Shack. This weapon is initially infused with the Sacred Affinity, in spite of having no Ash of War equipped.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Corpse-Stench Shack (Mt. Gelmir) Dropped by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater when she invades outside of the Corpse-Stench Shack. This weapon is initially infused with the Sacred Affinity, in spite of having no Ash of War equipped.
passiveEffects: Restores small amount of HP on hit.
entries.description: Huge carving knife made to cleanly butcher the human body. Signature weapon of the Ogress Anastasia, known to have eaten countless Tarnished while disguised as a Finger Maiden. Restores a small amount of HP when it squarely strikes an enemy.

entries.name: Crescent Moon Axe
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave) / Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants) 4% drop chance from the large Exile Soldiers that wield them. 2 can be found in the Stonesword Key-locked cellar with the Iron Whetblade in Stormveil Castle. The quickest way there being to drop down on the roof just outside of the Rampart Tower Site of Grace then jumping down again (which will deal some fall damage) to a dark courtyard between the roof and the Rampart Tower and finally dropping down to a lone regular Exile Soldier on a wooden platform that leads into the room with the large Soldiers. Alternatively, take the elevator by the Grace down and head out the northern door of the room to find the cellar on your left/to the west. A lone large Exile Soldier can be found on a stone platform a bit over the Liftside Chamber Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle, reached by heading east from the Grace up the stairs past a Warhawk and then turning around to find the Soldier. 2 large Exile Soldiers (and several regular Soldiers) can be found just west of the Limgrave Tower Bridge Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle. 2 can be found in the room just east of the Church of the Eclipse Site of Grace in Castle Sol.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave) / Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants) 4% drop chance from the large Exile Soldiers that wield them. 2 can be found in the Stonesword Key-locked cellar with the Iron Whetblade in Stormveil Castle. The quickest way there being to drop down on the roof just outside of the Rampart Tower Site of Grace then jumping down again (which will deal some fall damage) to a dark courtyard between the roof and the Rampart Tower and finally dropping down to a lone regular Exile Soldier on a wooden platform that leads into the room with the large Soldiers. Alternatively, take the elevator by the Grace down and head out the northern door of the room to find the cellar on your left/to the west. A lone large Exile Soldier can be found on a stone platform a bit over the Liftside Chamber Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle, reached by heading east from the Grace up the stairs past a Warhawk and then turning around to find the Soldier. 2 large Exile Soldiers (and several regular Soldiers) can be found just west of the Limgrave Tower Bridge Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle. 2 can be found in the room just east of the Church of the Eclipse Site of Grace in Castle Sol.
entries.description: Greataxe with a large, arcing blade and long handle. The "Crescent Moon" of its name is said to have been spurred by nostalgia. Specializes in sweeping through foes by making use of its long handle.

entries.name: Death Knight's Longhaft Axe
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Scorpion River Catacombs (Rauh Base) This weapon is dropped after defeating the Death Knight at Scorpion River Catacombs.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Scorpion River Catacombs (Rauh Base) This weapon is dropped after defeating the Death Knight at Scorpion River Catacombs.
entries.description: A long-hafted golden axe wielded by the Death Knight. Bears a representation of a decayed golden ring. Crackles with lightning, the power of the capital's ancient dragon cult. The knight, once the personal guard of Godwyn, was also the protector of the Prince of Death's cadaver surrogate.

entries.name: Executioner's Greataxe
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Crumbling Farum Azula 4% drop chance from Greataxe-wielding Giant Skeletons with 100 Discovery. Farm_spot_executioner_greataxe_2.png|West of Church of Irith and Lake-Facing Cliffs grace. One crawls from the ground, 2 scythe skeletons are near. Farm_spot_executioner_greataxe_1.png|Near the tower building south-east of Raya Lucaria. Surrounded by many other skeletons. Farm_spot_executioner_greataxe_3.png|East of Church of Plague. Crawls from the ground a hole in the ruins near Rosus statue. 4% drop chance from Greataxe-wielding Giant Beastman Skeletons.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Crumbling Farum Azula 4% drop chance from Greataxe-wielding Giant Skeletons with 100 Discovery. Farm_spot_executioner_greataxe_2.png|West of Church of Irith and Lake-Facing Cliffs grace. One crawls from the ground, 2 scythe skeletons are near. Farm_spot_executioner_greataxe_1.png|Near the tower building south-east of Raya Lucaria. Surrounded by many other skeletons. Farm_spot_executioner_greataxe_3.png|East of Church of Plague. Crawls from the ground a hole in the ruins near Rosus statue. 4% drop chance from Greataxe-wielding Giant Beastman Skeletons.
entries.description: Bulky cleaver welded to a long shaft. Said to have been used to dispatch the remnants of defeated enemies, felling them like timber. Perhaps that is the reason it excels at critical hits.

entries.name: Gargoyle's Black Axe
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Grand Lift of Rold (Forbidden Lands) Received upon defeating the Black Blade Kindred before the Grand Lift of Rold, along with the Gargoyle's Black Blades.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Grand Lift of Rold (Forbidden Lands) Received upon defeating the Black Blade Kindred before the Grand Lift of Rold, along with the Gargoyle's Black Blades.

entries.name: Gargoyle's Great Axe
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Altus Plateau Received upon defeating the Valiant Gargoyle enemy just north of the Outer Wall Phantom Tree grace located in Altus Plateau.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Altus Plateau Received upon defeating the Valiant Gargoyle enemy just north of the Outer Wall Phantom Tree grace located in Altus Plateau.
entries.description: Bronze greataxe wielded by Valiant Gargoyles. Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.

entries.name: Great Omenkiller Cleaver
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Perfumer's Grotto (Altus Plateau) / Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir) Received upon defeating the Omenkiller & Miranda the Blighted Bloom duo boss inside the Perfumer's Grotto in Altus Plateau. Dropped once by an Omenkiller in Volcano Manor, found by a bonfire behind a gate just before the bridge leading to the building with the Guest Hall Site of Grace.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Perfumer's Grotto (Altus Plateau) / Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir) Received upon defeating the Omenkiller & Miranda the Blighted Bloom duo boss inside the Perfumer's Grotto in Altus Plateau. Dropped once by an Omenkiller in Volcano Manor, found by a bonfire behind a gate just before the bridge leading to the building with the Guest Hall Site of Grace.
entries.description: The blade of this huge, loathsome cleaver comprises a row of amputated Omen horns. Weapon of slaughter wielded by Omenkillers. The hideous horns cause blood loss, adding vibrant colors to the ongoing mayhem.

entries.name: Greataxe
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Limgrave Found inside a carriage hauled by two Trolls that is heading south on the road west of the Waypoint Ruins in Limgrave. The carriage must be stopped before the chest can be opened, requiring at least one troll be either killed or incapacitated. These trolls will not pursue the Tarnished as they are chained to the Carriage and can only attack by stomping, which they will only do in response to being attacked, making hit-and-run tactics and ranged attacks very effective.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Limgrave Found inside a carriage hauled by two Trolls that is heading south on the road west of the Waypoint Ruins in Limgrave. The carriage must be stopped before the chest can be opened, requiring at least one troll be either killed or incapacitated. These trolls will not pursue the Tarnished as they are chained to the Carriage and can only attack by stomping, which they will only do in response to being attacked, making hit-and-run tactics and ranged attacks very effective.
entries.description: Greataxe akin to a huge lump of iron. Recognized as the weapon of choice of badland chieftains. Too heavy to be wielded by those of merely ordinary strength, blows from this axe will flatten enemies, and the force of its charged attack is a sight to be behold.

entries.name: Longhaft Axe
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Castle Morne (Weeping Peninsula) / Revenger's Shack (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Unsightly Catacombs & Leyndell, Royal Capital (Altus Plateau) / Cave of the Forlorn & Miquella's Haligtree (Consecrated Snowfield) / Scadu Altus 2% drop chance to drop from the larger, Scaly Misbegotten enemies that wield it. One can be found atop the pile of bodies in the Castle Morne courtyard. 1 easily reached Scaly Misbegotten (along with a Winged Misbegotten) can be found across a bridge to a tower just southwest of the Beside the Rampart Gaol Site of Grace in Castle Morne. 1 lonely Scaly Misbegotten by jumping down the cliffs west of the Behind the Castle Site of Grace in Castle Morne and then jumping off the edge of the tower to reach a bridge with some sleeping regular Misbegotten and the Scaly Misbegotten on the other side. 2 Scaly Misbegotten can be found in Village Windmill Pasture in Altus Plateau.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Castle Morne (Weeping Peninsula) / Revenger's Shack (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Unsightly Catacombs & Leyndell, Royal Capital (Altus Plateau) / Cave of the Forlorn & Miquella's Haligtree (Consecrated Snowfield) / Scadu Altus 2% drop chance to drop from the larger, Scaly Misbegotten enemies that wield it. One can be found atop the pile of bodies in the Castle Morne courtyard. 1 easily reached Scaly Misbegotten (along with a Winged Misbegotten) can be found across a bridge to a tower just southwest of the Beside the Rampart Gaol Site of Grace in Castle Morne. 1 lonely Scaly Misbegotten by jumping down the cliffs west of the Behind the Castle Site of Grace in Castle Morne and then jumping off the edge of the tower to reach a bridge with some sleeping regular Misbegotten and the Scaly Misbegotten on the other side. 2 Scaly Misbegotten can be found in Village Windmill Pasture in Altus Plateau.
entries.description: Large iron axe with a long handle. Weapon of the maltreated Misbegotten. Making use of the force generated by its length, this weapon's resentment-charged blows are difficult to stop.

entries.name: Putrescence Cleaver
entries.detailedLocation: Trade: Remembrance of Putrescence Trade the Remembrance of Putrescence with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.acquisition: Trade: Remembrance of Putrescence Trade the Remembrance of Putrescence with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.description: Weapon wielded by the Putrescent Knight. A great cleaver of hardened putrescence affixed to an arch fashioned from human bones. Gains power from the wielder's arcane attribute.

entries.name: Rusted Anchor
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Morne Tunnel (Weeping Peninsula) Dropped by the Scaly Misbegotten area boss in Morne Tunnel.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Morne Tunnel (Weeping Peninsula) Dropped by the Scaly Misbegotten area boss in Morne Tunnel.
entries.description: A rusty anchor wielded as a weapon. Each of its four flukes is thick and sharp, enabling piercing attacks. When the Tarnished left the Lands Between with their Lord, one boat alone was said to have been left behind.

entries.name: Winged Greathorn
entries.detailedLocation: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor, gained by defeating Regal Ancestor Spirit, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.acquisition: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor, gained by defeating Regal Ancestor Spirit, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.description: A unique horn in which the power of ancestral spirits fiercely dwells, this large, wing-shaped specimen is wielded as a weapon of spirit worship. In the ancestral spirit-worshipping faith, these are considered envoys' wings, made to reap the lives of beings which experience no sprouting.

entries.name: Club
entries.detailedLocation: Starting: Starting gear for the Wretch origin. Purchase: Limgrave Bought for 600 Runes from the Nomadic Merchant southeast of Coastal Cave, beneath the collapsed structure. Drop: Coastal Cave & Limgrave / Demi-Human Forest Ruins (Weeping Peninsula) / Lakeside Crystal Cave & Liurnia of the Lakes/ Volcano Cave (Mt. Gelmir) / Lux Ruins (Altus Plateau) / Shack of the Lofty (Mountaintops of the Giants) / Cerulean Coast 2% drop chance from Club-wielding Demi-Humans. 1 can be found just past the entrance to the Coastal Cave in Limgrave, near the merchant that also sells a Club. 2 club-wielders can be found among a group just south of the Scenic Isle Site of Grace in southern Liurnia.
entries.acquisition: Starting: Starting gear for the Wretch origin. Purchase: Limgrave Bought for 600 Runes from the Nomadic Merchant southeast of Coastal Cave, beneath the collapsed structure. Drop: Coastal Cave & Limgrave / Demi-Human Forest Ruins (Weeping Peninsula) / Lakeside Crystal Cave & Liurnia of the Lakes/ Volcano Cave (Mt. Gelmir) / Lux Ruins (Altus Plateau) / Shack of the Lofty (Mountaintops of the Giants) / Cerulean Coast 2% drop chance from Club-wielding Demi-Humans. 1 can be found just past the entrance to the Coastal Cave in Limgrave, near the merchant that also sells a Club. 2 club-wielders can be found among a group just south of the Scenic Isle Site of Grace in southern Liurnia.
entries.description: A thick, solid lump of wood. Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill. A simple, primitive weapon that requires only brute strength and persistence to hammer your foe into the ground.

entries.name: Curved Club
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes / Consecrated Snowfield / Mohgwyn Palace 2% drop chance from club-wielding Second-Generation Albinauric (their clubs are considerable larger than the actual weapon). 2 club-wielders can be found on a broken bridge east of Academy Gate Town's Site of Grace.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes / Consecrated Snowfield / Mohgwyn Palace 2% drop chance from club-wielding Second-Generation Albinauric (their clubs are considerable larger than the actual weapon). 2 club-wielders can be found on a broken bridge east of Academy Gate Town's Site of Grace.
entries.description: Hard, curved club, shaped like a crescent moon. Wielded instead of a curved sword by Albinaurics lacking dexterity. The only point of similarity between the two is the shape.

entries.name: Envoy's Horn
entries.detailedLocation: Dropped by the Oracle Envoy enemies that wield it. [[.
entries.acquisition: Dropped by the Oracle Envoy enemies that wield it. [[.

entries.name: Flowerstone Gavel
entries.primaryLocation: Grand Altar of Dragon Communion - Jagged Peak
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Grand Altar of Dragon Communion (Jagged Peak) The Flowerstone Gavel will be where the Dragon Communion Priestess once stood at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion after Bayle the Dread is defeated. WARNING: If the Dragon Communion Priestess is given Thiollier's Concoction, she will not drop this item. Instead the player will receive her spirit ash.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Grand Altar of Dragon Communion (Jagged Peak) The Flowerstone Gavel will be where the Dragon Communion Priestess once stood at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion after Bayle the Dread is defeated. WARNING: If the Dragon Communion Priestess is given Thiollier's Concoction, she will not drop this item. Instead the player will receive her spirit ash.
entries.description: Weapon of the Dragon Communion priestess. A dragonstone hammer resembling an ancient flower. The four petals and the flower's core are all sharp, ending in points, and are capable of dealing heavy damage to dragons.

entries.name: Hammer
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Leyndell, Royal Capital (Altus Plateau) The Hammer is located on the upper floor of the Fortified Manor, right next to the Sanctified Whetblade.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Leyndell, Royal Capital (Altus Plateau) The Hammer is located on the upper floor of the Fortified Manor, right next to the Sanctified Whetblade.
entries.description: Hammer comprised of a large stone affixed to a metal handle. Originally a blacksmith's tool. The art of smithing is said to have originated among the giants. This weapon's striking attacks boast ample weight behind them.

entries.name: Mace
entries.detailedLocation: Purchase: Roundtable Hold One is sold for runes 800 Runes by the Twin Maiden Husks.
entries.acquisition: Purchase: Roundtable Hold One is sold for runes 800 Runes by the Twin Maiden Husks.
entries.description: An iron bludgeon with sharp protrusions. Striking attacks have few drawbacks, potent as they are at breaking through guards and stances. Most suited to head on slugging matches.

entries.name: Marika's Hammer
entries.detailedLocation: Trade the Elden Remembrance, dropped by Elden Beast, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method). [[.
entries.acquisition: Trade the Elden Remembrance, dropped by Elden Beast, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method). [[.

entries.name: Monk's Flamemace
entries.detailedLocation: Chance to drop from Fire Monk enemies.
entries.acquisition: Chance to drop from Fire Monk enemies.

entries.name: Morning Star
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Weeping Peninsula (Limgrave) Found in a broken down black carriage south of Bridge of Sacrifice and Irina in the Weeping Peninsula region.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Weeping Peninsula (Limgrave) Found in a broken down black carriage south of Bridge of Sacrifice and Irina in the Weeping Peninsula region.
entries.description: Great hammer comprised of a globe attached to a handle. Though a bludgeon dealing strike damage, the appellative star is covered in spikes which cause blood loss. Ironic given its graceful name, this weapon often reeks of blood.

entries.name: Nox Flowing Hammer
entries.detailedLocation: Found on a corpse in Night's Sacred Ground, located in Nokron, Eternal City. It is found near the Mimic Tear Ashes. [[.
entries.acquisition: Found on a corpse in Night's Sacred Ground, located in Nokron, Eternal City. It is found near the Mimic Tear Ashes. [[.

entries.name: Ringed Finger
entries.detailedLocation: The Ringed Finger is found in a chest inside Gelmir Hero's Grave, located on Mt. Gelmir.
entries.acquisition: The Ringed Finger is found in a chest inside Gelmir Hero's Grave, located on Mt. Gelmir.
entries.description: Note: translated to English A hammer made from cutting off Judge Rykard's finger. Even after death, with Rykard's powerful magic, even a single finger is a powerful weapon.

entries.name: Scepter of the All-Knowing
entries.detailedLocation: Defeat Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing. [[.
entries.acquisition: Defeat Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing. [[.

entries.name: Spiked Club
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Limgrave / Weeping Peninsula / Mt. Gelmir 2% drop chance from slightly larger, club-wielding Demi-Humans. 1 large club-wielder can be found in the pit just past the entrance of Coastal Cave in Limgrave. 1 can be found just northeast of the Mistwood Outskirts Site of Grace in Limgrave. 1 club-wielder can be found northwest of the Fort Haight Site of Grace in Limgrave, at the ambush site on the road. 1 can be found just outside of Volcano Cave in Mt. Gelmir. Another 2 can be found inside of the Cave itself. 1 somewhat hard to find one can be found southwest of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace in Limgrave, near a Spiritspring, with another one patrolling east of Demi-Human Forest Ruins if one can jump across the gap to Weeping Peninsula.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Limgrave / Weeping Peninsula / Mt. Gelmir 2% drop chance from slightly larger, club-wielding Demi-Humans. 1 large club-wielder can be found in the pit just past the entrance of Coastal Cave in Limgrave. 1 can be found just northeast of the Mistwood Outskirts Site of Grace in Limgrave. 1 club-wielder can be found northwest of the Fort Haight Site of Grace in Limgrave, at the ambush site on the road. 1 can be found just outside of Volcano Cave in Mt. Gelmir. Another 2 can be found inside of the Cave itself. 1 somewhat hard to find one can be found southwest of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace in Limgrave, near a Spiritspring, with another one patrolling east of Demi-Human Forest Ruins if one can jump across the gap to Weeping Peninsula.
entries.description: A club with beast fangs wrapped around the striking end. The uneven spread of fangs causes blood loss. Given only to the toughest of demi-humans, this weapon is a badge of honor. Or so the demi-humans believe.

entries.name: Stone Club
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Academy Crystal Cave (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Sellia Hideaway (Caelid) / West Windmill Pasture (Altus Plateau) / Miquella's Haligtree Has a base 4% chance to drop from any Battlemage. A lone Battlemage can be found among the graves just outside of Sellia Hideaway. The simplest farming spot is just before the Haligtree Promenade Site of Grace in Miquella's Haligtree, where two Battlemages can be found.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Academy Crystal Cave (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Sellia Hideaway (Caelid) / West Windmill Pasture (Altus Plateau) / Miquella's Haligtree Has a base 4% chance to drop from any Battlemage. A lone Battlemage can be found among the graves just outside of Sellia Hideaway. The simplest farming spot is just before the Haligtree Promenade Site of Grace in Miquella's Haligtree, where two Battlemages can be found.
entries.description: Signature weapon of battlemages, hewn from hard glintstone. This club is much heavier than its size suggest, but has no magic power. So that they not lose sight of the true essence of combat, battlemages prefer to feel the impact of their blows, fighting their opponents hand to hand.

entries.name: Varré's Bouquet
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Mohgwyn Palace (Siofra River) Progress White Mask Varré's questline and then touch his invasion sign located just before the Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint Site of Grace. Defeat him in his world and then he'll be lying on the ground near where his invasion sign was. Talk to him and exhaust his dialogue, and then he'll drop Varré's Bouquet upon his death.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Mohgwyn Palace (Siofra River) Progress White Mask Varré's questline and then touch his invasion sign located just before the Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint Site of Grace. Defeat him in his world and then he'll be lying on the ground near where his invasion sign was. Talk to him and exhaust his dialogue, and then he'll drop Varré's Bouquet upon his death.
entries.description: A steel mace resembling a charming bouquet of roses. Each petal has a sharpened edge, leaving the roses perpetually colored with blood. This weapon reflects White Mask Varré's manner of speech rather well, enticing in its splendor, but full of deadly consequence.

entries.name: Warpick
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Limgrave / Weeping Peninsula / Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Altus Plateau / Deeproot Depths / Consecrated Snowfield / Miquella's Haligtree Soldier enemies of every faction that wield this weapon have a 2% drop rate for it. This includes Godrick Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Soldiers, Radahn Soldiers, Leyndell Soldiers, Mausoleum Soldiers, and Haligtree Soldiers.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Limgrave / Weeping Peninsula / Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Altus Plateau / Deeproot Depths / Consecrated Snowfield / Miquella's Haligtree Soldier enemies of every faction that wield this weapon have a 2% drop rate for it. This includes Godrick Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Soldiers, Radahn Soldiers, Leyndell Soldiers, Mausoleum Soldiers, and Haligtree Soldiers.
entries.description: Great hammer with a hard protruding beak. A pickaxe designed for combat, in essence. A simple but highly effective weapon, the weighty piercing attack casually rips through metal armor.

entries.name: Bastard's Stars
entries.detailedLocation: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Naturalborn, dropped by Astel, Naturalborn of the Void, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate a remembrance (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.acquisition: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Naturalborn, dropped by Astel, Naturalborn of the Void, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate a remembrance (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.description: Flail which deals magic damage, having been imbued with power by the remembrance of Astel. Formed of the same many-colored star debris that comprised the form of the Naturalborn of the Void.

entries.name: Chainlink Flail
entries.detailedLocation: Dropped by the Mad Pumpkin Head enemies that wield it. [[.
entries.acquisition: Dropped by the Mad Pumpkin Head enemies that wield it. [[.

entries.name: Family Heads
entries.detailedLocation: Received upon defeating Necromancer Garris, who is found behind an illusory wall inside the Sage's Cave, located in Altus Plateau.
entries.acquisition: Received upon defeating Necromancer Garris, who is found behind an illusory wall inside the Sage's Cave, located in Altus Plateau.

entries.name: Flail
entries.detailedLocation: Found at Gatefront Ruins, located in the black carriage furthest east from Gatefront's marker.
entries.acquisition: Found at Gatefront Ruins, located in the black carriage furthest east from Gatefront's marker.

entries.name: Nightrider Flail
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Weeping Peninsula Drop from the Night's Cavalry located in the Weeping Peninsula, found near the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace at night.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Weeping Peninsula Drop from the Night's Cavalry located in the Weeping Peninsula, found near the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace at night.
entries.description: A flail with two additional bludgeoning heads. Weapon of the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds. The large spikes make it highly effective at inducing blood loss, but also demand higher dexterity to wield.

entries.name: Serpent Flail
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Fog Rift Fort (Gravesite Plain) This weapon can be found inside a chest within Fog Rift Fort.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Fog Rift Fort (Gravesite Plain) This weapon can be found inside a chest within Fog Rift Fort.
entries.description: A flail with coiled snakes for bludgeoning heads. Fire roars within the snakes' bodies, inflicting horrible burns. Some of Messmer's army used these flails to burn hornsent—to brand them with agony and fear.

entries.name: Battle Hammer
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Leyndell, Royal Capital 4% chance to drop from hammer-wielding Grave Warden Duelists when defeated. WARNING: These enemies will stop spawning once Maliketh is defeated.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Leyndell, Royal Capital 4% chance to drop from hammer-wielding Grave Warden Duelists when defeated. WARNING: These enemies will stop spawning once Maliketh is defeated.
entries.description: Large iron great hammer designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike.

entries.name: Beastclaw Greathammer
entries.detailedLocation: Awarded by the Beast Clergyman for feeding him 7 Deathroot.
entries.acquisition: Awarded by the Beast Clergyman for feeding him 7 Deathroot.

entries.name: Black Steel Greathammer
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Church of Consolation (Gravesite Plain) A guaranteed drop from the Black Knight found at the Church of Consolation.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Church of Consolation (Gravesite Plain) A guaranteed drop from the Black Knight found at the Church of Consolation.
entries.description: Weapon of the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Greathammer of black steel with decorative embellishments in gold. Blessed with an Erdtree incantation. Further holy imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power. Guard Counters cause a burst of power.

entries.name: Brick Hammer
entries.detailedLocation: Found on a corpse in Stormveil Castle, near the area where you get trapped in a room with a Banished Knight. It is accessed by jumping across a gap.
entries.acquisition: Found on a corpse in Stormveil Castle, near the area where you get trapped in a room with a Banished Knight. It is accessed by jumping across a gap.

entries.name: Celebrant's Skull
entries.detailedLocation: From the Windmill Village site of grace, head northeast along a narrow ledge just below the village. Found on a corpse at the end of the path. [[.
entries.acquisition: From the Windmill Village site of grace, head northeast along a narrow ledge just below the village. Found on a corpse at the end of the path. [[.

entries.name: Cranial Vessel Candlestand
entries.detailedLocation: Mountaintops of the Giants, Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, behind the second imp statue in the dungeon. [[.
entries.acquisition: Mountaintops of the Giants, Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, behind the second imp statue in the dungeon. [[.
entries.description: Candlestand used in worship of Birac, the most hallowed Monk Prelate of the Giants' Flame. Concerned over the lazy arrogance with which the monks treated the Flame, Birac severed his own head as a lesson to the others, intending it to be used as a candlestand. His faith yet smolders from within the cranial vessel.

entries.name: Curved Great Club
entries.detailedLocation: Chance to drop from Albinauric enemies that wield it in Liurnia of the Lakes. [[.
entries.acquisition: Chance to drop from Albinauric enemies that wield it in Liurnia of the Lakes. [[.

entries.name: Devourer's Scepter
entries.detailedLocation: Received upon killing Knight Bernahl. This can be either at the Warmaster Shack in Limgrave, or in during his invasion in Farum Azula. [[.
entries.acquisition: Received upon killing Knight Bernahl. This can be either at the Warmaster Shack in Limgrave, or in during his invasion in Farum Azula. [[.

entries.name: Envoy's Long Horn
entries.detailedLocation: Large Oracle Envoys have a chance to drop this item. [[.
entries.acquisition: Large Oracle Envoys have a chance to drop this item. [[.

entries.name: Great Mace
entries.detailedLocation: Found inside a chest around the trebuchets before the Grand Lift of Dectus in Liurnia of the Lakes. [[.
entries.acquisition: Found inside a chest around the trebuchets before the Grand Lift of Dectus in Liurnia of the Lakes. [[.

entries.name: Great Stars
entries.detailedLocation: Found inside a wandering caravan near the Road of Iniquity Side Path grace located in Altus Plateau. As of patch 1.06, this weapon is also dropped by Magnus the Beast Claw upon defeat. [[.
entries.acquisition: Found inside a wandering caravan near the Road of Iniquity Side Path grace located in Altus Plateau. As of patch 1.06, this weapon is also dropped by Magnus the Beast Claw upon defeat. [[.

entries.name: Greathorn Hammer
entries.detailedLocation: Greathorn Hammer has a 2% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Warriors who wield it.
entries.acquisition: Greathorn Hammer has a 2% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Warriors who wield it.

entries.name: Large Club
entries.detailedLocation: Found on a corpse near a group of Demi-Human enemies south of the Forlorn Hound Evergaol, located in Limgrave.
entries.acquisition: Found on a corpse near a group of Demi-Human enemies south of the Forlorn Hound Evergaol, located in Limgrave.

entries.name: Pickaxe
entries.detailedLocation: Has a 2% drop chance from miners found in mining galleries throughout the Lands Between.
entries.acquisition: Has a 2% drop chance from miners found in mining galleries throughout the Lands Between.
entries.description: Large pickaxe designed to crack thick bedrock. Tool of sturdy miners. Not originally designed as a weapon, but very adept of piercing armor. "Little wretches, do you think your armor harder than stone?".

entries.name: Rotten Battle Hammer
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Consecrated Snowfield Dropped by a Rotten Duelist enemy located west of the Consecrated Snowfield grace.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Consecrated Snowfield Dropped by a Rotten Duelist enemy located west of the Consecrated Snowfield grace.
entries.description: Large iron great hammer designed for gladiatorial combat, now festering with scarlet rot. Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike.

entries.name: Smithscript Greathammer
entries.detailedLocation: The weapon can be found at Taylew's Ruined Forge.
entries.acquisition: The weapon can be found at Taylew's Ruined Forge.

entries.name: Anvil Hammer
entries.detailedLocation: This weapon can be found and obtained at Ruined Forge Lava Intake.
entries.acquisition: This weapon can be found and obtained at Ruined Forge Lava Intake.
entries.description: One of the treasures of the ruined forges. A tremendous hammer that incorporates as its head the red-hot anvil of the forge. It is said that the anvil's shape is inspired by that of an altar, and that long ago, it was indeed used as such in rite and ritual.

entries.name: Axe of Godfrey
entries.detailedLocation: Trade the Remembrance of Hoarah Loux, dropped by Hoarah Loux, Warrior, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method). [[.
entries.acquisition: Trade the Remembrance of Hoarah Loux, dropped by Hoarah Loux, Warrior, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method). [[.

entries.name: Bloodfiend's Arm
entries.detailedLocation: Drops from one of a group of Bloodfiends in Prospect Town, Gravesite Plain.
entries.acquisition: Drops from one of a group of Bloodfiends in Prospect Town, Gravesite Plain.
entries.description: Weapon used by the bloodfiends. An arm pulled from the corpse of one of their kin, and wielded as a makeshift weapon. Having been sanctified by a blood ritual, this armament is capable of spraying blood stored within when executing a strong attack.

entries.name: Devonia's Hammer
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Ancient Ruins of Rauh (Land of the Tower) Defeat Crucible Knight Devonia at the Ancient Ruins of Rauh. They drop their hammer along with the Crucible Hammer-Helm.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Ancient Ruins of Rauh (Land of the Tower) Defeat Crucible Knight Devonia at the Ancient Ruins of Rauh. They drop their hammer along with the Crucible Hammer-Helm.
entries.description: Great hammer wielded by Devonia, longest-serving of the Crucible Knights. Weapon forged of primordial gold, marked by its reddish hue and inhabited by ancient holiness. A torrent of life is engraved upon the striking face.

entries.name: Dragon Greatclaw
entries.detailedLocation: Dropped by the Draconic Tree Sentinel boss guarding the entrance to Leyndell, Royal Capital. [[.
entries.acquisition: Dropped by the Draconic Tree Sentinel boss guarding the entrance to Leyndell, Royal Capital. [[.

entries.name: Duelist Greataxe
entries.detailedLocation: Chance to drop from the Grave Warden Duelist enemies that wield it near the West Capital Rampart grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital. [[.
entries.acquisition: Chance to drop from the Grave Warden Duelist enemies that wield it near the West Capital Rampart grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital. [[.

entries.name: Envoy's Greathorn
entries.detailedLocation: Chance to drop from Giant Oracle Envoy enemies. [[.
entries.acquisition: Chance to drop from Giant Oracle Envoy enemies. [[.

entries.name: Fallingstar Beast Jaw
entries.detailedLocation: Acquired by defeating the Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast boss in a large crater on Mt. Gelmir, south of the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace.
entries.acquisition: Acquired by defeating the Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast boss in a large crater on Mt. Gelmir, south of the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace.

entries.name: Gazing Finger
entries.detailedLocation: The weapon can be obtained upon trading the Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.
entries.acquisition: The weapon can be obtained upon trading the Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.
entries.description: The head of Metyr, the finger-mother, wielded as a weapon without modification. From within the center of the fingerprint that wrinkles the creature's foremost protrusion, a tiny wart-like eye gazes vacantly into the beyond.

entries.name: Ghiza's Wheel
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir) Dropped by the Inquisitor Ghiza invader in the Volcano Manor.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir) Dropped by the Inquisitor Ghiza invader in the Volcano Manor.
entries.description: Great iron wheel lined with flesh-flaying blades. Device of torture used by Inquisitor Ghiza. As the wheel spins it causes severe pain and blood loss. The design was adopted for use as the iconic weapon wielded by Iron Virgins.

entries.name: Giant-Crusher
entries.detailedLocation: Found inside a carriage south of Outer Wall Phantom Tree grace, located in Altus Plateau. [[.
entries.acquisition: Found inside a carriage south of Outer Wall Phantom Tree grace, located in Altus Plateau. [[.

entries.name: Golem's Halberd
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Weeping Peninsula / Stormhill / Greyoll's Dragonbarrow / Liurnia of the Lakes / Capital Outskirts / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Leyndell, Ashen Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants 10% chance to drop from Guardian Golem enemies that wield it (5% from non-respawning ones).
entries.acquisition: Drop: Weeping Peninsula / Stormhill / Greyoll's Dragonbarrow / Liurnia of the Lakes / Capital Outskirts / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Leyndell, Ashen Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants 10% chance to drop from Guardian Golem enemies that wield it (5% from non-respawning ones).
entries.description: A great halberd of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Wielded by the Guardian Golem.

entries.name: Great Club
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Old Altus Tunnel (Altus Plateau) Received upon defeating the Stonedigger Troll located inside the Old Altus Tunnel. It requires two Stonesword Keys to access.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Old Altus Tunnel (Altus Plateau) Received upon defeating the Stonedigger Troll located inside the Old Altus Tunnel. It requires two Stonesword Keys to access.
entries.description: An enormous club of hard wood. Wildly hammering foes with this striking weapon requires no dexterity; only brute force. While it may seem sacrilegious, this weapon is said to be a withered branch of the Erdtree. Imbued with holy power, this weapon will never snap.

entries.name: Prelate's Inferno Crozier
entries.detailedLocation: Prelate's Inferno Crozier is dropped by a Fire Prelate in Fort Laiedd, west of the Volcano Manor on Mt. Gelmir. Prelate's Inferno Crozier will only drop one time in each playthrough. [[.
entries.acquisition: Prelate's Inferno Crozier is dropped by a Fire Prelate in Fort Laiedd, west of the Volcano Manor on Mt. Gelmir. Prelate's Inferno Crozier will only drop one time in each playthrough. [[.

entries.name: Rotten Greataxe
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Ordina, Liturgical Town (Consecrated Snowfield) Dropped by a Rotten Duelist north-west of Ordina, Liturgical Town, together with the Rotten Duelist Greaves.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Ordina, Liturgical Town (Consecrated Snowfield) Dropped by a Rotten Duelist north-west of Ordina, Liturgical Town, together with the Rotten Duelist Greaves.
entries.description: Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat, now festering with scarlet rot. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.

entries.name: Rotten Staff
entries.detailedLocation: Dropped by the Putrid Avatar/scarlet rot Erdtree Avatar patrolling the bridge in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. [[.
entries.acquisition: Dropped by the Putrid Avatar/scarlet rot Erdtree Avatar patrolling the bridge in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. [[.

entries.name: Shadow Sunflower Blossom
entries.detailedLocation: Trade: Finger Reader Enia Trade the Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower, gained by defeating the Scadutree Avatar, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.acquisition: Trade: Finger Reader Enia Trade the Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower, gained by defeating the Scadutree Avatar, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
entries.description: The head of a monstrous shadow sunflower manifestation of the Scadutree. Then again, it might be just a flower, wielded as a weapon. Much like the Scadutree itself in appearance, a second stalk winds tightly around the first, almost as if in a tender embrace. | JP= 影樹の化身たる巨大な影輪草の頭部 あるいは花を、そのまま武器としたもの そのあり様は影樹に似て 花付きの茎を支え、抱きしめるように もう一本の茎が絡み付いている.

entries.name: Staff of the Avatar
entries.detailedLocation: Dropped by an Erdtree Avatar near the Great Waterfall Crest grace located in Deeproot Depths. [[.
entries.acquisition: Dropped by an Erdtree Avatar near the Great Waterfall Crest grace located in Deeproot Depths. [[.

entries.name: Troll's Hammer
entries.detailedLocation: Found on a corpse inside Old Altus Tunnel, located in Mt. Gelmir. It requires two stonesword keys to access the tunnel.
entries.acquisition: Found on a corpse inside Old Altus Tunnel, located in Mt. Gelmir. It requires two stonesword keys to access the tunnel.

entries.name: Watchdog's Staff
entries.detailedLocation: Found behind an illusory wall inside Road's End Catacombs, located in Liurnia of the Lakes.
entries.acquisition: Found behind an illusory wall inside Road's End Catacombs, located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

entries.name: Bloodfiend's Fork
entries.detailedLocation: Random Drop: Prospect Town, Rivermouth Cave, Stone Coffin Fissure (Gravesite Plain), Rauh Base 3% chance of dropping from Bloodfiends who carry this item.
entries.acquisition: Random Drop: Prospect Town, Rivermouth Cave, Stone Coffin Fissure (Gravesite Plain), Rauh Base 3% chance of dropping from Bloodfiends who carry this item.
entries.description: Weapon used by the bloodfiends. Three tines of carved bone spear the victim to provoke blood loss. A ritual implement for blood offerings to the Formless Mother. At times, the bloodfiends will spill even their own blood using these forks. |JP_Name=血鬼のフォーク |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Bolt of Gransax
entries.detailedLocation: Located in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Exit the Erdtree Sanctuary and descend with the elevator, then jump over the street railing and down onto the building below. The spear is on top of its gigantic version. Warning: This item is not present in Leyndell, Ashen Capital. It must be obtained prior to defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.
entries.acquisition: Located in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Exit the Erdtree Sanctuary and descend with the elevator, then jump over the street railing and down onto the building below. The spear is on top of its gigantic version. Warning: This item is not present in Leyndell, Ashen Capital. It must be obtained prior to defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

entries.acquisition: Has a 0.5% drop rate from the Dominula Dancers wielding them in Dominula, Windmill Village, located in the north of Altus Plateau. [[.

entries.acquisition: The slow-moving Claymen enemies in the underground ruins of Siofra River and Ainsel River have a chance to drop this item. [[.

entries.detailedLocation: Cleanrot Knights have a chance to drop this item.

entries.detailedLocation: Found inside a chest behind an illusory wall in Sellia Hideaway, located in Caelid. [[.
entries.acquisition: Found inside a chest behind an illusory wall in Sellia Hideaway, located in Caelid. [[.

entries.name: Death Ritual Spear
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Mountaintops of the Giants Dropped by the Death Rite Bird on the Mountaintops of the Giants, found just southwest of Castle Sol. This is the only Death Rite Bird that is active all day, instead of only at night.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Mountaintops of the Giants Dropped by the Death Rite Bird on the Mountaintops of the Giants, found just southwest of Castle Sol. This is the only Death Rite Bird that is active all day, instead of only at night.
entries.description: Ritual spear used by priests of old who were permitted to come among the Deathbirds. The priests became guardians of the birds through the rite of Death, which also serves as an oath sworn to their distant resurrection.

entries.name: Inquisitor's Girandole
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir) Received upon defeating the Abductor Virgin duo boss in Volcano Manor. [[.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir) Received upon defeating the Abductor Virgin duo boss in Volcano Manor. [[.
entries.description: Instrument of torture used on nobles behind the curtain at the Volcano Manor of Mt. Gelmir. Its numerous spikes pierce the flesh, then singe the wounds with flame. The smell of burnt blood induces despair in the victim. A candlestick conceived by a thorough mind.

entries.name: Iron Spear
entries.detailedLocation: Dropped by the spear wielding Fallen Hawk Soldiers near the Nokron, Eternal City grace. [[.
entries.acquisition: Dropped by the spear wielding Fallen Hawk Soldiers near the Nokron, Eternal City grace. [[.

entries.name: Partisan
entries.detailedLocation: Can be dropped from Knight enemies that wield it, such as the Godrick Knight in the Gatefront Ruins in Limgrave, or the two Leyndell Knight near the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace in Mt. Gelmir.
entries.acquisition: Can be dropped from Knight enemies that wield it, such as the Godrick Knight in the Gatefront Ruins in Limgrave, or the two Leyndell Knight near the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace in Mt. Gelmir.

entries.name: Pike
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave) Found on a corpse inside Stormveil Castle, in the open area with flamethrower enemies.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave) Found on a corpse inside Stormveil Castle, in the open area with flamethrower enemies.
entries.description: A longspear featuring an especially lengthy handle. Specialized for use from long distances, it boasts the longest reach of any melee weapon. Incredibly useful even against foes on horseback, but hard to wield in cramped spaces.

entries.name: Rotten Crystal Spear
entries.detailedLocation: Dropped from the Putrid Crystalian enemies that wield it in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. [[.
entries.acquisition: Dropped from the Putrid Crystalian enemies that wield it in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. [[.

entries.name: Short Spear
entries.detailedLocation: Starting Equipment: 1 is part of the starting equipment of the Prophet origin. Purchase: Roundtable Hold 1 is sold for runes 600 Runes by the Twin Maiden Husks in Roundtable Hold. Loot: Lands Between / Realm of Shadow A base 4% chance to be dropped by the many Foot Soldiers that wield it in both the Lands Between and Realm of Shadow.
entries.acquisition: Starting Equipment: 1 is part of the starting equipment of the Prophet origin. Purchase: Roundtable Hold 1 is sold for runes 600 Runes by the Twin Maiden Husks in Roundtable Hold. Loot: Lands Between / Realm of Shadow A base 4% chance to be dropped by the many Foot Soldiers that wield it in both the Lands Between and Realm of Shadow.
entries.description: An exceedingly plain spear of modest weight. Simple to wield compared to many of its peers, its strong attack unleashes a series of successive piercing thrusts.

entries.name: Smithscript Spear
entries.detailedLocation: The weapon can be found at Ruined Forge of Starfall Past after looting a body on the main floor of said location.
entries.acquisition: The weapon can be found at Ruined Forge of Starfall Past after looting a body on the main floor of said location.
entries.description: Spear engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts. Execute a strong attack, a dashing strong attack, or a mounted strong attack to throw the spear.

entries.name: Spear

entries.description: Greatspear of the bloodfiend hexers. One of the most significant implements used in their blood rituals. Sacred spears of blood are the instruments of communion with an outer god. The mother of truth desires a wound. |JP_Name=血鬼の聖槍 |JP_Sourc=1.12.

entries.name: Lance

entries.acquisition: Loot: Limgrave Found on a corpse on a squarish ruin, northeast of the Warmaster's Shack.
entries.description: Considered a type of greatspear, this weapon has no blade, but instead features a long, conical body designed to pierce. Though heavy and hard to wield, this weapon displays its worth in horseback combat whether mounted or even on foot.

entries.acquisition: Drop: Realm of Shadow There is a base 2.00% chance where Messmer Soldiers can drop this weapon. Three wielding spears can be found at a camp to the west from Moorth Ruins site of grace.
entries.description: Weapon used by the soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. A greatspear with a steel blade worn from use. Being made for overwhelming onslaughts, attacks with this weapon can be charged to unleash consecutive strikes.

entries.description: Trident of Mohg, Lord of Blood. A sacred spear that will come to symbolize his dynasty. As well as serving as a weapon, it is an instrument of communion with an outer god who bestows power upon accursed blood. The mother of truth desires a wound.

entries.name: Serpent-Hunter
entries.detailedLocation: Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor) Loot: Can be picked up within the boss arena of Praetor Rykard. This item does not re-spawn when the player has one in either their inventory or chest, even in NG+. However it will re-spawn (and thus can be picked up again) from the same location should the player discard it. This is to make sure that the player always have the means of fighting Rykard with it. Because of this safeguard it is still possible to obtain duplicates of this weapon: Requirements: The player needs to not have a copy of it in their inventory. Rykard needs to still be alive. The game needs to be in online-mode. 1) Stand outside Rykard's arena and attempt to connect to another player's world through any means necessary. (Tarnished's Furled Finger, Duelist's Furled Finger, Bloody Finger, Recusant Finger, Festering Bloody Finger or Blue Cipher Ring) 2) When the game has successfully found a world it can try to connect to, enter Rykard's arena and pick up the Serpent-Hunter before the Loading Screen appears. 3) Leave the multiplayer session either by completing your objective or using the Finger Severer. 4) When you re-spawn back in your own world, do not fast travel or rest at the Sites of Grace, instead enter Rykard's arena again and you'll see the Serpent Hunter is still there, available to be picked up again for a second time. (Traveling or resting at the site of grace will make the game check if the Serpent-Hunter is in your inventory before it decides if it'll spawn in a new one for you to pick up) It's possible to obtain even more copies of this weapon if the player simply loops back to step 1 after finishing step 3.

entries.description: Weapon that serves as both greatsword and spear. Thought to have been used to hunt an immortal great serpent in the distant past, it manifests a long blade of light when facing such a creature. When their master's heroic aspirations degenerated into mere greed, his men searched for a weapon with which they might halt their lord.

entries.acquisition: Siluria's Tree is received upon defeating Crucible Knight Siluria at the Deeproot Depths.

Remade by the forging arts of the realm of shadow, this weapon can be thrown by executing a strong attack, dashing strong attack, or mounted strong attack. Charge the attack to produce flame on impact.

entries.description: A jet-black glaive with a blade as weighty as a bludgeon. Weapon of the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds. This glaive excels at weighty slash attacks that crash into foes, making it a powerful weapon even on horseback.

entries.acquisition: Chance to drop from Kindred of Rot enemies.

entries.acquisition: Trade: Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud Trade the Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.
entries.description: Weapon of Romina, Saint of the Bud. A scarlet glaive with a dangling bud-like blade. Attacks cause buildup of rot. Once, in the crumbling, burning church, Romina held the bud in speechless silence. That bud would become her blade.

entries.description: Hefty whip woven from the flame-red hair of a Fire Giant. Every giant is red of hair, and Radagon was said to have despised his own red locks. Perhaps that was a curse of their kind.

entries.name: Hoslow's Petal Whip
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Mountaintops of the Giants Dropped by Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood after invading him in the Mountaintops of the Giants for the final contract from Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Mountaintops of the Giants Dropped by Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood after invading him in the Mountaintops of the Giants for the final contract from Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress.
entries.description: Metal whip formed of razor-sharp chain-link blades that have the appearance of flower petals. This work of art is handed down through the generations of the illustrious House Hoslow. High dexterity is required to wield this weapon, but it excels at inflicting devastating blood loss. "The tale of House Hoslow is told in blood.".

entries.detailedLocation: Quest Reward: Patches The reward from Patches in Volcano Manor after defeating Great Horned Tragoth. He won't give it to the player the first time he is spoken too. Instead, the area has to be reloaded in some way (either via teleporting or by exiting and re-entering the game) and he can be spoken to again to gain the weapon. [[.

entries.description: This ritual implement is a three pronged candlestick with solid flames formed of the magma of Mt. Gelmir. When wielded as a weapon, the flames become supple whips of lava.

entries.name: Thorned Whip

entries.description: Hefty whip covered in crimson thorns. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. A device of fearsome religious encouragement, it is fashioned in the image of the briars of sin. Very effective at inflicting blood loss.

entries.name: Tooth Whip
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Whipping Hut (Scadu Altus) Pillaged from a corpse inside the whipping hut.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Whipping Hut (Scadu Altus) Pillaged from a corpse inside the whipping hut.
entries.description: Whip bestrewn with rotting, misshapen teeth. Filthy and seething with disease, the teeth are embedded in the whip and dose the victim with deadly poison upon each strike. As the wounds ripen they grow inflamed and ooze pus. The flesh of shamans was said to meld harmoniously with others. |JP_Name=歯の鞭 |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Urumi
entries.detailedLocation: Found on a corpse up on the rooftops of Caria Manor located in Liurnia of the Lakes.
entries.acquisition: Found on a corpse up on the rooftops of Caria Manor located in Liurnia of the Lakes.
entries.description: This weapon made of extremely thin, flexible blades of metal is wielded like a whip by Nightfolk warriors. Though in essence a whip with a cutting edge, it can also be used as a spear to pierce foes.

entries.name: Whip

entries.acquisition: Castle Morne: Inside the second prison cell area reached by dropping down onto a couple of beams. The room is filled with rats and a misbegotten.
entries.description: A leather whip. Not originally used for combat, but as an instrument of pain. Through its supple attacks cannot be thwarted by parrying or even guarding, it is incapable of dealing critical hits.

entries.description: One of the weapons originating from the Two Fingers. A formless sequence of ciphers comprise its blade, and as such no shield can repel it. Deals holy damage. The furtive inscription appears to hang in the air; the language of light spoken by the Two Fingers.

entries.description: The embodiment of the power that still remained in the dragon's head that was grafted to Godrick's left arm. The wielder's arm will take the form of a small dragon, sprouting sharp dragon fangs at the fist. This weapon cannot be two-handed.

entries.description: Iron manifer of spherical shape. Big Boggart the blackguard's weapon of choice. Not a weapon to be taken lightly, as its weighty blows shatter bones with ease.

entries.acquisition: Loot: Fort Gael (Caelid) Found inside a chest in Fort Gael.
entries.description: Imported dagger design with a rather unique handle. The blade can be swung about as the extension of one's fist.

entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Abyssal Woods Obtained from the killing the Madding Hand NPC in the Abyssal Woods, located south of the Woodland Trail Site of Grace.

Raises attack power when madness is triggered in the vicinity. Forged of an unyielding, black impulse toward revenge fostered in those who were hunted down as heretics by their own brethren, these are the weapons of the utterly downtrodden.

entries.acquisition: Quest reward & Loot: Enir-Ilim Recovered from Thiollier's body at the end of his questline.
entries.description: Concealed weapon used by Thiollier, of a design generally favored by poison-wielders for dark and subtle purposes. Like St. Trina, who blossomed in the deep-purple garden, a rich poison is secreted from within which sends its victims into an eternal sleep. |JP_Name=ティエリエの隠し針 |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Veteran's Prosthesis
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants) Dropped by Commander Niall upon his defeat at the end of Castle Sol.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants) Dropped by Commander Niall upon his defeat at the end of Castle Sol.
entries.description: Bladed prosthetic leg enwreathed with the power of lightning, instead attached to the fist. Commander Niall, veteran of Castle Sol, offered this prosthesis in exchange for the lives of the defeated knights held prisoner. He went on to lead these men as an army of no nation.

entries.name: Dane's Footwork
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower) Pillaged from Dane's corpse after successfully defeating the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower) Pillaged from Dane's corpse after successfully defeating the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.
entries.description: A technique for hand-to-hand combat without the aid of a weapon. This martial art focuses on kicking techniques. This kick-based martial art is unique to Dane, a Dryleaf and sworn ally of Leda. He acquired these skills by training with the aid of a waterfall; letting the water beat his body, and throwing himself into its basin. |JP_Name=ダン流蹴術 |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Dryleaf Arts
entries.detailedLocation: Quest Reward: Moorth Ruins (Scadu Altus) Obtained from defeating Dryleaf Dane in an honorable duel at the Moorth Ruins site of grace. To challenge Dane to a duel, retrieve the May the Best Win gesture from the Highroat Cross site of grace then perform the gesture to its completion in front of him. Note: Entering the Miquellan Loyalist bossfight once will make Dane permanently leave Moorth Ruins if he hasn't already been defeated there, thus making this item unavailable for the player to obtain on their own for the rest of the journey. Comes equipped with the Ash of War: Palm Blast.
entries.acquisition: Quest Reward: Moorth Ruins (Scadu Altus) Obtained from defeating Dryleaf Dane in an honorable duel at the Moorth Ruins site of grace. To challenge Dane to a duel, retrieve the May the Best Win gesture from the Highroat Cross site of grace then perform the gesture to its completion in front of him. Note: Entering the Miquellan Loyalist bossfight once will make Dane permanently leave Moorth Ruins if he hasn't already been defeated there, thus making this item unavailable for the player to obtain on their own for the rest of the journey. Comes equipped with the Ash of War: Palm Blast.
entries.description: A technique for hand-to-hand combat without the aid of a weapon. This martial art combines fist strikes and kicks. The teachings of a group of spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect, revealed only to those of worthy valor and character. The practice of this martial art marks the dawn of an ascetic's journey. |JP_Name=落葉格闘 |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Bloodhound Claws
entries.detailedLocation: Received after defeating a Bloodhound Knight inside Volcano Manor. [[.
entries.acquisition: Received after defeating a Bloodhound Knight inside Volcano Manor. [[.

entries.name: Claws of Night
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Finger Ruins of Miyr (Scadu Altus) Obtained from defeating the invading Swordhand of Night Anna on the approach to the hanging bell of the Finger Ruins.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Finger Ruins of Miyr (Scadu Altus) Obtained from defeating the invading Swordhand of Night Anna on the approach to the hanging bell of the Finger Ruins.
entries.description: Claws of a bottomless black from which no light can escape. Wielded by Anna, Swordhand of Night. Engraved with a smithscript enabling strong attack to launch all three claws at a target. The blades are only semicorporeal, and cannot be fully guarded against. |JP_Name=夜の爪 |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Hookclaws
entries.detailedLocation: Found on a corpse in Stormveil Castle, near the Stormveil Cliffside grace.
entries.acquisition: Found on a corpse in Stormveil Castle, near the Stormveil Cliffside grace.

entries.name: Raptor Talons
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Sage's Cave (Altus Plateau) Found inside Sage's Cave. They can be found inside a chest just beyond a room containing four skeletons, hidden behind an Illusory Wall.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Sage's Cave (Altus Plateau) Found inside Sage's Cave. They can be found inside a chest just beyond a room containing four skeletons, hidden behind an Illusory Wall.
entries.description: Claw comprised of two sharp, thin blades. Wielded by the assassins of ravenmount, this weapon allows them to imitate the attacks of Deathbirds. Besides excelling at airborne attacks, its charge attack mimics the vicious swoop of a bird of prey.

entries.name: Venomous Fang
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Abandoned Cave (Caelid) Found on a corpse inside the Abandoned Cave located in Caelid.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Abandoned Cave (Caelid) Found on a corpse inside the Abandoned Cave located in Caelid.
entries.description: One of the weapons designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. The black fang protruding from the bronze snake head is coated in deadly poison.

entries.name: Beast Claw (weapon)
entries.detailedLocation: This weapon is dropped from Logur the Beast Claw, in the southern area of Gravesite Plains, on the way to the Church of Consolation from the Gravesite Plain site of grace. Comes equipped with the Ash of War: Savage Claws by default.
entries.acquisition: This weapon is dropped from Logur the Beast Claw, in the southern area of Gravesite Plains, on the way to the Church of Consolation from the Gravesite Plain site of grace. Comes equipped with the Ash of War: Savage Claws by default.

entries.name: Red Bear's Claw
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Northern Nameless Mausoleum (accessed through Rauh Base) Acquired from defeating the Red Bear NPC bossfight in the Northern Nameless Mausoleum.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Northern Nameless Mausoleum (accessed through Rauh Base) Acquired from defeating the Red Bear NPC bossfight in the Northern Nameless Mausoleum.
entries.description: Claw of a great red bear wielded without modification by Red Bear, whose name is lost to madness. After killing the great red bear in a blood-soaked bout, he became fascinated by the untainted glory of its naked strength. "I wish to be a bear, no more, and no less." |JP_Name=赤熊の爪 |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Chilling Perfume Bottle
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Lamenter's Gaol (Charo's Hidden Grave) Located in a room guarded by a restless Jar Innards enemy. The room can be reached after opening the first locked door of the gaol using the Upper Gaol Key, descending down the first ladder and arriving into a room with the frozen floor, where a Jar Innards enemy will come running out of a door to the right. This item is in that room.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Lamenter's Gaol (Charo's Hidden Grave) Located in a room guarded by a restless Jar Innards enemy. The room can be reached after opening the first locked door of the gaol using the Upper Gaol Key, descending down the first ladder and arriving into a room with the frozen floor, where a Jar Innards enemy will come running out of a door to the right. This item is in that room.
entries.description: Perfume bottle remade into a weapon by perfumers of the realm of shadow. Attacks release perfumed powder, producing an icy chill. From time to time, perfumers set out on journeys to pursue new aromatics and flower gardens. |JP_Name=冷気の調香瓶 |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Deadly Poison Perfume Bottle
entries.detailedLocation: Purchase: Gravesite Plain Can be acquired from Thiollier for runes 6000. If this item was not bought from Thiollier before he moves from his first location, then it can alternatively be bought from Moore for runes 6000. Can alternatively be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for runes 6000 after giving them Moore's bell bearing, after he has acquired Thiollier's stock. This item can be missed if Thiollier's quest ends prematurely before the player can buy it from him and if Moore is killed should he invade the player for killing two members of the forager brood.
entries.acquisition: Purchase: Gravesite Plain Can be acquired from Thiollier for runes 6000. If this item was not bought from Thiollier before he moves from his first location, then it can alternatively be bought from Moore for runes 6000. Can alternatively be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for runes 6000 after giving them Moore's bell bearing, after he has acquired Thiollier's stock. This item can be missed if Thiollier's quest ends prematurely before the player can buy it from him and if Moore is killed should he invade the player for killing two members of the forager brood.
entries.description: Perfume bottle customized by Thiollier. Attacks release perfumed powder, producing deadly poison. There are some techniques of the perfuming arts that employ poison. Upon learning of this, Thiollier threw himself into mastering those techniques, and he made them his own. |JP_Name=猛毒の調香瓶 |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Firespark Perfume Bottle
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Gravesite Plain Acquired from a chest in the southeastern corner of the military encampment by the Castle Front site of grace.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Gravesite Plain Acquired from a chest in the southeastern corner of the military encampment by the Castle Front site of grace.
entries.description: Perfume bottle remade into a weapon by perfumers of the realm of shadow. Attacks release perfumed powder, producing sparks of fire. The crusade was a violent purge, and the perfumers were not called there to heal. |JP_Name=火花の調香瓶 |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Frenzyflame Perfume Bottle
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Abandoned Church (Abyssal Woods) Pillaged from a seated corpse located by the northern wall of the Church Ruins.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Abandoned Church (Abyssal Woods) Pillaged from a seated corpse located by the northern wall of the Church Ruins.
entries.description: Perfume bottle remade into a weapon by perfumers of the realm of shadow. Attacks release perfumed powder, producing frenzied flame. From time to time, perfumers set out on journeys to pursue new aromatics and flower gardens. |JP_Name=狂い火の調香瓶 |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Lightning Perfume Bottle
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Gravesite Plain Found in a small pond surrounded by Lightning Sheep southeast of the Ellac River Downstream site of grace / northeast of the Cerulean Coast site of grace.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Gravesite Plain Found in a small pond surrounded by Lightning Sheep southeast of the Ellac River Downstream site of grace / northeast of the Cerulean Coast site of grace.
entries.description: Perfume bottle remade into a weapon by perfumers of the realm of shadow. Attacks release perfumed powder, producing lightning. From time to time, perfumers set out on journeys to pursue new aromatics and flower gardens. |JP_Name=雷の調香瓶 |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Bone Bow
entries.primaryLocation: Land of the Tower - Belurat, Tower Settlement
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Belurat, Tower Settlement (Land of the Tower) Found at the bottom floor of the tower with the spiraling staircase, located at the northwestern edge of the settlement. It is guarded by two giant Spider Scorpions.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Belurat, Tower Settlement (Land of the Tower) Found at the bottom floor of the tower with the spiraling staircase, located at the northwestern edge of the settlement. It is guarded by two giant Spider Scorpions.
entries.description: A crude shortbow fashioned from sickly bone. A medium for spirit-calling, and a product of the ancient hexing arts of the tower. |JP_Name=骨の弓 |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Composite Bow
entries.detailedLocation: Purchase: Bellum Church (Liurnia of the Lakes) 1 is sold for runes 3500 runes by a Nomadic Merchant just down an incline north of Bellum Church, located in northern Liurnia of the Lakes.
entries.acquisition: Purchase: Bellum Church (Liurnia of the Lakes) 1 is sold for runes 3500 runes by a Nomadic Merchant just down an incline north of Bellum Church, located in northern Liurnia of the Lakes.
entries.description: Bow composited from a mix of materials. Demands high attributes, and is tricky to wield, but is a fearsome tool when mastered.

entries.name: Harp Bow
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Altus Plateau Found on top of a cliff east of Sainted Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau. Requires having examined the "Champion's Song" Painting just inside the northeastern section of the wall around Shaded Castle.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Altus Plateau Found on top of a cliff east of Sainted Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau. Requires having examined the "Champion's Song" Painting just inside the northeastern section of the wall around Shaded Castle.
entries.description: Bow fashioned from a minstrel's harp. Sonorous tones still resound when firing arrows. Troubadours sing tales of champions, both in the honorable service of the Erdtree, and the one who spurns honor for blasphemy.

entries.name: Misbegotten Shortbow
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Weeping Peninsula / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Cave of the Forlorn & Miquella's Haligtree (Consecrated Snowfield) 2% drop chance from Winged Misbegotten enemies. A group of 3 can be found just southeast of the Ailing Village Outskirts Site of Grace in Weeping Peninsula, along the cliffs. 2 can be found on one of the small towers connected to the Beside the Rampart Gaol Site of Grace in Castle Morne. 6 or so Winged Misbegotten can be found in an unmarked camp east of the Altus Plateau Site of Grace.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Weeping Peninsula / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Cave of the Forlorn & Miquella's Haligtree (Consecrated Snowfield) 2% drop chance from Winged Misbegotten enemies.
