entries.description: Shortbow wielded by Winged Misbegotten. Fine fur clings to it. Designed to inflict additional damage by sacrificing range.

entries.name: Red Branch Shortbow
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Tombsward Ruins (Weeping Peninsula) / Academy of Raya Lucaria & Caria Manor (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Redmane Castle (Caelid) / Shaded Castle & Leyndell, Royal Capital (Altus Plateau) / Castle Ensis (Gravesite Plain) 4% chance to drop from Pages and Noble Pages. 2 regular Pages can be found in the underground part of Tombsward Ruins. 3 regular Pages can be found on the stairs leading up to the Royal Moongazing Grounds Site of Grace in Caria Manor 1 Noble Page can be found in one of the side chapels reached with the ladder to the second floor in the Church of the Cuckoo in Academy of Raya Lucaria. 1 Noble Page can be found down a set of stairs just south of the West Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital. This enemy is not found in Ashen Capital.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Tombsward Ruins (Weeping Peninsula) / Academy of Raya Lucaria & Caria Manor (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Redmane Castle (Caelid) / Shaded Castle & Leyndell, Royal Capital (Altus Plateau) / Castle Ensis (Gravesite Plain) 4% chance to drop from Pages and Noble Pages. 2 regular Pages can be found in the underground part of Tombsward Ruins. 3 regular Pages can be found on the stairs leading up to the Royal Moongazing Grounds Site of Grace in Caria Manor 1 Noble Page can be found in one of the side chapels reached with the ladder to the second floor in the Church of the Cuckoo in Academy of Raya Lucaria. 1 Noble Page can be found down a set of stairs just south of the West Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital. This enemy is not found in Ashen Capital.
entries.description: Shortbow of polished red wood. Fashioned by a master craftsman and wielded by pages. A bow which requires dexterity rather than strength to master.

entries.name: Shortbow
entries.detailedLocation: Starting equipment: 1 is part of the starting equipment for the Bandit origin. Purchase: Limgrave 1 is sold for runes 600 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant found beneath a collapsed structure just southeast of Coastal Cave. Drop: Weeping Peninsula / Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Mountaintops of the Giants / Scadu Altus 2% drop chance from bow-wielding Marionette Soldiers. A few are found scattered around Witchbane Ruins, along with some spear-wielding Marionette Soldiers.
entries.acquisition: Starting equipment: 1 is part of the starting equipment for the Bandit origin. Purchase: Limgrave 1 is sold for runes 600 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant found beneath a collapsed structure just southeast of Coastal Cave. entries.description: A small bow for firing arrows from a distance. Other than its ability to fire off arrows in rapid succession, it is also well-suited for use on horseback. To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.

entries.name: Albinauric Bow
entries.detailedLocation: Chance to drop from Albinauric Archer enemies. [[.
entries.acquisition: Chance to drop from Albinauric Archer enemies. [[.

entries.name: Ansbach's Longbow
entries.detailedLocation: Quest Reward / Guaranteed Drop: Specimen Storehouse (Shadow Keep) Obtained from either assisting Ansbach or Leda in their confrontation at Specimen Storehouse.
entries.acquisition: Quest Reward / Guaranteed Drop: Specimen Storehouse (Shadow Keep) Obtained from either assisting Ansbach or Leda in their confrontation at Specimen Storehouse.
entries.description: Weapon of Sir Ansbach. A longbow consisting of two bow bodies and two strings. Unusually for a longbow, it can be wielded similarly to a light bow—provided that the wielder has the extraordinary dexterity demanded. |JP_Name=アンスバッハの長弓 |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Black Bow
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Leyndell, Royal Capital (Altus Plateau) Found on a corpse on the rooftops of lower Leyndell, Royal Capital. The rooftops be accessed by going down the stairs from the Avenue Balcony Site of Grace, jumping over a railing to the right and climbing a series of stairs to the northeast. The Black Bow can then be found on a corpse on a southwestern roof. WARNING: If Maliketh is defeated before the Black Bow is acquired it will become unavailable for that character until a new Journey is started.

entries.description: Longbow carved from black wood to resemble a blade. One of the most difficult bows to master. The blade-like body of the bow is light and cuts through the air. Though a longbow, it can be wielded similarly to a shortbow.

entries.name: Erdtree Bow
entries.detailedLocation: Found inside a chest that can be accessed by going on the rooftops near the Erdtree Sanctuary grace, located in Leyndell, Royal Capital. [[.
entries.acquisition: Found inside a chest that can be accessed by going on the rooftops near the Erdtree Sanctuary grace, located in Leyndell, Royal Capital. [[.

entries.name: Horn Bow
entries.detailedLocation: Found on a corpse in the area below Hallowhorn Grounds in the Siofra River region.
entries.acquisition: Found on a corpse in the area below Hallowhorn Grounds in the Siofra River region.

entries.name: Longbow
entries.detailedLocation: Part of Samurai origin's starting equipment. Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 1,200 Runes. Dropped by Skeletons wielding the longbow.
entries.acquisition: Part of Samurai origin's starting equipment. Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 1,200 Runes. Dropped by Skeletons wielding the longbow.

entries.name: Pulley Bow
entries.detailedLocation: Found on a corpse up a tower near the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace. [[.
entries.acquisition: Found on a corpse up a tower near the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace. [[.
entries.description: Longbow which utilizes a series of pulleys and strings. The complex mechanism, which required advanced mathematical and mechanical understand to craft, was likely made by a certain genius who learned Golden Order fundamentalism. Enhances precision while shooting, enabling arrows to fly much further distances.

entries.name: Serpent Bow
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Abandoned Cave (Caelid) Found inside the Abandoned Cave by a pool of Scarlet Rot.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Abandoned Cave (Caelid) Found inside the Abandoned Cave by a pool of Scarlet Rot.
entries.description: Malformed bow in the shape of a pair of poisonous snakes. Imbues arrows with poison through pagan magic, revealing its true worth when used with poison-infused arrows. Used by assassins known as the Formless Serpents.

entries.name: Erdtree Greatbow
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Fringefolk Hero's Grave (Limgrave) Received when destroying the Chariot in the Hero's Grave, along with 10 Great Arrows. The Chariot is destroyed by dropping one of 3 massive urns on top of it. Doing this requires a ranged weapon and some ammunition, which should then be fired as the Chariot is turning around, signified by the screen shaking and a rumbling sound being made. If all 3 urns miss the dungeon will have to be reset by resting at a Site of Grace. The overlook to the Chariot is reached by dropping down a hole in the Grave's main path, and then afterwards in a room with a bridge the Tarnished will have to drop to the bottom of that room to then take an elevator to the overlook, guarded by a Dragon Communion-wielding Banished Knight.

entries.description: Greatbow featuring Erdtree styling. In times of old, when faith and battle went hand in hand, this weapon was created in tandem with the Golden Great Arrow. Scales all arrow damage with faith, revealing its true worth when used with holy-infused arrows.

entries.name: Golem Greatbow
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Weeping Peninsula / Stormhill / Greyoll's Dragonbarrow / Liurnia of the Lakes / Capital Outskirts / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Leyndell, Ashen Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants / Scadu Altus / Charo's Hidden Grave 10% chance to drop from Guardian Golem enemies that wield it (5% from non-respawning ones). One Golem Archer can be found just before the break in the middle of the bridge to the Divine Tower of Limgrave, and though two regular Golems are in the way they are slow enough that it's still generally possible to kill the Archer before they can catch up. A Golem Archer can be found just to the right if taking the Grand Lift of Dectus to Altus Plateau, though a non-Archer Golem will be found on the other side of the path which can complicated killing the Archer. Two Golem Archers can be found on the path from Deep Siofra Well to Caelid Colosseum. The lift up from the well requires two Stonesword Keys to activate and these Archer Golems are the only ones in the game that can drop Golem's Magic Arrows.

entries.description: Greatbow of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Weapon of the Guardian Golem. Extremely heavy, this greatbow requires enormous strength just to draw, suggesting it was not designed for human use.

entries.name: Greatbow
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Altus Plateau Found inside a chest on top of the Highway Lookout Tower in northern Altus, just on the border to the Capital Outskirts. Drop: Altus Plateau / Deeproot Depths Has a 4% chance to drop from Greatbow-wielding Leyndell Knights, Haligtree Knights, Mausoleum Knights, and Redmane Knights (non-spectral only) found throughout the Lands Between and Greatbow-wielding Black Knights in the Realm of Shadow. A single Greatbow-wielding Leyndell Knight can be found just east-northeast of the Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace in Altus Plateau, guarded by two Leyndell Foot Soldiers. The single living Redmane Knight with a Greatbow is found when approaching Fort Gael, up on a small cliff and guarded by Radahn Soldiers, Radahn Foot Soldiers, and a Flame Chariot.

Drop: Altus Plateau / Deeproot Depths Has a 4% chance to drop from Greatbow-wielding Leyndell Knights, Haligtree Knights, Mausoleum Knights, and Redmane Knights (non-spectral only) found throughout the Lands Between and Greatbow-wielding Black Knights in the Realm of Shadow. entries.description: Enormous greatbow larger than any man. Can not be drawn with any ordinary level of strength, but the force of its shots is extraordinary. A greatbow can only fire great arrows.

entries.name: Igon's Greatbow
entries.detailedLocation: Quest Reward / Guaranteed Drop: Gravesite Plain / Jagged Peak Acquired from Igon's corpse after either completing his questline or killing him at any of his possible locations. This item may come with Ash of War: Igon's Drake Hunt already attached only if the player choses to fulfill Igon's questline. Killing him to obtain this weapon early will prevent the player from acquiring the ash of war on their own until their next Journey.

entries.description: Weapon of Igon, the broken drake warrior. A greatbow fashioned from two dragon bones bound with coarse rope. Covered in gashes left by claws. Imbued with Igon's obsession, enhancing the power of Igon's Harpoon. |JP_Name=エーゴンの大弓 |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Lion Greatbow
entries.detailedLocation: Trade: Remembrance of the Starscourge Trade the Remembrance of the Starscourge with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough either way).
entries.acquisition: Trade: Remembrance of the Starscourge Trade the Remembrance of the Starscourge with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough either way).
entries.description: Greatbow of black iron wielded by General Radahn. Decorated with a lion motif. Imbued with gravitational power of the Starscourge, when used along with Radahn's Spear, it becomes a true weapon of a champion.

entries.name: Arbalest
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave) Found inside Stormveil Castle, near the explosive ballista shooting enemies. The quickest path to the Arbalest is through the Rampart Tower Site of Grace. Jump down and enter the room that has a fog wall that can only be broken with a Stonesword Key. After exiting that room, take a right and climb up the ladder on the wall, continue upon the path and climb up another ladder. Run past or defeat the two Banished Knights, cross the wooden bridge, and jump where they see an Exile Soldier manning a ballista. There will be a small gap separating the rocky outcrop from a castle rampart. Jump the gap, and the Arbalest will be on a corpse behind another Exile Soldier.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave) Found inside Stormveil Castle, near the explosive ballista shooting enemies. The quickest path to the Arbalest is through the Rampart Tower Site of Grace. Jump down and enter the room that has a fog wall that can only be broken with a Stonesword Key. After exiting that room, take a right and climb up the ladder on the wall, continue upon the path and climb up another ladder. Run past or defeat the two Banished Knights, cross the wooden bridge, and jump where they see an Exile Soldier manning a ballista. There will be a small gap separating the rocky outcrop from a castle rampart. Jump the gap, and the Arbalest will be on a corpse behind another Exile Soldier.
entries.description: Large crossbow made from composite materials. One of the largest of all bolt-firing devices. Its limbs are more pliable than metallic ones, allowing bolts fired from this weapon to pierce even helms forged of steel.

entries.name: Crepus's Black-Key Crossbow
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Roundtable Hold Found behind a fog wall that requires 1 Stonesword Key to open inside the Roundtable Hold. This door is reached by going down a flight of stairs in the eastern wing, past Smithing Master Hewg, and then turning around. Found alongside 20 Black-Key Bolts.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Roundtable Hold Found behind a fog wall that requires 1 Stonesword Key to open inside the Roundtable Hold. This door is reached by going down a flight of stairs in the eastern wing, past Smithing Master Hewg, and then turning around. Found alongside 20 Black-Key Bolts.
entries.description: Black crossbow featuring a long stock. Used for sniping, it has a very long range. Weapon of Crepus, who served the Two Fingers from the shadows of the Roundtable as the head confessor.

entries.name: Full Moon Crossbow
entries.primaryLocation: Academy of Raya Lucaria - Liurnia of the Lakes
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes) Found inside a chest up a tower on the rooftops of Raya Lucaria.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes) Found inside a chest up a tower on the rooftops of Raya Lucaria.
entries.description: One-of-a-kind enchanted crossbow of exquisitely detailed craftmanship. Made to celebrate the matrimonial union, and reconciliation, between the houses of the Erdtree and the Full Moon, Leyndell and Raya Lucaria. The two rings dance when reloading the weapon. Reveals true worth when used with holy-infused bolts.

entries.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Greyoll's Dragonbarrow / Deeproot Depths / Altus Plateau / Miquella's Haligtree / Gravesite Plain / Scadu Altus 2% drop chance from crossbow-wielding Soldier enemies: Godrick Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Soldiers, Radahn Soldiers, Mausoleum Soldiers, Leyndell Soldiers, Haligtree Soldiers, and Messmer Soldiers. 3 crossbow-wielding Godrick Soldiers can be found just northwest of Gatefront Ruins, standing on the sides of the path. Another crossbow-wielder can be found much further up the path, though it generally isn't worth including when farming. More crossbow-wielding Godrick Soldiers can be found on the sides of the path leading to the Castleward Tunnel Site of Grace outside of Stormveil Castle, though that situation is more messy when it comes to farming. Messmer Soldiers technically only have a 1.99% drop chance.

entries.description: Heavy crossbow with iron limbs, increasing damage dealt. Commonly employed in the Shattering.

entries.name: Light Crossbow
entries.detailedLocation: Purchase: Weeping Peninsula 1 is sold for runes 1,500 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant at the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace, north of Castle Morne itself.
entries.acquisition: Purchase: Weeping Peninsula 1 is sold for runes 1,500 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant at the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace, north of Castle Morne itself.
entries.description: Ranged weapon made from a bow fixed to a stock. Deals good damage and is simple to use, but requires reloading after firing. Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.

entries.name: Pulley Crossbow
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Craftsman's Shack (Mt. Gelmir) Found on a corpse near the Craftsman's Shack Site of Grace, on top of the wooden platforms just outside.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Craftsman's Shack (Mt. Gelmir) Found on a corpse near the Craftsman's Shack Site of Grace, on top of the wooden platforms just outside.
entries.description: Crossbow made with pulleys and power springs. The complex mechanism, which required advanced mathematical and mechanical understanding to craft, was likely made by a certain genius who learned Golden Order fundamentalism. One touch fires a volley of bolts. Be warned; large stores of bolts can be quickly spent.

entries.name: Repeating Crossbow
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Scadu Altus Found alongside the road just south of the Ghostflame Dragon north of the Moorth Highway, South Site of Grace and southwest of Moorth Ruins.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Scadu Altus Found alongside the road just south of the Ghostflame Dragon north of the Moorth Highway, South Site of Grace and southwest of Moorth Ruins.
entries.description: A mechanized crossbow that has been fitted with a fan-shaped contraption. This metallic piece adds a reloading system used in the execution of a unique battle art. |JP_Name=連弩 |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Soldier's Crossbow
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Weeping Peninsula / Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Scadu Altus / Shadow Keep 4% drop chance from crossbow-wielding Foot Soldiers: Godrick Foot Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Foot Soldiers, Leyndell Foot Soldiers, and Messmer Foot Soldiers. There are two easily farmed Godrick Foot Soldiers on the cliff overlooking the Saintsbridge Site of Grace, east of the Deathtouched Catacombs. Radahn- and Haligtree-aligned Foot Soldiers do not wield crossbows and thus do not drop this weapon. Loot: Stormveil Castle / Castle Sol 2% drop chance from crossbow-wielding Exile Soldiers. Though it is inadvisable to farm them due to their lower drop rate there is one somewhat farmable Exile Soldier standing on a platform southwest of the Limgrave Tower Bridge Site of Grace, on the main path to the Grace from the Castle's main entrance.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Weeping Peninsula / Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Scadu Altus / Shadow Keep 4% drop chance from crossbow-wielding Foot Soldiers: Godrick Foot Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Foot Soldiers, Leyndell Foot Soldiers, and Messmer Foot Soldiers. entries.description: A crossbow of simple make, usable by anyone, but lacking in both power and accuracy. Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.

entries.name: Spread Crossbow
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Gravesite Plain Pillaged from a corpse in a small ruined campsite by the cliffs facing Ellac River, south of the Castle Front military encampment. From the site of grace, circle around the tall mesa to the south and drop down to a low ledge with three Messmer Soldiers.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Gravesite Plain Pillaged from a corpse in a small ruined campsite by the cliffs facing Ellac River, south of the Castle Front military encampment. From the site of grace, circle around the tall mesa to the south and drop down to a low ledge with three Messmer Soldiers.
entries.description: A modified crossbow made by combining two crossbows into one. Capable of loading multiple bolts and firing them simultaneously, enabling a spread of fire. |JP_Name=散弾クロスボウ |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Hand Ballista
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Forest Lookout Tower (Weeping Peninsula) Found in a chest on top of the Forest Lookout Tower in the Weeping Peninsula, located southwest of the Bridge of Sacrifice from Limgrave.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Forest Lookout Tower (Weeping Peninsula) Found in a chest on top of the Forest Lookout Tower in the Weeping Peninsula, located southwest of the Bridge of Sacrifice from Limgrave.
entries.description: An unconventional ballistic device modelled on a weapon used to besiege castles. Only capable of firing greatbolts. Perfect for reckless acts such as storming a castle or facing an entire army alone.

entries.name: Jar Cannon
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Volcano Cave (Mt. Gelmir) Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Margot inside of Volcano Cave.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Volcano Cave (Mt. Gelmir) Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Margot inside of Volcano Cave.
entries.description: Jar cannon which uses explosives to fire greatbolts. Deals great damage but is slow to reload. Experimental firearm brought to the assault on Volcano Manor, where it was discovered that no one knew how to use it.

entries.name: Rabbath's Cannon
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Rabbath's Rise (Scadu Altus) Found in the study of Rabbath's Rise. Can be accessed by ascending using a nearby Sealed Spiritspring or by descending down the rise from the cliffs southeast of Shaman Village.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Rabbath's Rise (Scadu Altus) Found in the study of Rabbath's Rise. Can be accessed by ascending using a nearby Sealed Spiritspring or by descending down the rise from the cliffs southeast of Shaman Village.
entries.description: A type of jar cannon used to fire greatbolts. A masterwork of Spellmachinist Rabbath. The power of the glintstones that encircle the barrel imbues bolts with magic damage and guides shots toward their targets. |JP_Name=ラバスの大砲 |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Academy Glintstone Staff
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Liurnia of the Lakes Dropped by Thops, either by killing him in the Church of Irith or upon finishing his questline, inside the Academy of Raya Lucaria just before the Schoolhouse Classroom site of grace. Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes/Caelid/Mt. Gelmir 2% drop chance from Glintstone Sorcerers (excluding the Lazuli variant). These Sorcerers are common enemies throughout Academy of Raya Lucaria, with 7 in particular being found on the way to the Red Wolf of Radagon from the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace, along with a Lazuli Sorcerer and a Living Jar Warrior. Two Sorcerers can be found just next to the Primeval Sorcerer Azur Site of Grace, just north of Hermit Village. Several more can be found throughout Academy Crystal Cave and Sellia Hideaway.

Gelmir Found together with the Albinauric Mask in the same room as an Omenkiller, located on the third floor of the same building as the Guest Hall Site of Grace, located in Volcano Manor. This room is accessed by jumping onto a balcony from the roof of the building. The balcony is located to the right of the building when looking towards the main entrance on the second floor.

entries.acquisition: Equipped: Starting equipment for the Astrologer origin. Purchase: Liurnia of the Lakes 1x sold by the Nomadic Merchant at the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace for 800 runes Runes.
entries.description: Staff of the astrologers. A glintstone is embedded in the tip, enabling it to be used as a catalyst for sorceries. Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.

entries.name: Azur's Glintstone Staff
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Liurnia of the Lakes Found in a secluded room on the highest level of the Church of the Cuckoo, accessed via the rooftops of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. From the Debate Parlor site of grace, go outside to the left until you meet two Glintstone Sorcerers. Jump down on the stairs next to them. Continue forward until you can jump onto the rooftops. Then, proceed further and go up the ladder at the end of said rooftops. After the sorcerer, go down on the rooftops again, until you can see a dome-like structure that has windows. Go through one of the windows, and descend onto the lower floor. One of the exits leads to a enclosed bridge, with a High Page guarding the secluded room. The staff is in the room behind him, in front of an inactive Graven Mass.

The chest is on a raised platform hidden by an illusory wall, which in turn is found to the left just after the door to the room with the Battlemage/fog wall to the boss. Entering the cave requires 2 Stonesword Keys.

Sellia Crystal Tunnel is the earliest farming spot for the staff, though Can also be found in Altus Tunnel and Sellia Hideaway. 4% drop chance from large Glintstone Miners. One is found towards the end of Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel, another towards the end of Sellia Hideaway.

entries.description: Staff of Count Ymir, who made himself a Mother of Fingers. Carried for want of tail-fingers of his own. Enhances finger sorceries. The crystal ball, though representative of a microcosm, would not receive any sign.

entries.name: Meteorite Staff
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Caelid Found inside a broken tower with Miranda Sprouts in the southwestern part of Street of Sages Ruins, in the northwestern corner of the Swamp of Aeonia.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Caelid Found inside a broken tower with Miranda Sprouts in the southwestern part of Street of Sages Ruins, in the northwestern corner of the Swamp of Aeonia.
entries.description: Staff embedded with a dark purple glintstone, said to be the fragment of a meteorite. Boasts high sorcery scaling and boosts gravity sorceries as well. However, this staff cannot be strengthened in any way.

Gelmir and Guardians' Garrison in Mountaintops of the Giants.

entries.name: Clawmark Seal
entries.detailedLocation: Quest Reward: Dragonbarrow (Caelid) Received after feeding 1 Deathroot to Gurranq, Beast Clergyman inside the Bestial Sanctum.
entries.acquisition: Quest Reward: Dragonbarrow (Caelid) Received after feeding 1 Deathroot to Gurranq, Beast Clergyman inside the Bestial Sanctum.
entries.description: Sacred seal granted by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman. A rare trinket which allows incantions to be scaled with strength. The claw mark represents Gurranq's wrath. Enhances bestial incantations learned from Gurranq.

entries.name: Dragon Communion Seal
entries.detailedLocation: Dropped by a spectral Banished Knight located in the Fringefolk Hero's Grave in Limgrave. To find it, start at the Stranded Graveyard Site of Grace and head down the first two ramps in the Grave, then head right in the split to go up another two ramps. The Knight is inside a small room at the end of the ramp and is quite tough for the early game. The Chariot in the dungeon can be used to help kill it, though that comes at considerable risk to the player as well.
entries.acquisition: Dropped by a spectral Banished Knight located in the Fringefolk Hero's Grave in Limgrave. To find it, start at the Stranded Graveyard Site of Grace and head down the first two ramps in the Grave, then head right in the split to go up another two ramps. entries.description: Formless drakeblood seal with a dragon communion crest. Enhances Dragon Communion incantations. The sacrificial devouring of the heart gives power. Indeed, Dragon Communion is too primal in nature for the term "incantation" to be appropriate. This seal scales incantations with one's arcane attribute.

entries.name: Dryleaf Seal
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Recluses' River (Scadu Altus) Found on one of the cliffs facing the river north of Recluses' River Downstream site of grace.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Recluses' River (Scadu Altus) Found on one of the cliffs facing the river north of Recluses' River Downstream site of grace.
passiveEffects: Boosts golden ring of light incantations.
entries.description: Sacred seal of the spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect. Enhances incantations of Miquella. Those who saw the decline of the Erdtree in the fallen leaves long ago braced themselves for the weakening of Order, and embraced a strict faith. And then, they made to serve a new god. |JP_Name=落葉の聖印 |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Erdtree Seal

Can also be found by starting at the Guest Hall Site of Grace and backtracking to the top floor of the building, before exiting it across the bridge and taking a right through the large gate to find a bonfire. The Seal is in one of the cells there.

entries.description: A sacred seal bestowed by a Finger Maiden which serves as a catalyst for casting sacred incantations. Incantations must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a sacred seal must be equipped to cast them.

entries.name: Fire Knight's Seal
entries.primaryLocation: Shadow Keep, Church District - Shadow Keep
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Shadow Keep, Church District (Shadow Keep) After draining the water from the district, this item can be found on the floor behind the decapitated statue of Marika inside the largest church in the district. It is guarded by Wego, Fire Knight Elder along with his putrid corpse summons.

It is guarded by Wego, Fire Knight Elder along with his putrid corpse summons.
entries.description: Sacred seal of the Fire Knights, who answer directly to Messmer the Impaler. Enhances fire incantations of Messmer. The emblem of Messmer's army depicts a golden ring and the fire of his sacred seal. |JP_Name=火の騎士の聖印 |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Leyndell, Royal Capital/Leyndell, Ashen Capital) Received by completing Lightseeker Hyetta's questline by accepting the blessing of the Three Fingers and then touching her.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Leyndell, Royal Capital/Leyndell, Ashen Capital) Received by completing Lightseeker Hyetta's questline by accepting the blessing of the Three Fingers and then touching her.
entries.description: Formless sacred seal bestowed by the maiden of the Three Fingers. Enhances incantations of the frenzied flame. This seal is the mark of the Lord of Frenzied Flame. Scales incantations using strength, dexterity, intelligence and faith all together.

entries.name: Giant's Seal
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Mountaintops of the Giants Found near a Fire Prelate enemy inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, reached by taking an elevator down and then sending it up again, then pulling the elevator's lever to ride down another floor using a hidden compartment and then finally climbing up a ladder to the left to find the room.

entries.description: Sacred seal depicting the one-eyed god of the Fire Giants, adorned with braids of red hair. Sacred seal wielded by Fire Monks and Prelates, this catalyst enhances Giant's Flame incantations.

entries.name: Godslayer's Seal
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Stormveil Castle Found inside a chest behind a fog wall that requires 1 Stonesword Key to open. The cellar entrance can be found to the left in the castle courtyard (the one just before the Liftside Chamber Site of Grace) if entered via the main gate and is guarded over by four rats.

entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Gravesite Plain (through Rauh Base) Reward from "The Sacred Tower" Painting, which can be acquired from interacting with a painting found in a cave, northeast of the Scorched Ruins. The player can only acquire this item after having burned the Sealing Tree past the Church of the Bud. After which the painter (and thus this item) can be found on the edge of a cliff south of the Northern Nameless Mausoleum.

entries.name: Beast-Repellent Torch
entries.detailedLocation: Purchase: Dragonbarrow 1x sold for runes 1,200 Runes by the Isolated Merchant at the Isolated Merchant's Shack in north-west Dragonbarrow, Caelid.
entries.acquisition: Purchase: Dragonbarrow 1x sold for runes 1,200 Runes by the Isolated Merchant at the Isolated Merchant's Shack in north-west Dragonbarrow, Caelid.

entries.name: Ghostflame Torch
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Siofra River Found on a corpse on the rooftops near the entrance of Nokron, Eternal City. This section of rooftops can only be accessed when entering through the crater in Limgrave (only accessible after deating Starscourge Radahn). After that, proceed to the parapets of Nokron and make a running jump to the right from the first pillar or first parapet and then another running jump to a platform with the torch.

entries.description: Metal torch that burns with cold ghostflame. Tool of the Fallen Hawks who prowl the underground rivers. When the band's last embers were used up in their long search, they began to burn the bones of their fellows, acquiring the cold ghostflame, but sealing their fate as dwellers of the underground for all eternity.

entries.name: Lamenting Visage
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Lamenter's Gaol (Gravesite Plain) Can be found by starting from the pit with Living Jar Warriors and the Gaol Lower Level Key is, then climbing back up the way into the pit taking the first door on the left, and then going through the illusory wall at the end of the small corridor and opening a locked door with the aforementioned key.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Lamenter's Gaol (Gravesite Plain) Can be found by starting from the pit with Living Jar Warriors and the Gaol Lower Level Key is, then climbing back up the way into the pit taking the first door on the left, and then going through the illusory wall at the end of the small corridor and opening a locked door with the aforementioned key.
passiveEffects: Can be raised up when equipped in the left hand, illuminating more of the surrounding area.
entries.description: A stone lantern carved to resemble a lamenting human head, the eyes vacantly beaming out light. Can be raised up when equipped in the left hand, illuminating more of the surrounding area. The unusual expression somehow imparts a sense of contentment. The languid ease of one who needs not sight.

entries.name: Nanaya's Torch
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Abyssal Woods Found on a body inside of Midra's Manse. From the Midra's Library Site of Grace head west and jump across the rafters and bookcases to reach the northern wall and then continue west. Note that this requires pulling a lever to raise a bookcase at the end. To reach this lever, drop down west of the Midra's Library Site of Grace and then turn around to find a room with a painting that's also an illusory wall. Behind this painting is a ladder leading up to the lever.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Abyssal Woods Found on a body inside of Midra's Manse. entries.description: A torch made by attaching a dying flame of frenzy to a small spinal column. In a distant land, in an age long past, was born a man who failed to become the Lord of Frenzied Flame. All that remains of him is cradled gently by Nanaya.

entries.name: Sentry's Torch
entries.detailedLocation: Purchase: Capital Outskirts 1x sold for runes 7,000 Runes by the Hermit Merchant at Hermit Merchant's Shack. More precisely, found north of the first rampart of the capital and by the northern wall, alternatively far west of the Minor Erdtree in the Capital Outskirts.

entries.description: Torch given to protectors of the Erdtree. Its flames are bestowed with a special incantation which allows the bearer to see assassins cloaked in veils. Furnished on behalf of the Erdtree and the Grace-Given Lord such that a Night of the Black Knives will never come again.

entries.name: St. Trina's Torch
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Consecrated Snowfield Found inside one of the Troll-drawn Carriages in the southeast of the Snowfield, northeast of the Consecrated Snowfield Site of Grace and west of the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs Sites of Grace. The other Carriage contains the Flowing Curved Sword, and at night they are guarded by a duo of Night's Cavalry.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Consecrated Snowfield Found inside one of the Troll-drawn Carriages in the southeast of the Snowfield, northeast of the Consecrated Snowfield Site of Grace and west of the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs Sites of Grace. entries.name: Steel-Wire Torch
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Weeping Peninsula Found at Castle Morne along the northern side of the castle, top level. It's on a body at the end of a narrow path, guarded by two Misbegotten. To reach this spot from the beginning, start at the Castle Morne Lift Site of Grace and enter the castle. Then, run up the pile of bodies in the courtyard to enter a room and then climb up the ladder on the other side. Finally, take a left to find the narrow piece of battlement with the torch.

entries.description: Small wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a true metal shield. The design is said to represent the stars of the night sky, portending fate.

entries.name: Buckler
entries.detailedLocation: Equipped: One is part of the starting gear for the Bandit class. Purchase: Stormveil Castle One is sold for runes 1,500 Runes by Gatekeeper Gostoc.
entries.acquisition: Equipped: One is part of the starting gear for the Bandit class. Purchase: Stormveil Castle One is sold for runes 1,500 Runes by Gatekeeper Gostoc.
entries.description: A small metal roundshield. The bump in the center is designed to parry. A well-timed parry deflects an enemy's attack, breaking their stance and leaving them open to a critical hit. Though risk is inherent, this shield favors aggression.

entries.name: Coil Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Volcano Cave (Mt. Gelmir) From the cave's Site of Grace, take the right path when the cave splits, then fall down one drop and then turn around rather than falling down further. Following this path leads to a smaller section with the shield and 3 Arteria Leaves.

entries.name: Gilded Iron Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Church of Pilgrimage (Weeping Peninsula) Found on a corpse in the small graveyard west of the Church. It's on the westernmost grave, reached in an almost straight line west from the Sacred Tear in the church.

Continue following the wall instead of going up the stairs and you will eventually reach an item on a rocky outcropping near a Sorcery Scarab and a gathering of Fingercreepers. That stand-alone item is the shield.

entries.description: An ordinary small roundshield made of metal. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation. Finely balanced, this shield is easy to use.

One can be found just outside of the Guest Hall Site of Grace. 3.03% drop chance from the Magma Blade-and-shield-wielding Manserpents found in the Manor. Though it has a lower drop chance than other sword-wielding Manserpents, it's possible to farm this shield and the Magma Blade by taking the elevator just outside of Temple of Eiglay Site of Grace kill the two Serpents there (one straight ahead, the other to the right through the doorway).

entries.name: Shield of Night
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Bonny Gaol (Scadu Altus) Recovered from a body lying on a guillotine-table. Located on a somewhat hidden floor of the gaol. To reach this floor, the player must progress through the dungeon until they reach a jar-elevator that has already begun to move on its own. This elevator will first descend down to a stone bridge (which, when followed, will progress towards the end of the dungeon) before automatically ascending back up again. Jumping back onto the jar-elevator as it ascends and staying on it until it reaches the top will eventually take the player to the section where this item can be found.

entries.name: Shield of the Guilty

The cellar entrance is inside of the southernmost ruin, visible behind through hole in a wall behind some branches, and requires jumping over the wall (preferably with Torrent, but it's possible to climb the northwest wall to get in without him) to get into the building section to enter.

entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Crumbling Farum Azula 2% drop chance from the sword-and-shield and throwing knife variants of Beastman of Farum Azula. One sword-and-shield Beastman can be found just after the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths Site of Grace, along with a dog.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Crumbling Farum Azula 2% drop chance from the sword-and-shield and throwing knife variants of Beastman of Farum Azula. One sword-and-shield Beastman can be found just after the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths Site of Grace, along with a dog.
entries.description: Shield fashioned from a tall broken jar carried by the beastmen of Farum Azula. There is a particular knack to wielding it. The beastmen have always fired earthenware jars for the express purpose of making shields. Such are their ways, strange though they are.

entries.name: Black Leather Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Purchase: Caria Manor (Liurnia of the Lakes) One is sold for runes 2,500 Runes by Pidia.
entries.acquisition: Purchase: Caria Manor (Liurnia of the Lakes) One is sold for runes 2,500 Runes by Pidia.

entries.name: Blue Crest Heater Shield

entries.acquisition: Equipment: One is part of the starting gear for the Confessor Origin. Purchase: Bellum Highway (Liurnia of the Lakes) One is sold for runes 1,500 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant (Northern Liurnia) just north of Bellum Church.

entries.name: Brass Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Limgrave / Weeping Peninsula / Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Deeproot Depths / Altus Plateau / Mt. Gelmir / Miquella's Haligtree 2% drop chance from any Godrick Soldier, Raya Lucaria Soldier, Radahn Soldier, Mausoleum Soldier, Leyndell Soldier, or Haligtree Soldier that happens to be wielding it. Four of the Godrick Soldiers at Gatefront Ruins carry the shield. One is wandering on the road south of the Grace, another sits at a bonfire just south of the previous one, and the final two are at another bonfire, just north of the second soldier. Two shield-wielding Mausoleum Soldiers can be found just outside the southern entrance to the Fourth Church of Marika. Another three are wandering down the hill from the Church.

Two shield-wielding Mausoleum Soldiers can be found just outside the southern entrance to the Fourth Church of Marika. Another three are wandering down the hill from the Church.
entries.description: On the larger side for medium-sized shield, the face has been covered in brass. Commonly employed in the Shattering.

entries.name: Candletree Wooden Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Sage's Cave (Altus Plateau) Found inside one of 4 chests found behind an illusory wall halfway through the cave. The illusory wall is on the left, flanked by two braziers, after dropping down a ledge just after passing the first waterfall.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Sage's Cave (Altus Plateau) Found inside one of 4 chests found behind an illusory wall halfway through the cave. The illusory wall is on the left, flanked by two braziers, after dropping down a ledge just after passing the first waterfall.

entries.name: Carian Knight's Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes) Dropped by Moongrum, Carian Knight. As the shield is automatically awarded after his death, an easy way to earn the shield is to rush past Moongrum to the elevator and take it up so that he falls down the hole underneath it.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes) Dropped by Moongrum, Carian Knight. entries.name: Eclipse Crest Heater Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Minor Erdtree (Weeping Peninsula) Found on a corpse atop a large stone archway protruding from a cliff northwest of the Minor Erdtree. Halfway down one of the stone pillars just northwest of the Tree are two stone hexagons connected by a stone bridge. Dropping down the northwest side of the northern hexagon leads to a ledge with the corpse. <!--.

entries.name: Golden Lion Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Quest Reward: Specimen Storehouse (Shadow Keep) Received from Freyja by the Storehouse, Seventh Floor site of grace, after having given her the "Letter for Freyja" key item, which in of itself can be acquired from Sir Ansbach after giving him the Secret Rite Scroll.
entries.acquisition: Quest Reward: Specimen Storehouse (Shadow Keep) Received from Freyja by the Storehouse, Seventh Floor site of grace, after having given her the "Letter for Freyja" key item, which in of itself can be acquired from Sir Ansbach after giving him the Secret Rite Scroll.
entries.description: Shield made to resemble a fierce golden lion with a luxuriant mane. Awarded to especially valorous members of Radahn's personal guard on the occasion of its formation. |JP_Name=黄金獅子盾 |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Great Turtle Shell
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Weeping Peninsula Found atop the tower to the south of Oridys's Rise. Only reachable by using the spiritspring near the Nomadic Merchant at the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace to jump to the top of the tower.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Weeping Peninsula Found atop the tower to the south of Oridys's Rise. Only reachable by using the spiritspring near the Nomadic Merchant at the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace to jump to the top of the tower.
entries.description: Shield fashioned from a great turtle shell. The natural curve helps it contend with foes' attacks. The turtle is a symbol of tirelessness, and this shield boosts stamina recovery speed.

entries.name: Hawk Crest Wooden Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Location: Stormveil Castle Found in room that requires a Stonesword Key to open, near the Grafted Scion and the elevator shortcut back up to the Rampart Tower Site of Grace. This is the same room as the one that has the Miséricorde and Iron Whetblade. <!--.

entries.description: A medium-sized metal shield, comparatively easy to handle. Metal shields reliably negate physical damage when guarding, a trait which made them highly trusted on the battlefield.

entries.detailedLocation: Equipment: One is part of the starting gear for the Hero Origin. Purchase: Church of Elleh (Limgrave) One is sold for runes 600 Runes by Merchant Kalé. <!--.

entries.name: Marred Leather Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Stormveil Castle Located halfway up the wooden walkway to the side entrance of the castle that Gostoc recommends, found just after the Stormveil Cliffside Site of Grace.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Stormveil Castle Located halfway up the wooden walkway to the side entrance of the castle that Gostoc recommends, found just after the Stormveil Cliffside Site of Grace.

entries.name: Marred Wooden Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Stormveil Castle Drop down the north side of the tower on the left on the wall north of the Rampart Tower Site of Grace, then continue dropping down until a broken, thorned tower is reached with the shield.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Stormveil Castle Drop down the north side of the tower on the left on the wall north of the Rampart Tower Site of Grace, then continue dropping down until a broken, thorned tower is reached with the shield.
entries.description: Wooden shield of Stormveil soldiers. Much like the castle, it is marred by mottling and thorns. Some say it is the curse of grafting which causes such affliction, while others talk of its root being something altogether more sinister hidden deep within the castle.

entries.name: Messmer Soldier Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Random Drop: Realm of Shadow 2% chance of dropping from Messmer Soldiers who carry this item.
entries.acquisition: Random Drop: Realm of Shadow 2% chance of dropping from Messmer Soldiers who carry this item.
entries.description: Worn roundshield carried by soldiers loyal to Messmer, the Impaler. The largest of all metal shields in their class. |JP_Name=メスメル兵の盾 |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Red Crest Heater Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Purchase: Altus Plateau One is sold for runes 2,500 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant just north of the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge Site of Grace, or southwest of the Minor Erdtree in Altus Plateau.
entries.acquisition: Purchase: Altus Plateau One is sold for runes 2,500 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant just north of the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge Site of Grace, or southwest of the Minor Erdtree in Altus Plateau.

entries.acquisition: Purchase: Altus Plateau One is sold for runes 2,000 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant just north of the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge Site of Grace, or southwest of the Minor Erdtree in Altus Plateau.

entries.name: Serpent Crest Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Gravesite Plain Reward from "Incursion" Painting, which can be acquired from interacting with the painting found in the Artist's Shack located on the cliffs southeast of Prospect Town. Once the painting has been acquired, the player can then find the painter (and thus this item) southwest of the lake west of the Abandoned Ailing Village, on a small hill facing the natural stone bridge to Belurat, Tower Settlement.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Gravesite Plain Reward from "Incursion" Painting, which can be acquired from interacting with the painting found in the Artist's Shack located on the cliffs southeast of Prospect Town. Once the painting has been acquired, the player can then find the painter (and thus this item) southwest of the lake west of the Abandoned Ailing Village, on a small hill facing the natural stone bridge to Belurat, Tower Settlement.
entries.description: A finely-made "redshield" featuring an engraving of a winged serpent. Excels at guarding against fire. Said to have been made to commemorate the beginnings of the crusade started by Messmer, son of Marika. |JP_Name=蛇紋章の盾 |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Silver Mirrorshield
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Apostate Derelict (Consecrated Snowfield) Found at the back of the building, next to Phillia, Towering Little Sister.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Apostate Derelict (Consecrated Snowfield) Found at the back of the building, next to Phillia, Towering Little Sister.

entries.name: Sun Realm Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Capital Outskirts / Crumbling Farum Azula 2% drop chance from red-caped Skeletons and shield-wielding Beast Skeletons. Two easily farmable Skeletons of this type can be found besides the road from the Saintsbridge Site of Grace to Summonwater Village. Starting at Summonwater Village Outskirts Site of Grace is also possible. The graveyards at the Church of the Plague and Hermit Merchant's Shack also contain these skeletons.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Capital Outskirts / Crumbling Farum Azula 2% drop chance from red-caped Skeletons and shield-wielding Beast Skeletons. entries.name: Twinbird Kite Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Capital Outskirts (Altus Plateau) Dropped by the Deathbird that appears at the eastern top of the hill east of the Hermit Merchant's Shack at night, just west of the nearby Minor Erdtree. Be wary of the Skeletal Snails that accompany it.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Capital Outskirts (Altus Plateau) Dropped by the Deathbird that appears at the eastern top of the hill east of the Hermit Merchant's Shack at night, just west of the nearby Minor Erdtree. Be wary of the Skeletal Snails that accompany it.
passiveEffects: Increases Attack and Defense when at low HP.
entries.description: Shield featuring a vividly painted twinbird. The twinbird is said to be the envoy of an outer god, and mother of the Deathbirds. At dwindling levels of HP, this shield slightly boosts both attack and defense.

entries.name: Wolf Crest Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Castle Ensis (Gravesite Plain) Found in a hidden room down some stairs west of the courtyard where Moonrithyll, Carian Knight can be fought. Can alternatively be reached after dropping down from the ledge where Glintblade Trio can be found.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Castle Ensis (Gravesite Plain) Found in a hidden room down some stairs west of the courtyard where Moonrithyll, Carian Knight can be fought. Can alternatively be reached after dropping down from the ledge where Glintblade Trio can be found.
entries.description: A finely-made "blueshield" featuring an engraving of a wolf under the moon. Excels at fending off sorceries. The wolf is the beast of the Carian royal covenant; a symbol of the moon's pride that none can forget, no matter what remote lands they may arrive in. |JP_Name=狼紋章の盾 |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Ant's Skull Plate
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Nokstella, Eternal City Can be found in a chest in a small room at the beginning of Nokstella, Eternal City. From the Nokstella, Eternal City Site of Grace, heading up the stairs just to the west of the Grace there is a room with a treasure chest to the south on the first landing that contains this Greatshield.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Nokstella, Eternal City Can be found in a chest in a small room at the beginning of Nokstella, Eternal City. From the Nokstella, Eternal City Site of Grace, heading up the stairs just to the west of the Grace there is a room with a treasure chest to the south on the first landing that contains this Greatshield.
entries.description: Huge head of one of the giant ants which inhabit the two underground rivers, used without modification as a shield. Excels at repelling enemy attacks. Giant ants are venomous creatures, granting a boost to immunity when wielding this shield.

entries.name: Black Steel Greatshield
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Fog Rift Fort (Gravesite Plain) Dropped by Black Knight Garrew, who can be found patrolling the southern ramparts of the Fog Rift Fort.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Fog Rift Fort (Gravesite Plain) Dropped by Black Knight Garrew, who can be found patrolling the southern ramparts of the Fog Rift Fort.
entries.description: Weighty shields carried by the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Made of black steel with decorative embellishments in gold. Symbolic of their iron conviction in their crusade, the Black Knights will never yield. Nor will they ever doubt their purpose. |JP_Name=黒鉄の大盾 |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Briar Greatshield
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: The Shaded Castle (Altus Plateau) Dropped by Elemer of the Briar at the top of Shaded Castle.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: The Shaded Castle (Altus Plateau) Dropped by Elemer of the Briar at the top of Shaded Castle.
entries.description: Greatshield from a foreign land, used by Elemer of the Briar. Attacks with this armament utilize the iron thorns that have been wound around its frame. Originates from Eochaid, a land of proudly solitary ascetics.

entries.name: Crossed-Tree Towershield
entries.detailedLocation: Purchase: Altus Plateau Purchased from the Nomadic Merchant near the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge Site of Grace in central Altus Plateau for 3800 Runes. This location is southeast of the Altus Plateau Minor Erdtree.
entries.acquisition: Purchase: Altus Plateau Purchased from the Nomadic Merchant near the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge Site of Grace in central Altus Plateau for 3800 Runes. This location is southeast of the Altus Plateau Minor Erdtree.
entries.description: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Emblazoned with an old, interleaving tree. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.

entries.name: Crucible Hornshield
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Siofra Aqueduct The Crucible Hornshield is received upon defeating the Crucible Axe Knight at the Siofra Aqueduct, near the Aqueduct-Facing Cliffs Site of Grace.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Siofra Aqueduct The Crucible Hornshield is received upon defeating the Crucible Axe Knight at the Siofra Aqueduct, near the Aqueduct-Facing Cliffs Site of Grace.

entries.name: Cuckoo Greatshield
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes 4% drop chance from Cuckoo Knights. Four knights can be found on and beside the road leading northeast from East Raya Lucaria Gate Site of Grace to a point just south of Bellum Church.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes 4% drop chance from Cuckoo Knights. Four knights can be found on and beside the road leading northeast from East Raya Lucaria Gate Site of Grace to a point just south of Bellum Church.
entries.description: Metal greatshield painted with a peering cuckoo. Carried by the enchanted knights sworn to the academy. Boasting high magic damage negation, this shield is used to hunt down mages. "Our enemy is none other than Caria itself.".

entries.name: Distinguished Greatshield
entries.detailedLocation: Purchase: Hermit Merchant's Shack (Capital Outskirts) 1 is sold for runes 5500 Runes by the Hermit Merchant at the Hermit Merchant's Shack in Capital Outskirts.
entries.acquisition: Purchase: Hermit Merchant's Shack (Capital Outskirts) 1 is sold for runes 5500 Runes by the Hermit Merchant at the Hermit Merchant's Shack in Capital Outskirts.
entries.description: Greatshield featuring sumptuous ornamentation used by the scions of great families. Due to their excessive size, these shields were at times seen as the hallmark of little lordlings who were too timid to earn a few nicks and scratches.

entries.name: Dragon Towershield
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Crumbling Farum Azula Found in a chest in a side area after the Dragon Temple Rooftop, guarded by a Banished Knight. From the Site of Grace, run down to the nearby Ancient Dragon. Left/northeast of it, look over the cliff edge to finding a series of floating rocks to drop down to reach a building. Proceed past a Banished Knight and some Stormhawks to climb up a ladder, where the chest can be found by turning left twice, with another Banished Knight in front of it.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Crumbling Farum Azula Found in a chest in a side area after the Dragon Temple Rooftop, guarded by a Banished Knight. From the Site of Grace, run down to the nearby Ancient Dragon. Left/northeast of it, look over the cliff edge to finding a series of floating rocks to drop down to reach a building. Proceed past a Banished Knight and some Stormhawks to climb up a ladder, where the chest can be found by turning left twice, with another Banished Knight in front of it.
entries.description: Tower shield engraved with a dragon, symbol of protection. Heavy even among greatshields, it possesses exceptional guarding ability. The ancient dragons, who ruled in the prehistoric era before the Erdtree, would protect their lord as a wall of living rock.

entries.name: Dragonclaw Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Capital Outskirts Dropped by the Draconic Tree Sentinel boss that guards the main entrance to Leyndell, Royal Capital, in Capital Outskirts.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Capital Outskirts Dropped by the Draconic Tree Sentinel boss that guards the main entrance to Leyndell, Royal Capital, in Capital Outskirts.
entries.description: Greatshield said to have been whittled from the claw of a great, ancient dragon, wielded by grotesque Tree Sentinels who yet serve the Erdtree. Imbued with lightning.

entries.name: Eclipse Crest Greatshield
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes / Deeproot Depths / Consecrated Snowfield 4% drop rate from Greatsword-wielding Mausoleum Knight (excluding the Greatbow-wielding ones). One Greatsword-wielding Knight can be found with its back turned just outside of the Black Knife Catacombs, providing an easy farming spot.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes / Deeproot Depths / Consecrated Snowfield 4% drop rate from Greatsword-wielding Mausoleum Knight (excluding the Greatbow-wielding ones). One Greatsword-wielding Knight can be found with its back turned just outside of the Black Knife Catacombs, providing an easy farming spot.
entries.description: Metal greatshield painted with a sun in eclipse. Carried by the headless mausoleum knights. The eclipsed sun, drained of color, is the protective star of soulless demigods. It aids the mausoleum knights by keeping Destined Death at bay.

entries.name: Erdtree Greatshield
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Altus Plateau Dropped by the Tree Sentinel Duo guarding the southern gate from Altus Plateau to Capital Outskirts.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Altus Plateau Dropped by the Tree Sentinel Duo guarding the southern gate from Altus Plateau to Capital Outskirts.
entries.description: Weighty greatshield forged of gold carried by the order of Tree Sentinels, heavily equipped knights. Blessed by an old incantation of protection. The living rampart of the Erdtree, the Tree Sentinels are the standard to which all defenders of the Erdtree aspire.

entries.name: Fingerprint Stone Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Leyndell, Royal Capital) Found in the platforming segment leading to the Frenzied Flame Proscription. NOTE: Morgott, the Omen King must be defeated before this area can be accessed. If Morgott is still alive, a golden seal will block the path.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Leyndell, Royal Capital) Found in the platforming segment leading to the Frenzied Flame Proscription. NOTE: Morgott, the Omen King must be defeated before this area can be accessed. If Morgott is still alive, a golden seal will block the path.
entries.description: A great stone shield with an intricately carved fingerprint design. One of the heaviest of all greatshields. Part of the tomb of an ancient god, the Readerless Fingers relayed their message through these imprints, said to be the very seeds from which frenzy first sprouted.

entries.name: Gilded Greatshield
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Limgrave / Weeping Peninsula 4% drop chance from Godrick Knights. One spear-wielding Knight can be found at Gatefront Ruins. Two greatsword-wielding Knights can be found inside of the Godrick Soldier camp between Warmaster's Shack and Deathtouched Catacombs.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Limgrave / Weeping Peninsula 4% drop chance from Godrick Knights. One spear-wielding Knight can be found at Gatefront Ruins. Two greatsword-wielding Knights can be found inside of the Godrick Soldier camp between Warmaster's Shack and Deathtouched Catacombs.
entries.description: Metal greatshield coated with gold. Carried by knights loyal to Godrick. The red tinge in the gold coat mirrors the primordial matter that became the Erdtree. The color of homeward yearning.

entries.name: Golden Beast Crest Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed drop: Chapel of Anticipation Dropped by the Grafted Scion at the Chapel of Anticipation, along with the Ornamental Straight Sword. The Chapel can be revisited by using the "Precipice of Anticipation" Waygate at The Four Belfries, which is the second waygate from the top.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed drop: Chapel of Anticipation Dropped by the Grafted Scion at the Chapel of Anticipation, along with the Ornamental Straight Sword. The Chapel can be revisited by using the "Precipice of Anticipation" Waygate at The Four Belfries, which is the second waygate from the top.
entries.description: Shield of dull gold with a beast engraved as its crest. Lighter than most greatshields, and subsequently easier to wield. The beast depicted is Serosh, aged counselor who guides the golden lineage.

entries.name: Golden Greatshield
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Mt. Gelmir / Leyndell, Royal Capital 4% drop chance from Leyndell Knights (excluding the Greatbow-wielding ones but including the frenzied ones). The earliest Leyndell Knight can be found wandering alone just south of the Artist's Shack in Liurnia. Another can be found a bit south of the West Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell, guarded only by a Leyndell Foot Soldier.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Mt. Gelmir / Leyndell, Royal Capital 4% drop chance from Leyndell Knights (excluding the Greatbow-wielding ones but including the frenzied ones). The earliest Leyndell Knight can be found wandering alone just south of the Artist's Shack in Liurnia. Another can be found a bit south of the West Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell, guarded only by a Leyndell Foot Soldier.
entries.description: Oval greatshield made of gold, carried by knights who protect the Royal Capital of Leyndell. Knights of Leyndell are reputed for their sturdiness, exemplified by this shield's exceptional guard capacity.

entries.name: Haligtree Crest Greatshield
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree Has a 4% drop chance from one specific Haligtree Knight standing at the northern side of the chapel beyond the Drainage Channel Site of Grace.
entries.acquisition: Drop: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree Has a 4% drop chance from one specific Haligtree Knight standing at the northern side of the chapel beyond the Drainage Channel Site of Grace.
entries.description: Metal greatshield depicting the Haligtree with unalloyed gold. Carried by knights who have vowed to serve Miquella's Haligtree. Possesses high holy damage negation. Yet now, with the Haligtree misshapen, this wondrous rendition is a fleeting fantasy.

entries.name: Icon Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Woodfolk Ruins (Altus Plateau) Found on the right side inside the northernmost building at Woodfolk Ruins.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Woodfolk Ruins (Altus Plateau) Found on the right side inside the northernmost building at Woodfolk Ruins.
entries.description: Greatshield painted with a divine scene; the recipience of a blessed tear from the Erdtree. An item that looks back fondly on the age of plenty. The divine scene acts in and of itself as a sacred invocation; gradually restoring the carrier's HP.

entries.name: Inverted Hawk Towershield
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Nokron, Eternal City 1% drop chance from Greatshield-wielding Fallen Hawk Soldiers. Starting from the Nokron, Eternal City Site of Grace, three Greatshield-wielders can be found at the gazebo just to the east. A fourth one can be found at the tree in a corner northeast of the gazebo, and a fifth one is just outside of the narrow path down to the Mimic Tear.

entries.description: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Features an inverted hawk crest. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.

entries.name: Jellyfish Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Liurnia of the Lakes Found on a dead body with four Jellyfish around it, north of the Foot of the Four Belfries Site of Grace.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Liurnia of the Lakes Found on a dead body with four Jellyfish around it, north of the Foot of the Four Belfries Site of Grace.
entries.description: The head of a spirit jellyfish, commonly found floating above sacred ground throughout the Lands Between, wielded without modification as a shield. The see-through head is extremely light, but its flesh is supple, providing absolutely no protection from piercing attacks.

entries.name: Lordsworn's Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Deeproot Depths / Altus Plateau / Miquella's Haligtree 2% drop chance from any Spear-and-Greatshield-wielding Godrick Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Soldiers, Radahn Soldiers, Mausoleum Soldiers, Leyndell Soldiers, or Haligtree Soldiers. There are several Spear-and-Greatshield Soldiers in Gatefront Ruins, with one of them standing just south of the Site of Grace. A second can be found at the Ruin's western entrance and a third just to the left of the south entrance.

entries.description: Wooden tower shield. Lightweight for a greatshield and easy to handle. Commonly used in the Shattering. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.

entries.name: Manor Towershield
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Stormveil Castle From the Secluded Cell Site of Grace, head back towards the Living Jars, then turn right and follow the wall upon reaching the next level up the ramp to find a wooden scaffolding. At the end of the scaffolding is a ledge that can be jumped up to and the followed to the right to find a door. Following this path will lead to a storeroom full of Commoners with the Manor Shield being under the stairs.

entries.name: One-Eyed Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop: Guardians' Garrison (Mountaintops of the Giants) Dropped by Chief Guardian Arghanthy in the Guardians' Garrison in Mountaintops of the Giants.
entries.acquisition: Guaranteed Drop: Guardians' Garrison (Mountaintops of the Giants) Dropped by Chief Guardian Arghanthy in the Guardians' Garrison in Mountaintops of the Giants.
entries.description: Tricksome shield made from white stone depicting a malformed one-eyed god. The barrel of a firearm pokes through the open mouth. Once worshipped by the giants, this evil deity is believed to have been slain by Queen Marika.

entries.name: Redmane Greatshield
entries.detailedLocation: Drop: Caelid 4% drop chance from Redmane Knights (except for the Greatbow-wielding ones). A lone Redmane Knight can be found in a small camp a bit southwest of the Smoldering Wall Site of Grace. Three Redmane Knights can be found atop Fort Gael (ignoring the Greatbow-wielder outside of the Fort, since it can't drop the Greatshield).

entries.description: Greatshield shaped like a fang, featuring the crest of red-maned lion. Carried by the Redmane Knights who fought alongside Radahn.

entries.name: Spiked Palisade Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Caelid Found on the path from Deep Siofra Well to the Caelid Colosseum, on a small rock near where the first Golem Archer stands.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Caelid Found on the path from Deep Siofra Well to the Caelid Colosseum, on a small rock near where the first Golem Archer stands.
entries.description: A large wooden shield covered with spikes. Though relatively light, it lacks in damage negation. Designed to perform shield bashes, these attacks riddle the enemy with holes, earning it the nickname of "pard shield.".

entries.name: Verdigris Greatshield
entries.detailedLocation: Guaranteed Drop / Loot from Moore. Its location and availability can be determined by the player's dialogue-choices as they talk to Moore about the breaking of Miquella's great rune: Scadu Altus - If the player tells Moore to "Remain sad forever". Moore will quietly move to the cliffs north of the Church of the Crusade, where he can be found huddled up next to a motionless forager brood. Here, this item can be safely recovered from his body, with no need for a fight. Enir-Ilim - If the player selects "Put it behind you" when talking to Moore. Moore will appear at the Cleansing Chamber as one of the potential enemies in the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight. Defeating the loyalists will make this item appear on his body, which can be found in the arena after the battle is won. Gravesite Plain / Scadu Altus - The player can also get this item from killing Moore when he invades as retribution for the murder of two forager brood members. Note that Moore will not drop his bell bearing if killed in this manner, thus making that item inaccessible for the rest of the playthrough.

entries.description: Greatshield made of the unusual metal known as verdigris. Boasts greater guard capacity than damage negation. To the extent that the shield will continue to protect its target even if its bearer should die. |JP_Name=緑青の大盾 |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Visage Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Caelem Ruins (Caelid) It can be found in northeast Caelid, in a chest that's accessible after defeating the Mad Pumpkin Head Duo boss in the Caelem Ruins.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Caelem Ruins (Caelid) It can be found in northeast Caelid, in a chest that's accessible after defeating the Mad Pumpkin Head Duo boss in the Caelem Ruins.
entries.description: Tricksome bronze shield depicting the face of a Fire Giant. Several tongues leap from its open mouth. The dreadful visage and burning flames are designed to remind one of the horror of facing a Fire Giant. In other words, this shield has an instructional function.

entries.name: Wooden Greatshield
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave) Found on the upper floor of a guardhouse in Stormveil's courtyard, more specifically the guardhouse to the right if entering the area from the main gates and on the opposite side of the room with the "Prophecy" Painting.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave) Found on the upper floor of a guardhouse in Stormveil's courtyard, more specifically the guardhouse to the right if entering the area from the main gates and on the opposite side of the room with the "Prophecy" Painting.
entries.description: Wooden greatshield reinforced with a metal ornamentation. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.

entries.name: Carian Thrusting Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Specimen Storehouse (Shadow Keep) Located west of the Storehouse, Back Section site of grace, it can be found at the end of an open room guarded by a Fire Knight and a couple Shadow Undead.
entries.acquisition: Loot: Specimen Storehouse (Shadow Keep) Located west of the Storehouse, Back Section site of grace, it can be found at the end of an open room guarded by a Fire Knight and a couple Shadow Undead.
entries.description: Silver thrusting shield embedded with glintstones. Enables the wielder to attack and guard simultaneously. Once wielded by Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, during her sole entry into ritual combat—a demonstration of fidelity to the Erdtree. |JP_Name=カーリアの刺突盾 |JP_Source=1.12.

entries.name: Dueling Shield
entries.detailedLocation: Loot: Specimen Storehouse. Head north from the Storehouse, First Floor Site of Grace and up the stairs. Turn left and continue up two more flights of stairs until you reach a Fire Knight facing away from you. Follow the wooden path to the left of the Fire Knight, and on left you will see a buttress attached to the path, leading to a stone floor. Jump over the bannister, and the Dueling Shield can be found on a corpse against the wall.

entries.description: A "thrusting shield," or combined weapon and shield. Enables the wielder to attack and guard simultaneously. An armament once used in ritual combat performed to honor the Erdtree—a custom that had somehow remained within the realm of shadow.
